title: Senior Manager, Demand & Supply Planning
description:
The role

Today our jewellery manufacturing buys to order. A customer PO lands, we order loose diamonds from our own diamond-growing and polishing unit and findings (chains, earring backs, clasps and other bought-in components) from supplier partners, and both take 4–6 weeks. Customers often give us less time than that, so we rush, pay for it, or ship late. At the same time, parts of our factory sit under-loaded in off-season months and overloaded in peak.

You will fix both problems. You will forecast demand, place projection orders for diamonds and findings ahead of confirmed POs, hold the right buffer stock, and load slow months with pre-production of proven styles so we ship faster in season.

This is a pure planning role. You will not sell, buy on price, or run the shop floor. You will decide what we need, how much, and when — and be accountable for the numbers.


About us

Dholakia Lab Grown Diamond (DLGD) is the lab-grown diamond jewellery arm of the Hari Krishna (HK) Group. We are fully integrated, from growing and polishing lab-grown diamonds to designing and manufacturing jewellery for leading retailers and brands across the US, UK and Europe.


HK Group, founded in 1992, is one of India's largest diamond and jewellery exporters, with more than 11,000 people. In 2026, GJEPC recognised the Group as India's largest diamond jewellery manufacturer and exporter.


What you will do

1. Forecast demand

  • Build a rolling 12-month demand forecast by customer, programme, style family and month, refreshed monthly.
  • Use order history, seasonality (holiday, Valentine's, Mother's Day, bridal), customer sell-through and replenishment data, and known promotions.
  • Agree forecasts and blanket commitments directly with key customers' planning and merchandising teams, so our forecast rests on their plans, not only our history.
  • Measure and report forecast accuracy and bias every month, and explain the misses.

2. Plan loose diamonds

  • Translate the jewellery forecast into diamond requirements by shape, size/sieve, colour, clarity and certification.
  • Place monthly projection orders with our diamond unit so common qualities are polished and waiting before customer POs arrive.
  • Set and maintain safety stock for high-runner qualities; keep slow-moving and special qualities on order-to-order.
  • Cut rush orders (2-week turnarounds) to the exception, not the norm.

3. Plan findings and bought-in components

  • Build the findings plan (chains, earring backs, clasps, jump rings, settings and other parts) from the forecast and bills of materials.
  • Place projection and blanket orders with supplier partners, with agreed call-off schedules and minimum stock levels.
  • Standardise components where possible, so one stock serves many styles.
  • Track supplier lead time and on-time delivery, and escalate chronic gaps.

4. Level production across the year

  • Map capacity by department (casting, setting, polishing, assembly and others) month by month against demand.
  • Identify slow months and plan pre-production of proven, repeat styles into finished or semi-finished stock for peak season.
  • Only pre-build what has a firm customer commitment or a strong repeat history; agree the list with Sales and the Business Head before production starts.
  • Release work orders to the shop floor in line with the plan, and track plan vs actual.

5. Run the monthly planning cycle (S&OP)

  • Lead a monthly sales and operations planning meeting with Sales, Merchandising, Production, Procurement and Finance.
  • Bring one agreed number for demand, supply, inventory and capacity, with the risks and the decisions needed.
  • Model the cash and inventory cost of each planning choice before it is made.

6. Own inventory health

  • Monitor diamond, findings, WIP and finished-goods stock against agreed limits.
  • Flag ageing and excess stock early and propose how to use or re-allocate it.
  • Build and maintain the planning tools, dashboards and ERP master data the process depends on.


What you own, and what you don't

  • Demand: you own the forecast and its accuracy. Sales targets and customer pricing sit with Sales.
  • Diamonds and findings: you own what to order, how much and when, within an approved inventory budget. Supplier selection and price negotiation sit with Procurement.
  • Production: you own the monthly production plan and pre-build list. Shop-floor execution and staffing sit with Production.
  • Inventory: you own stock levels against agreed limits. Write-offs and valuation sit with Finance.

Projection orders and pre-builds above the approved inventory budget need sign-off from the Business Head and Finance.


How we will measure you

  • On-time, in-full delivery to customers
  • Orders delayed by diamond or findings shortage
  • Rush diamond orders as a share of total
  • Forecast accuracy and bias, by customer and style family
  • Inventory turns and ageing (diamonds, findings, finished goods)
  • Capacity utilisation in off-season months


Your first 90 days

  • Days 1–30: Map the current order-to-delivery flow, lead times by supplier, and the last 24 months of orders by customer and style. Identify the 20% of diamond qualities and findings that drive 80% of volume.
  • Days 31–60: Launch the first rolling forecast and the first projection orders for high-runner diamonds and findings. Propose safety-stock levels and an inventory budget.
  • Days 61–90: Run the first full monthly S&OP meeting. Present an off-season pre-build plan for the next slow period, with its cash and risk impact.


Who we are looking for

Must have

  • 8+ years in demand, supply or materials planning in manufacturing, with at least 3 years owning a forecast and inventory outcomes yourself.
  • Experience planning made-to-order or short-lifecycle products with long-lead materials (jewellery, watches, apparel, footwear, consumer goods or similar).
  • A proven record of cutting lead times or stock-outs without inflating inventory, with numbers to show it.
  • Strong Excel and data skills; comfortable building forecast models and planning dashboards from raw ERP data.
  • Hands-on ERP/MRP experience (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or a jewellery ERP).
  • The confidence to challenge Sales on forecasts and push back on rush requests, with data.


Strong advantage

  • Jewellery or diamond industry experience, especially with US, Europe & UK retail customers.
  • Working knowledge of diamond grading (shape, size, colur, clarity) and jewellery bills of materials.
  • S&OP / IBP process leadership, or APICS CPIM / CSCP certification.
  • Experience with statistical forecasting tools or Python / Power BI.


Education

  • Degree in engineering, supply chain, operations, statistics or a related field. An MBA in operations is welcome but not required.


The details

  • Title: Senior Manager – Demand & Supply Planning
  • Reports to: COO
  • Works with: Sales and Merchandising, Production, Procurement, our diamond unit, Finance
  • Team: Individual contributor at start, with scope to build a planning team of 2–3
  • Location: Mumbai,

title: TikTok Shop - Senior Logistics Cost Associate
description:

title: SAP PP/MM Business Analyst
description:
Company Overview


Stella-Jones is a leading manufacturer of essential infrastructure products focused on serving utilities and railroads, as well as supplying big box home improvement stores across North America. Headquartered in Montreal, Canada and publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange, Stella-Jones operates a vast network of facilities that employs more than 3,000 employees across the United States and Canada. Built on strong foundations with a coast-to-coast reach, we offer real opportunities for career success and community impact.


About the Opportunity

Are you ready to move beyond routine support and take true ownership of an enterprise-grade SAP environment?


At Stella-Jones, we are modernizing critical infrastructure products. As part of our digital transformation, we are rolling out SAP S/4HANA on RISE and establishing our internal SAP Center of Excellence (CoE).


We are looking for a senior SAP PP/MM Business Analyst to take the reins of our Production Planning and Materials Management landscape. In this high-impact role, you won't just configure systems—you will act as the strategic architect bridging IT and operations, leading the evolution of our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes across our manufacturing operations.


What You Will Do

  • Possess strong understanding of S&OP Transformation: Partner directly with operations and supply chain leadership to evolve our planning practices from siloed demand/supply balancing to a mature, integrated, cross-functional S&OP model.
  • Architect & Configure: Translate complex manufacturing and procurement workflows into scalable functional designs. Execute hands-on configuration across SAP PP (Work Centers, Routings, BOMs, MRP) and SAP MM (Procurement, Inventory Management, Valuation).
  • Drive S/4HANA Rollout: Play a pivotal role in the ongoing deployment, optimization, and continuous improvement of S/4HANA across the organization.
  • Bridge IT & Operations: Collaborate closely with Business Experts (BE), plant planners, and external AMS partners to align operational realities with SAP best practices.
  • Integrate & Innovate: Ensure seamless data flow and integration between PP, MM, SD, FICO, and future roadmap tools like SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on SAP functional experience, with proven expertise in both PP and MM modules.
  • S/4HANA Experience: Practical experience implementing, configuring, or supporting SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • S&OP Maturity: Strong conceptual and practical grasp of Sales & Operations Planning; proven experience guiding an organization through adoption.
  • Manufacturing & Supply Chain Acumen: Deep familiarity with plant operations, material flows, bill of materials (BOMs), inventory controls, and demand planning.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills in English with the ability to translate technical architecture into clear, business-friendly language across cross-functional teams.
  • Bonus Points: Hands-on experience with SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) or prior experience within heavy manufacturing, forest products, or process industries.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Modern Cloud Stack: Work directly on SAP S/4HANA on RISE, leveraging modern SAP architecture and best practices.
  • True Solution Ownership: Drive rollout initiatives, shape business process design, and help build a world-class internal CoE.
  • 100% employer paid extended health and dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D)
  • Short-Term and Long-Term disability coverage
  • Competitive compensation
  • Annual Bonus Program
  • Retirement program (RRSP) with generous Company match (150% of employee's 4% contribution)
  • Company Share Purchase Program with 25% Company contribution match
  • Career advancement opportunities

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, provincial, or local laws.


This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. title: Transportation Coordinator
description:
Job Purpose

The Transportation Coordinator is responsible for using data, analysis, and operational insight to improve the performance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness of the transportation network.

The role will analyze transportation activity, costs, service levels, and operational performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Working closely with internal teams, carriers, and transportation partners, the Transportation Analyst will translate data into actionable recommendations that improve service, reduce costs, and support informed business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze transportation data to identify trends, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), including on-time delivery, transportation cost, carrier performance, vehicle utilization, and service levels.
  • Develop and maintain accurate dashboards, reports, and performance analysis to provide clear visibility of transportation performance.
  • Provide regular insight and recommendations to operational and management teams, highlighting key issues, trends, and required actions.
  • Track transportation spend and analyze actual costs against budgets, forecasts, and agreed targets.

Transportation Optimization

  • Analyze transportation activity to identify opportunities to improve route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery performance, and overall network productivity.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce transportation costs while maintaining or improving service levels.
  • Analyze carrier performance and support the development of improvement plans where performance falls below agreed standards.
  • Support the evaluation and selection of carriers and transportation solutions.
  • Analyze transportation capacity and demand to support effective resource planning.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve transportation processes, systems, and ways of working.
  • Measure the impact of improvement initiatives and ensure benefits are tracked and sustained.
  • Challenge existing processes and develop data-led recommendations for more effective ways of working.

Stakeholder & Carrier Management

  • Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across Transport, Distribution, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
  • Work closely with carriers and third-party transportation providers to monitor performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide clear, concise, and commercially relevant analysis to support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Communicate performance issues and improvement opportunities clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Cost & Commercial Analysis

  • Monitor transportation expenditure and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Analyze freight rates, carrier costs, and other transportation-related expenditure.
  • Investigate and resolve transportation cost variances and billing discrepancies.
  • Support the development of transportation budgets and forecasts.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 2–5 years of experience in transportation analysis
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and data modeling.
  • Experience working with transportation or ERP systems, ideally including a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Good understanding of transportation operations and key transportation performance measures.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in transportation network analysis, route optimization, or network design.
  • Experience with using SQL to analyze datasets
  • Experience with freight auditing, billing, cost analysis, and rate benchmarking.

Key Competencies

  • Data-driven decision making – Uses data and evidence to identify issues, evaluate options, and make sound recommendations.
  • Analytical thinking – Able to interpret complex information, identify patterns, and determine root causes.
  • Commercial awareness – Understands the relationship between transportation cost, service, capacity, and operational performance.
  • Organization & prioritization – Effectively manages multiple activities and competing priorities.

Work Environment

  • The role involves regular collaboration with Transport, Distribution, Supply Chain, Finance and other operational teams.
  • The role will also involve interaction with external carriers and third-party transportation providers.
  • Occasional travel may be required to Distribution Centers, operational sites, or supplier locations.

Compensation

Salary: $75,000

title: Customer Forecast & Replenishment Planner
description:
We care for skin. We care for our people.

It all started with a pharmacist and a dream almost 140 years ago. Today, Beiersdorf is a global company with iconic brands — Coppertone, Aquaphor, Eucerin and NIVEA — focused on providing innovative, clinically-proven and safe skin and sun care solutions to more than 500 million consumers in over 200 countries — making people feel comfortable in their own skin.

At Beiersdorf, we care beyond skin. We care for people — our employees, our customers, our consumers and our communities — and our planet. We know that diversity of thought, backgrounds, experience and perspective enriches our culture and supports innovation and ingenuity. We know that responsibly-sourced, sustainable products and packaging make for a more sustainable future. And we know that when your skin feels better, you feel better.

A welcoming workplace that offers personal and professional growth for all individuals.

At Beiersdorf, you’ll find:

  • A welcoming workplace that values diversity, inclusion and belonging where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported
  • Flexible teams that enjoy a challenge and the ability to make an impact
  • A dynamic community of life-long learners that values individual skills, and a growth mindset as well as hard skills and established expertise
  • A purpose-led company that prioritizes your personal and professional development with the right balance of structure and flexibility to grow
  • A culture that lives by its core values of care, trust, simplicity, and courage

Unique benefits that consider the whole person.

We understand that you have a life outside of work, and we support you with unique benefits including:

  • Generous and flexible PTO policy
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Comprehensive Wellness and Benefits program
  • Cash Balance Plan (similar to a pension)
  • 401k match
  • Established Employee Resource Groups/affinity groups help to grow important connections and belonging with other colleagues
  • Dynamic work model – hybrid (at least 3 days on-site)

Base Salary Range:

$94,300.00

$118,200.00

Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills and other factors. Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility.

Experience, skills and competencies that lend themselves to this role:

We know that experience comes in all forms. We are looking for individuals who bring new and diverse skills to the team.

OVERVIEW:

The Customer Forecast & Replenishment Planner - Target leads customer-level planning, forecast collaboration, replenishment strategy, inventory health, and service performance. This role serves as the primary planning connection between the customer team, Sales, Demand Planning, Customer Service, Finance, Supply Planning, and customer replenishment partners.

The Planner translates Target’s customer demand signals, POS trends, order patterns, inventory insights, promotional activity, and service risks into actionable recommendations that improve forecast alignment, product availability, inventory productivity, and customer supply chain performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer Forecast & Planning Ownership

  • Own customer-level forecast and replenishment planning routines for assigned account in partnership with sales.
  • Partner with Sales to align forecast assumptions, risks, and opportunities with the account’s commercial and financial expectations, with Sales retaining final accountability for the financial call.
  • Partner with Demand Planning to provide customer-specific demand signals, order trends, POS insights, promotional assumptions, and forecast exceptions.
  • Review customer order forecasts, internal forecasts, item-level projections, and customer demand signals to identify alignment gaps.
  • Translate customer insights into clear planning recommendations for Sales and Demand Planning.
  • Support Sales in rolling forecast alignment and provide customer-level input into S&OP and demand planning processes.

Customer Replenishment & Inventory Strategy

  • Monitor customer inventory health, weeks of coverage/supply, in-stocks, service risk, fill rate, order cuts, and replenishment trends.
  • Identify inventory risks related to stockouts, excess, obsolete inventory, promotional builds, new item launches, discontinuations, and seasonal demand.
  • Recommend replenishment actions, inventory adjustments, and mitigation plans in partnership with Sales, Finance and Demand Planning.
  • Balance customer service needs with inventory efficiency, cost, and sales impact.
  • Partner with Customer Service and Supply Planning to resolve service issues and communicate risks clearly.
  • Lead customer/SKU inventory health reviews and ensure risks are prioritized with clear owners and next steps.

Customer Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the primary planning and replenishment partner for assigned customer replenishment contacts.
  • Partner with Sales on customer-facing supply chain communication, ensuring messaging is accurate, action-oriented, and aligned.
  • Participate in customer collaboration reviews, customer scorecard discussions, and planning conversations.
  • Prepare insights, talking points, and recommendations for customer meetings and internal account reviews.
  • Build trust with customer teams by providing timely, accurate, and business-relevant planning insights.

Business Analytics & Insights

  • Interpret KPI reporting, scorecards, dashboards, customer data, and replenishment trends to identify risks, opportunities, and root causes.
  • Lead root cause analysis for service issues, forecast misses, inventory gaps, order cuts, and customer performance concerns.
  • Convert data into business recommendations by clearly communicating the issue, impact, recommendation, owner, and timing.
  • Develop, maintain, and use account-specific reports and dashboards as needed, leveraging standardized tools and Analyst-prepared outputs where available, while owning the validation, interpretation, recommendations, and resulting actions for assigned accounts.
  • Provide recurring insights to cross functional partners.

New Item, Promotional & Seasonal Planning

  • Partner with Sales and Demand Planning to validate promotional assumptions, expected lift, customer order timing, and inventory needs.
  • Support pre-promotion planning by identifying supply risks, forecast gaps, and replenishment implications.
  • Lead post-promotion analysis for assigned accounts in partnership with Analyst, RGM, and/or Shopper teams focusing on business interpretation and future recommendations.
  • Support new item launch readiness, discontinuation planning, and seasonal inventory planning.

Cross-Functional Planning Partnership

  • Partner with Sales, Demand Planning, Customer Service, Supply Planning, and Finance to align on customer risks, forecast changes, promotional needs, and service issues.
  • Participate in weekly internal customer planning reviews and other account planning routines.
  • Provide customer-specific inputs into internal reporting, S&OP, risk reviews, and customer planning discussions.
  • Ensure follow-up actions are documented, assigned, and tracked.
  • Escalate risks proactively with a clear issue, impact, recommendation, owner, and timing.

Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring issues in replenishment, forecasting, reporting, customer communication, and cross-functional handoffs.
  • Recommend improvements to standard work, reporting consistency, planning routines, and escalation processes.
  • Help standardize customer planning practices across accounts.
  • Shift work from reactive issue resolution toward proactive risk identification and planning.

Key Partners and Performance Outcomes

Key Cross-Functional Partners

  • Sales / Customer Team
  • Demand Planning
  • Customer Service
  • Supply Planning
  • Finance
  • Customer Forecast & Replenishment Analyst
  • Customer replenishment contacts
  • Logistics / Transportation as needed

KPIs Owned or Influenced

  • Assigned customer replenishment visibility
  • Customer inventory health tracking
  • Customer/SKU risk identification
  • Root cause analysis support and follow-through
  • Customer-specific action tracking
  • Input quality into forecast alignment routines
  • Forecast accuracy and bias
  • In-stock %, fill rate, OTIF, WOS/WOC, sell-through, service level performance



QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Operations, Finance, or related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in replenishment, customer supply chain, sales planning, demand planning, supply planning, customer service operations, or a related role preferred.
  • Understanding of replenishment flow, inventory management, order patterns, service risk, customer scorecards, and supply chain KPIs.
  • Strong Excel and analytical skills required; Power BI, customer portals, ERP, and planning system experience preferred.
  • Ability to interpret data, identify risks, and communicate insights clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate work before sharing.
  • Strong communication, follow-through, and cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence without direct authority.

description:

For company profile, please visit the website :- www.assystem-india.com



Job Description

Job Description

Position: Engineer – Procurement (Civil Infrastructure – Design Projects)

Function: Procurement / Supply Chain Management

Industry: AEC / Civil Infrastructure / Engineering Consultancy

Location: As per business requirement



Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Procurement professional with exposure to the Civil Infrastructure and AEC (Architecture, Engineering & Construction) consulting sector. The incumbent will be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement activities for engineering and design consultancy projects, with a key focus on vendor identification, empanelment, evaluation, commercial negotiations and management of professional service providers.

The role requires close coordination with Project Managers, Design Heads, Technical Teams, Business Development and Finance to ensure timely onboarding of competent vendors and consultants, cost optimisation and adherence to project-specific requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Vendor Identification & Empanelment

  • Identify, evaluate and empanel vendors, specialist consultants and service providers for civil infrastructure design projects.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of qualified vendors across various engineering and design disciplines.
  • Assess vendor credentials, technical capabilities, relevant project experience, resource availability, financial stability and statutory compliance.
  • Establish vendor prequalification and evaluation criteria in coordination with technical and project teams.
  • Build a strong network of specialist consultants and design partners for project-specific requirements.

2. Project Procurement Management

  • Manage end-to-end procurement requirements for civil infrastructure design and engineering consultancy projects.
  • Understand project scope, technical requirements, deliverables and timelines to identify suitable procurement strategies.
  • Source and onboard external design consultants, specialist agencies and subcontractors for project execution.
  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely placement of work orders and service agreements.
  • Monitor procurement progress against project schedules and ensure timely mobilisation of external resources.

3. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimisation

  • Obtain and evaluate commercial proposals, quotations and fee structures from prospective vendors.
  • Conduct commercial negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favourable contractual terms.
  • Prepare cost comparisons, commercial evaluation statements and recommendations for vendor selection.
  • Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising technical quality and project deliverables.
  • Support budgeting and cost control for outsourced design and consultancy services.

4. RFQ, RFP & Contract Management

  • Prepare and issue Requests for Quotations (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and enquiries to prospective vendors.
  • Coordinate with technical teams for scope finalisation, BOQ / deliverable-based requirements and technical evaluations.
  • Review commercial terms, payment milestones, delivery schedules and contractual conditions.
  • Facilitate preparation and issuance of purchase orders, work orders and consultancy agreements.
  • Track contract validity, deliverables, variations, amendments and vendor performance.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Relationship Management

  • Work closely with Design, Project Management, Business Development, Finance and Legal teams.
  • Understand upcoming project requirements and develop a procurement plan aligned with business needs.
  • Establish and maintain long-term relationships with design consultants, specialist agencies and external service providers.
  • Resolve vendor-related commercial and coordination issues to ensure uninterrupted project delivery.

6. Compliance & Procurement Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the organisation's procurement policies, approval matrix and delegation of authority.
  • Maintain proper procurement documentation, vendor records, comparative statements and approval trails.
  • Monitor vendor performance through quality, turnaround time, cost and delivery parameters.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, contractual and organisational requirements.

Key Vendor Categories / Procurement Scope

  • Civil and structural design consultants.
  • Highway, expressway and transportation design consultants.
  • Bridge, flyover and elevated corridor design specialists.
  • Metro and railway infrastructure design consultants.
  • Geotechnical and survey agencies.
  • BIM and CAD design service providers.
  • MEP and utility design consultants.
  • Environmental and sustainability consultants.
  • Traffic engineering and transportation planning specialists.
  • Independent checking and proof-checking consultants.
  • Specialist engineering and technical service providers.

Experience

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience in procurement, preferably within Civil Infrastructure, Engineering Consultancy or AEC organisations.
  • Experience in procurement of professional services, design consultancy assignments and specialist engineering services.
  • Prior experience in vendor development, empanelment, commercial negotiations and contract management is essential.
  • Exposure to infrastructure projects such as highways, bridges, railways, metros, water and urban infrastructure will be preferred.





Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech) or Equivalent
  • MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain Management or Procurement would be an added advantage.

Additional Information

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of civil infrastructure design and engineering consultancy requirements.
  • Vendor sourcing, assessment, prequalification and empanelment.
  • Commercial evaluation, negotiation and cost optimisation.
  • RFQ / RFP management and contract administration.
  • Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
  • Analytical ability and commercial acumen.
  • Knowledge of procurement processes, documentation and governance.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement / ERP systems.

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

title: Program / Project Manager
description:
You'll be the person who keeps the company's operations moving so the founders and leadership can focus on customers. You'll own events, travel, vendors, hiring logistics and compliance follow-ups, working with a fast-moving team across India and the US. You'll use AI tools every day to work faster, and you'll check everything before it goes out.


What you'll do:

  • Conferences and events: run logistics end to end: registrations, booth setup and teardown vendors, shipping (UPS, boxes to hotels, tracking), design assets, travel, and post-event lead follow-up.
  • Travel and calendar: book hotels, flights and car rentals for the team and keep the team travel / conference calendar current.
  • Vendors and tools: own the vendor register (renewals, owners, costs, documents), flag renewals 30 days ahead, and handle tool accounts and invites for new joiners.
  • Hiring and onboarding: schedule interviews, run first-round fit screens for GTM roles, collect candidate documents, run background checks and the new-joiner onboarding checklist.
  • Partner and sales ops follow-ups: chase partners (PMS integrations, marketplace listings, credentials) and follow up after demos and onboarding calls so nothing is dropped.
  • Compliance support: run the weekly compliance sweep with Nihal (SOC 2 / GDPR tasks in Sprinto, evidence collection, nudges).
  • Office and team support: WeWork bookings, equipment, offsites, and being the point of contact for small requests like website updates.
  • Use AI well: draft follow-ups, notes, trackers and recaps with tools like Claude and Gemini, then review them for accuracy before sending.


How we'll measure success (first 90 days):

  • Conference checklists 100% closed 7 days before each event
  • Travel booked within policy and at least 14 days ahead (90%)
  • Zero surprise vendor renewals (all flagged 30 days ahead)
  • Interviews scheduled within 2 working days
  • No compliance items overdue more than 7 days
  • Requests acknowledged the same day and closed within 3 working days
  • Recaps posted within 24 hours of key meetings


You'll do well here if you:

  • Are extremely organized and follow through without being chased
  • Write and speak clear, professional English (you'll work with US colleagues and partners)
  • Are comfortable with Google Workspace and Slack, and have used AI tools at work
  • Can juggle many small tasks and know which one matters most


Nice to have:

  • Experience working with a US team
  • Event, conference or travel coordination
  • Startup experience

title: Supplier Strategy Analyst
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions provider helping organizations optimize their talent strategies, manage complex workforce programs, and achieve business objectives. Through our Managed Service Provider (MSP) solutions, we partner with leading organizations to drive supplier performance, strengthen workforce management strategies, and deliver measurable business value. Our teams combine data-driven insights, operational excellence, and collaborative partnerships to help clients build more effective and efficient workforce programs.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized Supplier Strategy Analyst to support supplier performance and strategic initiatives across our Managed Service Provider (MSP) programs. This position plays an important role in evaluating staffing supplier effectiveness, developing actionable insights, and supporting supplier relationships across multiple client accounts. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, identifying trends, creating compelling presentations, and collaborating with diverse stakeholders. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional looking to build expertise in business analytics, supplier strategy, and workforce solutions while gaining exposure to enterprise clients and strategic business operations.


Job Description

  • Supplier Performance Analysis: Analyze staffing supplier performance across multiple MSP programs, evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), identify trends, and recommend opportunities to improve supplier effectiveness and program outcomes.
  • Business Reviews & Presentations: Develop supplier scorecards, performance summaries, and executive-ready PowerPoint presentations for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), supplier meetings, and client leadership discussions.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Support supplier engagement activities, including supplier vetting, onboarding, ongoing performance evaluations, compliance reviews, and relationship management initiatives.
  • Requisition Distribution & Optimization: Monitor job requisition distribution across supplier networks, maintain accurate distribution lists, evaluate supplier participation, and identify opportunities to improve requisition coverage and supplier engagement.
  • Data Management & Integrity: Maintain accurate supplier records within Pinnacle Group's Supplier Portal, including supplier contacts, diversity certifications, compliance documentation, and alignment with client Vendor Management Systems (VMS).
  • Reporting & Dashboard Development: Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, support supplier scorecard implementation, analyze supplier performance metrics, and assist with job family mapping and workforce data reporting.
  • Strategic Insights & Continuous Improvement: Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that support supplier optimization, operational efficiency, and informed business decisions.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Supplier Strategy, MSP account leadership, internal operations teams, and external suppliers to coordinate meetings, communicate findings, and support strategic initiatives.
  • Program & Project Coordination: Track action items, maintain project documentation, coordinate supplier summits and business reviews, and ensure timely follow-through on supplier-related initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field; a concentration in Business Analytics is preferred.
  • 0–2 years of relevant professional experience in business analysis, reporting, operations, supplier management, customer service, or a related discipline. Recent graduates with relevant internships or academic projects are encouraged to apply.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, manipulate, analyze, and interpret datasets, using tools such as pivot tables, formulas, charts, and lookups.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to develop professional presentations, communicate data-driven insights, and create materials suitable for business and leadership reviews.
  • Demonstrated analytical aptitude, intellectual curiosity, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns, evaluate performance, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and business leaders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate records, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous customer service or stakeholder-facing experience required. Exposure to staffing, workforce solutions, MSP programs, supplier management, or Vendor Management Systems (VMS) is a plus, but not required.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you'll have the opportunity to develop valuable analytical and business skills while contributing to strategic supplier initiatives that support major enterprise workforce programs. This role offers meaningful exposure to business leadership, supplier strategy, performance analytics, and operational decision-making. You'll join a collaborative, results-driven environment that values curiosity, accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth. With a fully remote work arrangement and opportunities to expand your responsibilities, this position provides a strong foundation for a career in business analytics, supplier strategy, or workforce solutions.


AI Recruiting Disclosure

During the hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in evaluating information related to your application. These tools may help analyze job-related qualifications or assist recruiters in reviewing applications and interview responses. AI-generated information is one factor considered in our hiring process. Final employment decisions are made by qualified hiring personnel and are not based solely on AI-generated recommendations.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Junior Material Planner
description:
About Position:


We are seeking a Junior Material Planner with 2-5 years of experience to support material planning and supply chain operations for global manufacturing environments. The role is responsible for ensuring timely availability of raw materials and purchased components through effective planning, inventory management, supplier coordination, and SAP-based planning activities. The ideal candidate will work closely with suppliers, logistics teams, and plant operations to support uninterrupted production while maintaining planning accuracy and process compliance.


  • Role: Junior Material Planner
  • Location: All Persistent Locations
  • Experience: 2 to 5 Years
  • Job Type: Full-Time Employment


What You'll Do:


  • Execute material planning activities based on customer demand, production schedules, forecasts, and inventory requirements.
  • Support planning and coordination of raw materials and purchased components to ensure uninterrupted production operations.
  • Analyze demand data using SAP and planning tools to determine material requirements and replenishment needs.
  • Monitor inventory levels and maintain optimal stock availability while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Coordinate with suppliers for purchase order confirmations, shipment schedules, delivery commitments, and issue resolution.
  • Track inbound logistics activities to ensure timely delivery of materials to manufacturing locations.
  • Maintain accurate planning, inventory, and procurement-related data within SAP systems.
  • Identify material shortages, supply constraints, and delivery risks and escalate issues proactively.
  • Support inventory reconciliation, stock monitoring, and material availability tracking activities.
  • Ensure compliance with internal planning procedures, supply chain processes, and customer delivery requirements.
  • Collaborate with procurement, logistics, warehouse, and production teams to improve supply chain efficiency.
  • Prepare planning reports, inventory status updates, and material availability analysis.
  • Assist in continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and operational excellence.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for material shortages and supply disruptions.


Expertise You'll Bring:


  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
  • 2-5 years of experience in Material Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Production Planning, or Supply Chain operations.
  • Hands-on experience working with SAP MM or similar ERP systems.
  • Strong understanding of material planning, inventory control, procurement processes, and supply chain operations.
  • Experience monitoring inventory levels, material availability, and production requirements.
  • Knowledge of MRP (Material Requirements Planning) concepts and planning methodologies.
  • Experience coordinating with suppliers for order tracking, shipment follow-ups, and material delivery management.
  • Familiarity with demand planning, forecasting, replenishment planning, and inventory optimization techniques.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret planning and inventory data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel including Pivot Tables, Lookups, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Understanding of logistics, warehousing, and inbound supply chain processes.
  • Experience maintaining master data and planning information within ERP systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and mitigate supply risks.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and process compliance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced supply chain environment.


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

title: Associate Consultant - Manufacturing Operations Excellence
description:
Company Overview:

Purple Oak Advisors is a management and strategy consulting firm specializing in providing business transformation and performance improvement solutions to emerging market leaders. We are committed to delivering innovative strategies and sustainable improvements that drive growth and efficiency for our clients.


Position Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic Associate Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in analyzing business and factory operations, identifying areas for improvement, and devising strategic initiatives to optimize performance for our clients.


Key Responsibilities:

Process Improvement & Optimization:

  • Conduct in-depth analyses of client factory operations, maintenance and quality processes; identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for enhancement.
  • Design and implement process optimization strategies, leveraging best practices to streamline operations and enhance productivity.
  • Collaborate with client teams to re-engineer workflows, establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), and monitor adherence.

Factory Operations Cost Optimization:

  • Analyze client cost structures, identify cost-saving opportunities, and develop actionable strategies for reducing expenses without compromising quality.
  • Implement lean management principles and other cost-control techniques to drive efficiency.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews to ensure sustained cost reductions.

Strategic Initiative Development:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and execute strategic initiatives aligned with client business objectives.
  • Utilize data analytics and performance metrics to measure the impact of implemented strategies.

Client Communication & Reporting:

  • Prepare clear, data-driven presentations and reports outlining findings, recommendations, and implementation plans for clients.
  • Present insights and solutions to client stakeholders, ensuring alignment and understanding.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Contribute to the enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks used by Purple Oak Advisors.
  • Stay updated with industry best practices in process optimization, cost management, and working capital management.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or industrial engineering.
  • 2-3 years of experience in management consulting, or in a manufacturing set up, with a focus on lean manufacturing, process improvement, cost optimization, or working capital management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and Kaizen.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple client engagements.

title: Assistant Manager - Planning
description:
Mechanical Drawing Analysis, Raw Material Planning & Subcontracting

  • Analyze mechanical drawings to identify part dimensions, quantities, tolerances, material grades, thicknesses, and finishing requirements. Based on the project needs, we calculate raw material quantities and optimize nesting to reduce waste.
  • We then prepare clear material take-offs and procurement lists including stock sizes, quantities, and specifications for supplier quotation and subcontract fabrication. This helps ensure the correct materials are ordered and delivered in line with project requirements.


Release of Production Planning & MIS

  • Releasing weekly production plans based on project priorities, material availability, capacity, and delivery dates. Regular MIS reports provide an overview of project status, including planned versus actual progress, work-in-progress, delays, material requirements, and key actions—helping teams coordinate and address issues promptly.


Inventory & Material Management

  • Analyze current inventory levels as per the BOM and transfer available items from free/excess stock to fulfill production orders.
  • Release Purchase Requisitions (PR) for non-stock and shortage items.
  • Coordinate closely with the SCM team to ensure timely placement of Purchase Orders (POs) aligned with delivery schedules.
  • Escalate potential delays to management and facilitate interventions to maintain on-time delivery.

Production Planning & Control

  • Create Manufacturing Work Orders (MWO) for Assembly and Sub-Assembly BOMs.
  • Release Pick Lists or Material Requisitions (MR) in ERP for issuing materials from stores.
  • Follow up with the stores team for kit readiness and launch production as per the defined schedule.
  • Prioritize inward materials and coordinate with QC for GRN and inspection to ensure a smooth production flow.
  • Monitor and record production progress; escalate any design, capacity, or material shortage issues to the Head of Operations.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement processes for returning excess items through Component Return Notes (CRN) to optimize inventory utilization.
  • Drive continuous improvement by collecting feedback, analyzing performance data, and implementing best practices.
  • Identify potential risks (e.g., supplier delays, equipment failures) and develop mitigation and contingency plans.

Coordination & Communication

  • Ensure seamless coordination among Project Management, Design, Production, Quality, Testing, and Logistics teams.
  • Develop and implement risk management and issue-mitigation strategies.
  • Communicate operational changes, risks, and corrective actions to relevant stakeholders effectively and on time.

Root Cause & Corrective Action Management

  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to identify underlying issues and define effective corrective actions.
  • Develop and execute action plans to address recurring operational challenges.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures and ensure sustained process improvement.

Dispatch & Logistics

  • Close Work Orders, complete draw transactions for assemblies, and move items to FG stock.
  • Coordinate with Stores/Logistics for final packing and vehicle booking for dispatch.
  • Ensure deliveries meet customer specifications and timelines.
  • Circulate dispatch notifications to Finance/Stores for invoice processing.

title: Global Account Analyst
description:
Within our Corporate Supply Chain team located in Denver – Leprino is seeking a Global Account Analyst to support customer accounts across our dairy products business and help drive continued growth. We take pride in our vision to be “world’s best”—it’s why we work harder, invest more, and continually innovate.


At Leprino, starting compensation for this role typically ranges between $73,000 and $81,000. This position has an annual target bonus of 5%.


What You’ll Do:

  • Support global customer accounts across Leprino’s businesses, ensuring every order—from setup to delivery—runs smoothly and accurately!
  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of customer orders—contributing to the execution of 60,000+ annual orders across 300+ products, with individual orders potentially valued at up to $100,000.
  • Build and maintain clear communication with customers and internal partners to keep orders on track and expectations aligned.
  • Enter and manage customer orders in our systems with precision, checking pricing and shipment details to make sure everything’s right the first time.
  • Help prepare documentation for both domestic and international shipments, supporting compliance and timely delivery.
  • Identify and troubleshoot order or invoice discrepancies, working with cross-functional teams to resolve issues quickly.
  • Support customer contract execution, including pricing, product setup, and account maintenance.
  • Review customer feedback and partner with your team to strengthen service and prevent recurring problems.
  • Support global trade compliance activities, including export documentation, routed transactions, and regulatory filings such as AES, helping mitigate shipment risk and avoid costly penalties.
  • Pitch in when teammates need coverage or backup; together, we make sure our customers always receive excellent service.


You Have At Least (Required Qualifications):

  • A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, International Business, or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding of order management or logistics, gained through coursework, internships, or hands-on experience.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • A genuine curiosity about global operations, documentation, and customer management systems like SAP.
  • Availability for limited after-hours support rotations when needed to maintain global service continuity.


We Hope You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications):

  • A master’s degree or additional coursework in Supply Chain Management, International Business, or Operations.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and exposure to export documentation or customs processes.
  • Previous internship or work experience supporting order management, trade compliance, or customer service.
  • Familiarity with data accuracy or invoice reconciliation processes.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish (written and verbal) to support international customer communications.


At Leprino, we believe in equal employment opportunity and make employment decisions based on each individual’s unique talents, experience, skills, and knowledge; we do not discriminate on the basis of any personal characteristics. We know we are better together and are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive culture in which all employees can thrive.


Offering You In Return:

A chance to be part of a global team of individuals passionate about producing and delivering high-quality products that help feed and nourish families around the world. Leprino could not be where it is today without our incredible employees. That is why we share in our success together by rewarding you for your hard work. Hiring great people who are in it for the long run is our goal. Through competitive salaries and bonuses, life, medical/dental/vision coverage, voluntary benefits, employee assistance programs, wellness incentives, tuition assistance, vacation, ten paid holidays, sick time, paid parental leave, annual merit increases, as well as the LFC Profit-Sharing & 401(k) plan. Your impact will be noticed and rewarded, as you seek to further our company, our customers, and one another.


Our Story:

Leprino’s history dates back to the 1950s, when Jim Leprino first started making small batches of mozzarella for local markets and eateries in the Little Italy neighborhood of Denver. We’ve grown a bit since then. Today, Leprino is the world’s largest manufacturer of mozzarella and lactose, and a leading producer of whey protein. Still owned by the Leprino family, our sights are set to be the “World’s Best Dairy Food and Ingredient Company.” From a small corner grocery store we have grown to over 5,500 employees throughout the globe. Will you join us on our journey?


Learn more at Leprino.com

An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and India through its family of brands — Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media and Neon Earth.

From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades, to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients and partners make a personalised statement through customisation.


While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1,450+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

Learn more: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/


About the Role

We are looking for an analytical and initiative-taking Assistant/ Deputy Manager – Material Planning to own material planning for a defined set of brands and strategic accounts.

Group Bayport operates a predominantly made-to-order custom manufacturing model across a high-SKU environment. That makes material planning the difference between an order shipping on time and a production line standing idle. The role is accountable for having the right materials available when production needs them, for holding inventory at the agreed norms, and for working closely with Procurement, Production Planning and Operations so that plans translate into actual availability on the floor.


Position details

Designation: Assistant/ Deputy Manager – Material Planning

Function: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material Planning

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Experience: 6 – 10 years


Key Responsibilities

Planning ownership

  • Own the material plan end to end for assigned brands and strategic accounts.
  • Build material requirement plans from sales orders, customer forecasts, and production schedules.
  • Convert requirements into purchase requisitions and release them to Procurement with the correct priority and timing.
  • Maintain planning parameters in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master data.


Material availability and risk

  • Ensure availability of all production inputs — textiles, printing media, inks, hardware, packaging, and consumables.
  • Review material availability against the production plan daily and flag risks before they affect output.
  • Track supplier lead times and escalate slippage to Procurement early enough to act on it.
  • Identify shortages and build contingency plans — alternate material, alternate source, or re-sequencing with Production Planning.

Inventory management

  • Hold inventory at agreed norms — neither short nor in excess.
  • Analyse consumption trends and recommend stocking strategy for fast-moving and critical materials.
  • Review inventory ageing and slow-moving or non-moving stock and drive corrective action.
  • Lead inventory optimisation initiatives without compromising service levels.

Coordination and reporting

  • Work closely with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, Stores and Operations to ensure seamless material flow.
  • Participate in the S&OP cycle and support demand planning.
  • Publish daily, weekly, and monthly planning reports and KPIs.
  • Improve planning processes through data analysis and better use of the ERP.

Scope boundary

This role plans, triggers and tracks material requirements. Purchase order placement, supplier negotiation and vendor follow-up sit with Procurement. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating risk; Procurement is accountable for the buy.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • MBA or PGDM in Operations or Supply Chain Management preferred.


Experience

  • 6 to 10 years in material planning, production planning, supply chain, or inventory management.
  • Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
  • Experience in a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is a strong advantage.
  • Experience planning across multiple brands or business lines is an advantage.


Technical Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
  • Firsthand experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and modelling.
  • Comfortable analysing consumption patterns and demand data to reach a recommendation.


Competencies

  • Analytical, with a bias for working from data rather than assumption.
  • Organised, and able to carry several priorities without dropping any of them.
  • Communicates clearly across functions and manages stakeholders well.
  • Takes ownership of outcomes rather than of tasks.
  • Strong diligence and comfortable working at pace.


Preferred Industry Experience

  • Signage manufacturing
  • Digital and large format printing
  • Textile manufacturing
  • Packaging
  • Custom or made-to-order manufacturing

CREW LEADER TRAINER

The Crew Leader Trainer, under the general supervision of a Landscape Manager or Supervisor, acts as the primary source ensuring job site quality; this includes ensuring that tools and equipment are maintained in good order and the maintenance of a safe and orderly work environment. Trainees in the program may face challenges due to homelessness, re-entry, or underemployment. This is a full-time, non-exempt position.

Proof of a valid Real ID driver's license and an acceptable Motor Vehicle Report is required for this position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for the consistent delivery of on-time work production and service in line with Rubicon Landscape and contract quality standards.

  • Scheduling: Schedule the week’s work routes, including early shift hours to avoid pedestrian traffic and busy parking zones, and adjust for unforeseen demands to expedite work in non-scheduled zones.

  • Communication: Build relationships with clients and property managers; serve as the first point of contact in the field for questions and issues.
  • Evaluation: Assist Managers in assessing the performance and skill development of team members and trainees, giving constructive feedback.

COMPETENCIES

title: Sports Lead
description:
Put thumpN behind the gates of India's biggest leagues, tournaments and stadiums.


Why This Role Exists:


Sports fans don't just watch. They show up.


Cricket fills stadiums, and football, kabaddi, badminton and motorsports are building loyal crowds of their own across leagues, franchises and tournaments. Selling those seats well is a serious job: large inventories, complex rights, many stakeholders and fans who expect it to just work.


You'll own sports at thumpN. You'll win sports properties, lead the proposals and negotiations that get us there, and build long-term partnerships that make thumpN a ticketing name that federations, leagues and franchises trust.


What You'll Actually Do:

  • Independently lead business acquisition, RFPs, tenders, commercial proposals and contract negotiations for sports properties.
  • Identify new sports properties and expand thumpN's presence across sporting categories.
  • Own sports category revenue, pipeline, client retention and commercial performance.
  • Build long-term partnerships with federations, state associations, leagues, franchises and tournament organisers.
  • Manage complex stakeholder relationships across franchises, governing bodies, venue authorities, sponsors and operational partners.
  • Grow existing accounts into multi-season, multi-event partnerships.
  • Work with Account Management, Operations, Product and Technology to turn client requirements into ticketing solutions that work on match day.
  • Shape pricing, inventory and revenue projections for the properties you bring in.
  • Work with Marketing and Finance so every partnership is delivered and reported well.


What You Bring:


Required:

  • Relevant industry experience is a must. At least 5 years in the sports business, ideally in sports ticketing, commercial partnerships, league operations, franchise management or sports event management.
  • You already know the people who run Indian sports. Established relationships with federations, state associations, leagues, franchises, tournament organisers, sports agencies and commercial rights holders.
  • You've worked in professional sports. Hands-on experience with professional sporting events, ideally across cricket, football, kabaddi, badminton, motorsports or other major properties.
  • You can win a formal deal. You've led RFPs, tenders, commercial proposals and contract negotiations, and closed them.
  • You understand the business of sports ticketing. Ticketing economics, stadium inventory, pricing strategy, revenue projections, ticketing rights and commercial models.
  • You think in numbers, not just conversations. Strong commercial sense and a track record of working towards acquisition, revenue, GMV and category growth targets.
  • Your partners come back. You build relationships that turn one tournament into a multi-season partnership.
  • You make sure the deal turns into match day. You work with internal teams so onboarding and delivery run smoothly.


Preferred:

  • Experience independently managing large sporting properties or multi-event accounts. This one matters.
  • Exposure to more than one sport, not just cricket.
  • A genuine love for live sport. You know the difference between watching on TV and being in the stands.


Non-Negotiables:

  • You run your own patch. You're proactive, target-driven and comfortable working with minimal supervision in a company that's growing fast.
  • You're at home in the room. Federations, franchises and venue authorities all want different things. You can keep them aligned and still close the deal.

title: Supplier Quality Assurance
description:
Reporting to the Country TR Manager and working with customer teams, you will be assigned

full-time to a single supplier and based at that suppliers site. As the customers dedicated

on-site operational representative, you will monitor supplier performance daily and

coordinate the actions required to protect quality, supply and delivery commitments.


GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your mission focuses on five priorities:

Supply: monitor open orders, materials, capacity, WIP and critical parts.

Quality: verify product conformity with approved drawings, specifications and

customer requirements.

Process: confirm actual shop-floor progress, identify bottlenecks and drive corrective

or recovery actions.

Feedback and reporting: provide clear, fact-based updates on risks, actions, owners

and deadlines to the customer and Country TR Manager.

On-time delivery: challenge supplier commitments and coordinate priorities to

secure agreed delivery dates.

This is a full-time assignment at one suppliers site, with on-site presence throughout the

working week to ensure continuous monitoring and follow-up.

This list is not exhaustive.

CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS

External relationships:

Industrial customers / OEMs

Suppliers and subcontractors

Industrial partners and logistics service providers, depending on the scope of the

assignment.

Internal relationships:

Country TR Manager and operational managers

Supplier Management, Supply Chain, Quality and Engineering teams

Sales teams and relevant support functions

Customer teams and relevant stakeholders.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

The assignment is performed full-time at a single suppliers site. You will be integrated into

the suppliers day-to-day operational environment while remaining accountable to the

Country TR Manager and working in close coordination with the customer. The position

requires autonomy, availability, rigour, confidentiality and the ability to work in a multicultural

environment.

Supplier Delivery Assurance Engineer (DAS)

REPORTING & COMMUNICATION

You will be required to prepare and maintain:

The updated Open Order Report

The tracking of critical parts, overdue orders and delivery commitments

On-site monitoring and shop-floor validation reports

The monitoring of recovery plans and corrective actions

The OTD dashboard and agreed performance indicators

Weekly reporting on risks, deviations, actions, owners and deadlines

The necessary escalations to the Country TR Manager and the customers

Communication materials will use TRIGO standards, but may also include the tools,

templates, databases or platforms required by the customer.

DAILY ROUTINE WITH THE PMO

You will hold a daily coordination meeting with the PMO to review the suppliers actual

shop-floor progress against the production schedule and delivery commitments,

confirm critical parts and priorities for the day, and identify quality issues, bottlenecks

and risks to project milestones.

Agree actions, owners and deadlines, update the shared action tracker, and escalate

issues requiring customer or Country TR Manager decisions.

Provide the PMO with an end-of-day status update on completed actions, remaining

blockers and priorities for the next working day.

QUALITY MANAGEMENT

You will ensure compliance with the procedures, instructions and requirements of the TRIGO

Quality Management System, as well as the rules applicable at customer and supplier sites.

REQUIRED PROFILE

With a 2 to 5 year higher education qualification in industrial engineering, mechanical

engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality or an equivalent technical field, you should

ideally have significant experience in an industrial environment, in manufacturing, supply

chain, supplier management or supplier performance.

You understand manufacturing processes, production planning, industrial flows and

capacity constraints

You can analyse a production schedule, backlog, Open Order Report, WIP and OTD

indicators

You can verify actual production progress directly on the shop floor

You can interpret technical drawings, specifications and control plans, assess product

conformity and identify deviations that may affect quality, delivery or project

milestones

You can develop, challenge and monitor a supplier recovery plan

You are proficient in problem-solving and root cause analysis methods

You are proficient in Excel and reporting tools knowledge of Power BI is an advantage

You are fluent in English in a technical and professional environment proficiency in an

additional language is an advantage

You communicate confidently with suppliers and customer teams in a multicultural

environment

You demonstrate autonomy, tenacity, diplomacy, rigour and sound judgement

regarding escalation

You are available to work full-time on site at the assigned suppliers location.

This list is not exhaustive.

KEY DELIVERABLES

Updated Open Order Report

Critical Parts Status and past-due order tracking

WIP / shop-floor status

Product conformity and compliance status against approved drawings, specifications

and control plans

Quality deviation, containment and corrective action tracker

Supplier recovery plan and action tracker

Risk and escalation list

OTD dashboard

Regular report for the Country TR Manager and the customer.

title: Purchasing Officer (Import & Logistics)
description:
An established Australian wholesale business in rugs and home décor is looking for an experienced import Purchasing Officer to manage our overseas orders from factory to warehouse. This role suits someone who already knows the import process inside out and is naturally organised. You stay on top of every order, follow up before things go wrong, and keep management informed without being asked.


What you’ll be doing

  • Placing and managing purchase orders with our overseas agents and suppliers
  • Tracking production, shipping and delivery dates across all live orders
  • Following up with suppliers for confirmations, samples and shipping documents
  • Coordinating with our freight forwarder and warehouse on arrivals
  • Keeping order information accurate and up to date in our systems
  • Giving management regular, clear updates on order status, delays and anything that needs a decision
  • Flagging stock and reorder needs early


What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years’ experience in an import purchasing or freight coordination role, including overseas supplier management, sea freight and import documentation. Domestic purchasing experience alone won’t be enough for this role.
  • A Certificate or Diploma in Logistics/Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related field (or working towards one) is a plus, but experience matters most.
  • Strong organisation and time management skills, with a reliable system for keeping many orders on track at once.
  • A strong follow-up habit. You chase suppliers and forwarders before small delays turn into problems.
  • Proactive communication with management, giving clear, regular updates on order status, delays and anything that needs a decision.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Self-direction and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Clear, professional communication with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders and internal teams.
  • Confidence using cloud-based business systems and ERPs, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • A proactive, reliable and process-driven approach. You spot issues early and take practical action.


The good bits

  • Part-time, with flexibility offered.
  • Gorgeous product. Work with design-led product that ends up in homes and stores across Australia.
  • Full training and a documented process
  • Small team, quick decisions, zero bureaucracy
  • A growing business where good people get noticed
  • This role is an in office role - no remote work

title: Product Change Analyst 2
description:
Product Change Analyst 2


Location: Tualatin, OR 97062

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST

Work Arrangement: Tuesday–Thursday onsite; Monday and Friday remote

Pay Range: $31.54 - $36.79/Hour


Position Overview

The Product Change Analyst 2 will manage and coordinate Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), ensuring product changes are properly reviewed, assessed, documented, and implemented across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Planning teams.

This position focuses on evaluating inventory and material impacts, coordinating demand assessments, minimizing excess inventory, and supporting successful implementation of engineering changes.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in Engineering Change Management, supply chain or demand planning, and inventory analysis. They should be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and coordinate Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), including approval processes.
  • Work with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Planning to ensure inventory and demand assessments are completed before ECN approval.
  • Evaluate material availability and inventory impacts to minimize excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Analyze financial impacts associated with engineering changes, including rework costs and excess inventory.
  • Coordinate with ECN stakeholders and Change Implementation Management (CIM) Program Managers to support implementation plans.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and remote factories to update impacted sales orders based on material availability and demand.
  • Assess material availability and inventory impacts to establish appropriate ECN implementation dates.
  • Support ECN escalations, containment activities, and mitigation plans.


Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Engineering Change Management processes.
  • Experience with demand management, planning, and/or supply chain activities.
  • Understanding of Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, including Configurable BOMs.
  • Experience with:
  • Microsoft Excel
  • PLM systems
  • Siemens Teamcenter
  • SAP
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Diploma in Engineering or Bachelor's degree preferred. Candidates with extensive relevant change management experience may be considered without a degree.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Six Sigma or other structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and process improvement capabilities.
