title: Senior Functional Consultant Retail
description:
Business Operations Specialist


Be part of something revolutionary

We have a vision. Our Digital Brain, o9’s AI-powered platform, is being used by global enterprises to drive their digital transformations. The integrated planning and operational efficiencies we provide is helping businesses do more, be more and mean more to the world at large. Because businesses that plan better, reduce waste, creating value for themselves and the planet.

But we also have a vision for our people. We want the most talented, committed and driven people to power our transformative approach. In return, we’ll provide a nurturing environment where you can be a part of something special.


About o9 solutions:


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


What you’ll have…


● At least 2+ years of experience with implementing planning applications for Retail Industry is a MUST

● Hands on experience with implementing solutions for one or more key retail planning processes such as Merchandise Financial Planning, Assortment Planning, Allocations, Replenishment and Retail Forecasting

● Deep experience in end-to-end lifecycle of implementation; phases such as blueprinting, configuration, testing, go -live

● Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is desirable

● Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint for analysis and presentation

● Strong ability to lead by example and demonstrate proficiency in both product and domain.

● Patient listener with the ability clearly articulate your viewpoint to manage and deliver to customer expectations, even under pressure

● Ability to analyze and process large amounts of data and complement it with intuition to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is key.

● Ability to simplify complexity

● Good to have certifications in retail planning, supply chain planning, TOGAF


More about us…

With its recent Unicorn status, o9 Solutions is one of the fastest growing AI-powered digital transformation companies in the world today. Our high energy environment drives us to grow and aim 10x. It’s this drive that has made us leaders of Gartner’s S&OP Magic Quadrant.

The o9 platform, or “digital brain”, is the premier AI-powered, cloud-based platform behind the digital transformations of major global enterprises. These include Google, Walmart, and Starbucks, among others.

Our headquarters are located in Dallas, and we currently have offices in Amsterdam, Barcelona, Bangalore, Tokyo, and Seoul.

o9 is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of diverse backgrounds and hires without regard to race, colour, gender, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Material Coordinator
description:
Materials Coordinator III

Location: Fort McMurray

Position Type: 1 year contract

Schedule/Rotation:14/14 FIFO of Calgary or Edmonton

Position Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Materials Coordinator III to support inventory, procurement, and logistics activities while ensuring the timely delivery of materials in accordance with contractual requirements. The successful candidate will play a critical role in maintaining inventory accuracy, coordinating material movements, expediting orders, and supporting operational teams to ensure materials are available when and where they are needed.

This position requires a strong understanding of materials management, inventory control, and supply chain operations within an industrial environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities while collaborating with internal stakeholders and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the on-time delivery of materials in accordance with contract terms and operational requirements.
  • Monitor and provide updates on material status, open purchase orders, shipments, returns, and expediting activities.
  • Coordinate order schedules based on material lead times, project timelines, and delivery requirements.
  • Communicate material availability, order status, and potential delays to internal stakeholders and client groups.
  • Maintain the integrity and accuracy of inventory across multiple storage locations.
  • Perform and support daily, weekly, monthly, and annual inventory cycle counts and physical inventory audits.
  • Track repairs, material usage, and inventory requirements using spreadsheets and inventory management systems.
  • Forecast future material requirements based on production schedules, forecasts, and operational demands.
  • Collaborate closely with Supply Chain Buyers, warehouse personnel, and operations teams to execute material orders and deliveries.
  • Support inventory traceability initiatives and ensure data accuracy within inventory systems.
  • Receive, store, issue, and physically handle materials as required.
  • Safely lift and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and applicable industry regulations.


Qualifications

Required:

  • 5-7 years of experience in materials coordination, inventory management, warehouse operations, supply chain, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of materials management, procurement processes, inventory control, and logistics operations.
  • Experience managing inventory records, purchase orders, material tracking, and cycle count programs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and inventory management systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex inventory and material issues.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions within established guidelines.
  • Physical ability to lift and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting industrial, manufacturing, oil & gas, energy, mining, or heavy industrial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP or inventory management systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices and inventory optimization techniques.
  • Previous experience mentoring or providing guidance to less experienced team members.

Key Competencies

  • Materials Planning & Coordination
  • Inventory Management & Control
  • Purchase Order Tracking & Expediting
  • Supply Chain Operations
  • Warehousing & Logistics
  • Inventory Auditing & Cycle Counting
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Safety & Regulatory Compliance

Experience Level

This is an experienced-level position, typically requiring 5-7 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will be expected to apply advanced knowledge to complex material management challenges, develop practical recommendations, and serve as an informal resource to team members with less experience.

title: Site Planner
description:
Site Planner | Coventry | Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm | Office-based


We're looking for a Site Planner to join our team in Coventry. This is a key role at the heart of our operation, where you'll be responsible for coordinating production plans, managing stock levels and helping ensure our customers receive their orders on time.


You'll be working closely with colleagues across production, customer service, sales and procurement, so it's a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems and making a real impact on the day-to-day success of the business.


Construction Chemicals UK & Ireland is part of Saint-Gobain UK & Ireland, providing a broad range of innovative specialist materials and solutions for the construction industry, including concrete technologies, waterproofing systems, structural grouts, mortars and building materials.


What we're looking for:

  • Experience in a planning, production scheduling, supply chain or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across different teams.
  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and experience using ERP systems such as SAP.
  • A proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


What you will be doing:

  • Planning production schedules based on customer demand, forecasts and stock levels.
  • Managing raw material and finished goods inventory to ensure production requirements are met.
  • Working closely with sales, customer service and procurement teams to coordinate orders and deliveries.
  • Monitoring stock availability and communicating any supply or production challenges.
  • Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and contributing to the site's planning and operational performance.


Are Construction Chemicals UK & Ireland and Saint-Gobain inclusive employers?

Saint-Gobain is a worldwide leader in light and sustainable construction, following our purpose of Making the World a Better Home. We play a part in improving daily life through high-performance solutions. From wherever you are, let your unique personality and our values guide you every day to invent a more sustainable world.

We understand that a diverse workplace is not only a more enjoyable place to be, but also facilitates better decision making and innovation. So, whoever you are, and whichever Saint-Gobain business you join, you can be sure of a warm welcome with us.


And what about flexibility?

At Saint-Gobain, we're always open to new ways of working. Everyone has different needs and commitments. We'll happily discuss any need you might have for this role. Whilst we can't promise to meet every request when we're recruiting, we do promise to listen.

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL RESIDE WITHIN 25 MILES OF ANDERSON, IN**


As a Logistics Analyst, you will be responsible for managing customer data and ensuring freight is routed in the most cost-effective manner. You will be the primary advocate within the company for assigned customers to review transportation methods, cost, and optimization plans. You will work directly with the customer, their supplier base, and internally within Carter LOGISTEED to champion initiatives for that customer. You will need to anticipate and solve problems daily as well as provide effective communication with all necessary parties.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Design, optimize, and route our Shared Milkrun Network.
  • Identify and lead internal projects to reduce Carter LOGISTEED’s spend.
  • Analyze customer shipping data to drive improvement and obtain optimum effectiveness.
  • Build and review internal or customer key performance indicators, then act accordingly to drive efficiency.
  • Present analytical findings to the client or the Carter LOGISTEED executive team.
  • Maintain contact with customers to provide analysis and obtain feedback for improvement focus.
  • Collaborate closely with all Carter LOGISTEED departments to drive continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate and direct customer onboarding.
  • Drive new business through the RFQ process, building competitive, profitable bids for prospective clients.
  • Utilize evolving technologies such as Power BI and AI to improve reporting and internal processes.
  • Work Monday-Friday 8am-5pm.


EDUCATION:

Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a related field is required. In lieu of a degree, 3-5 years of similar work experience is acceptable.


EXPERIENCE:

Qualified candidates will possess excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to process data. Must have strong organizational skills along with excellent written and verbal communication abilities. Must be self-sufficient, self-motivated, and comfortable making data-driven decisions.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None


COMPUTER SKILLS:

Proficiency in Microsoft programs such as Word, Excel, and Outlook email required. Experience with Power BI and/or AI tools is preferred but not required. Must have the ability to learn new programs as necessary.


OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

Solid work ethic and willingness to successfully function with professionalism and a positive attitude in a team environment.


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Environment consists of 8-10 logistics analysts working alongside members of the continuous improvement team where daily collaboration is strongly encouraged. Furthermore, logistics analysts will conduct in-person meetings with members of the Carter LOGISTEED executive team. Our open-door policy allows for more interaction and the opportunity for your voice to be heard.

title: Analyst, Materials
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analyst, Materials based in the United States.

The Analyst, Materials will join a specialist research team focused on the semiconductor materials market, providing actionable intelligence to support industry and business decisions. The role will lead research, analysis, and demand forecasting across at least two specialty materials areas, such as advanced packaging, wet chemicals, CMP materials, wafers, or metal-organic precursors. Combining technical expertise with market insight, the analyst will develop robust forecasting models and validate findings through an established network of suppliers and chip manufacturers. They will translate complex industry developments and data into clear, engaging reports and market assessments. The position also involves custom research, client engagement, and collaboration across research and product teams. title: Supply Planning Specialist
description:
Company

Our client is a well-established international organisation with a complex supply chain network and a strong focus on reliable customer service, efficient production planning, and continuous improvement. The team works closely across markets, factories, and global supply chain functions to ensure supply plans are robust, data-driven, and executable.


Job Description

For our client’s Supply Planning team in Leeuwarden (Netherlands), we are looking for a Supply Planning Specialist to take ownership of the medium- and long-term supply planning cycle. The role focuses on translating demand into practical production and material plans, balancing inventory and capacity constraints, and ensuring the right products and materials are available at the right time.


Responsibilities

- Own and lead the rolling medium- to long-term supply planning cycle (up to 18 months)

- Translate demand into an executable supply plan, aligning production, materials, inventory, and capacity

- Build and maintain production plans and material requirement plans for the planning horizon

- Set up and maintain production capacity and storage capacity plans

- Ensure availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods while optimising supply chain performance

- Balance customer service targets, inventory levels, production constraints, and material availability

- Identify supply risks, potential shortages, and capacity constraints early, and coordinate mitigation actions with stakeholders

- Support phase-in/phase-out activities for new and discontinued products from a planning perspective

- Monitor and manage key planning KPIs (e.g., stock cover, inventory levels, ageing stock, supply reliability)

- Provide visibility on risks, opportunities, and required decisions within the S&OP process

- Ensure data accuracy and system integrity in planning tools (ERP / advanced planning systems)

- Drive a structured, system-based planning approach and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives


Requirements

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or similar)

- Relevant experience in supply planning, production planning, or material planning

- Solid understanding of inventory, capacity planning, and S&OP ways of working

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Experience working with ERP and/or advanced planning systems (SAP and/or OMP is a plus)

- Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working cross-functionally and internationally

- Proactive mindset and able to take ownership from issue identification through resolution

- Fluent in English (Dutch is a plus)


Other Information

The role is based in Leeuwarden, Netherlands, with a collaborative working environment and regular on-site presence (typically several days per week).

C&P Analyst Roles & Responsibilities

Supplier Management

  • Submit requests to Finance to set up and/or update Business Associate (BA) records as required, including branch BA’s
  • Upon approval from full time analyst.
  • Coordinates Supplier qualification process including:
  • Prequalification: confirm ISN status of suppliers and support set up (ie. connecting company to the supplier) and/or update of ISN records as required
  • Qualification: scope-specific requirements including but not limited to that of technical specifics, financial health, detailed H&S and quality requirements, etc
  • Work with Finance to ensure suppliers’ payment information has been set up and/or updated
  • Ongoing supplier relationship management:
  • Managing issues that may arise with the supplier including dispute resolution
  • Facilitating onboarding sessions and training for receiving/invoicing process in collaboration with other internal stakeholders (eg. Finance/Accounts Payable, Health & Safety, etc.)
  • Coordinating and documenting scorecards for supplier performance as required


Contracting & Procurement (Pre-Award)

  • Manage end-to-end sourcing, contracting, and procurement process for services and materials, including the following:
  • Action Purchase Requisitions (PR) as they are approved in the system. Be a source of guidance should requestors have questions on creating PR’s.
  • Responsible for end-to-end RFx process including ensuring sourcing strategy documents (ex. Single source justification (SSJ), contracting strategies) and key aspects (evaluation criteria, bid lists, etc) are approved prior to commencing sourcing. This may involve supporting internal stakeholders in completing the associated forms and system entries and validating that all required information has been correctly completed
  • Complete evaluation, negotiation and contract award / execution (i.e. Master Agreements, Work Authorizations, Standalone Agreements, Purchase Orders) including resolving any exceptions to contract terms and conditions
  • Creation and management of system purchase documents (i.e. Purchase Orders and Release Orders), ensuring the correct purchase document types are being used and requirements are being communicated (eg. work order requirement for Release Orders)
  • Cross-functional support for opportunities identified and spearheaded by SCM Category Management


Contracting & Procurement (Post-Award)

  • Contract and PO revisions. Revisions should only be driven by contractual changes (ex. Scope, commercial and/or schedule). Revisions should not be done to correct coding or cost to reflect services/materials that have already been delivered or invoices that have been received.
  • Expediting delivery of PO services and materials including producing reports on delivery dates, communicating with suppliers to steward critical lead times, and proactively advising on risk mitigation options
  • Support receiving and invoicing functions on issues related to contractual terms and conditions, approved scope, and rate schedule discrepancies
  • Execute Contract and PO closeout requirements, including confirming closeout requirements have been met (eg. quality/completion of scope, document transfer, final invoice payment, holdback release, etc.)
  • Support contract audits


SCM Governance & Reporting

  • Complete and execute SCM Governance documents (eg. Supply Chain Plans (SCP), CAS (Contract Award Summary)/CAR (Contract Award Revision) forms)

  • Submission of Value Creation forms to SCM Governance. Clarification of Value Creation submissions as requested by SCM Governance.
  • Complete supplier rate and spend analytics with support from SCM Governance
  • Communicate SCM reporting requests from internal stakeholders to SCM Governance (eg. suppliers spend reports to support site budgeting)
  • Develop and manage Site Specific Plan
  • Support SCM Governance in completion of annual SCM Contracting & Procurement Plan


Miscellaneous

6-8 years of experience

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Axi operates across six global regions in one of the most targeted sectors for sophisticated cyber threats - fintech and online trading - where the integrity of client funds and financial systems carries real, immediate stakes. This role exists because the threat landscape has outgrown our current security engineering capacity, and we need someone who can close that gap with maturity and precision. You will own Axi's vulnerability management lifecycle, lead incident response, and embed secure-by-design thinking across cloud and infrastructure environments where the cost of a miss is measured in regulatory exposure and client trust.


Your EDGE Assignment/You Will:

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle across Axi's global infrastructure - from identification and risk-based prioritisation through to verified remediation and reporting.
  • Lead penetration testing engagements and red team exercises, translating findings into measurable reductions in Axi's attack surface with clear remediation ownership.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve security controls across cloud, network, and application environments, with Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Security, and Entra ID as core platforms.
  • Lead incident response from detection through to post-incident closure - owning investigation, containment, and the remediation actions that prevent recurrence.
  • Manage Axi's threat intelligence programme, converting emerging threat data into concrete defensive actions across the Microsoft security stack and beyond.
  • Ensure secure-by-design standards are embedded into engineering pipelines and infrastructure deployments, owning the standards themselves - not just advising on them.
  • Deliver a structured programme of security risk assessments across third-party integrations and internal systems, escalating and resolving findings within defined risk appetite thresholds.
  • Undertake any additional duties, projects and responsibilities as reasonably assigned to support evolving business and operational requirements.


Are you the one?:

  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience, with a career track that has progressed from SOC L2/L3 or security operations into engineering - you've moved from detecting threats to systematically eliminating the conditions that create them.
  • Deep working knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Purview, and Azure Security - not as a generalist observer but as someone who has configured, tuned, and operationalised these tools in production environments.
  • Proven experience managing IAM frameworks and Conditional Access policies at scale, with a clear understanding of how identity is the new perimeter in a distributed, cloud-first organisation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex security incident investigations from first alert through to root cause analysis and post-incident remediation.
  • Solid background in vulnerability management programmes and penetration testing engagements, including the ability to triage findings by exploitability and business impact - not just CVSS score.
  • Experience working in a regulated financial services or fintech environment is strongly preferred - you understand what it means when compliance and security obligations converge.
  • Proficiency in KQL for building detection logic and investigation queries within Sentinel is a strong plus, as is hands-on experience with threat hunting, IOC analysis, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Comfortable working autonomously across a globally distributed technology environment, making defensible risk decisions without waiting for a blueprint.
  • Precise and methodical under pressure - when an incident is live, you bring structure to chaos, not more noise.

title: Senior Vice President - Operations
description:
Farmers for Forests (F4F) is seeking a full-time employee for the Senior Vice President - Operations position to manage field operations in the organization. The Senior Vice President - Operations will be responsible for supporting the COO in managing the operations team and supporting the VPRC in field data collection. We are looking for someone with 3-6 years of experience in a similar role.


Position:


The Senior Vice President - Operations will be based in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and will be responsible for ensuring that F4F's field operations across Madhya Pradesh run smoothly and efficiently, with travel to field locations across the state as required. The day-to-day job will involve managing field teams, procurement, inventory management, quality implementation, SOP adherence, government relations, etc. There is significant travel involved in this position. We will only consider applicants able to travel or spend at least 70% of their time in field locations. You will also be working closely with local implementation partners and our government partners in district administrations and the forest department.


Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Operations Strategy & Scale: Lead the overall operations strategy and build systems that enable F4F to scale projects efficiently across geographies.
  • Team Building & Leadership: Build, mentor and lead a high-performing operations team with clear structures, KRAs, KPIs and accountability at every level.
  • End-to-End Operations: Oversee the complete project lifecycle, from planning and budgeting to implementation, monitoring, quality assurance and closure.
  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Lead relationships with key clients, donors, investors and implementation partners, ensuring timely delivery, satisfaction and resolution of escalations.
  • Budget & Cost Management: Drive effective budget planning, plan-versus-actual tracking and cost optimization to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets.
  • Procurement & Supply Chain: Oversee procurement strategy, vendor management, inventory and logistics to ensure timely availability of quality inputs at optimal costs.
  • Data & MIS Management: Establish robust data and MIS systems for tracking project progress, budgets, expenses, plantation, survival, inventory and team performance.
  • Process & SOP Development: Develop and continuously improve SOPs, systems and processes to ensure standardized, efficient and high-quality execution across projects.
  • Performance & Quality Management: Establish operational benchmarks and review project performance against targets, driving corrective actions to improve quality, productivity and outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Ensure seamless coordination between Operations, Finance, Procurement, Technology, Biodiversity, Carbon and Fundraising teams for effective project delivery.
  • Risk Management & Problem Solving: Identify operational risks and bottlenecks proactively and lead timely interventions, escalations and solutions to ensure business continuity.
  • Innovation & Operational Excellence: Identify technology-enabled and innovative operating models that improve productivity, reduce costs and strengthen F4F's ability to scale its impact.


Requirements:

  • Someone who is entrepreneurial, self-motivated and operates with a growth mindset.
  • Someone who doesn't give up easily-the work we do is full of challenges and requires a fair amount of out-of-the-box and jugaad thinking.
  • Someone who functions well in an unstructured, start-up environment.
  • Someone who is excited about building a company and a team.
  • Someone who is passionate about rural development, ecological restoration and fighting climate change.
  • Someone who enjoys working with a diverse set of people and managing large teams, and is collaborative.
  • Someone who is comfortable taking on all types of tasks (including the unglamorous and menial ones) and is humble, generous and kind.
  • Someone with an MBA (Operations, Agriculture, Rural Management).
  • Someone with 8-12 years of experience overall and with extensive experience working in rural India.
  • Someone who has valid driving licences for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers.
  • Someone who is willing to be based in Jabalpur and travel to field locations across Madhya Pradesh, as required by project and field operations.

title: Senior Demand & Merchandise Planner
description:
Make Your Mark as an Demand Planner at Storio group
About The Role
Storio Group produces millions of personalised photo products every year across brands like Photobox, Hofmann, and Albelli. Our business is highly seasonal and promotional, and planning is how we stay ahead of it. Everything we sell is made to order. We turn sales data and commercial insight into forecasts of sales, volume and ASP that give the business sales and margin visibility and drive stock and production capacity decisions across Europe.

As Senior Demand & Merchandise Planner, you will be a core Subject Matter Expert in our rapidly developing S&OP function. Reporting to the Head of Demand Planning, you will bridge top-line commercial forecasts with item-level operational reality. You will validate B2C category sales, volume and ASP forecasts, own the sub-category and item mix beneath them, establish B2B forecasting, and improve forecast phasing across our peak cycles. This is a high-impact role where you will build quality into our planning process and support commercial and operational readiness.

How You Embrace Curiosity Daily
Make your mark by taking on these core day-to-day responsibilities:

  • Validate and check Commercial & Marketing's monthly, weekly, and daily category top-line forecasts of sales, volume and ASP against run rates, promotional plans, and customer strategies
  • Challenge forecast assumptions constructively across key markets and products, including mix and ASP shifts, when inputs diverge from historical trends or operational reality
  • Own the detailed item planning process, splitting category forecasts into granular sub-category and item variant forecasts across sales, volume and ASP, providing item sales mix and margin visibility, and Operations with accurate production requirements
  • Decompose forecasts into their parts (baseline, commercial initiatives and new products), so each can be challenged and tracked
  • Drive continuous improvement in weekly and daily forecast phasing, reviewing and validating sales forecasts against promotional mechanics, seasonal uplift spikes, and Last Order Dates for key gifting events
  • Build pragmatic models and tools that help forecast owners submit higher-quality phasing inputs
  • Take end-to-end ownership of forecasting for B2B vendors, integrating these streams into the central S&OP process

How You Make Your Mark
In this role, you will deliver real impact across our commercial and supply chain objectives

  • Support robust commercial consensus by bringing planning expertise to cross-functional partners
  • Validate and check promotional phasing directly to Last Order Dates to improve peak season operational readiness
  • Provide sales, volume, ASP and margin visibility through accurate, granular item forecasts aligned to category forecasts from Commercial & Marketing
  • Close unforecasted blind spots by building baseline forecasts for B2B channels
  • Prepare variance analysis and scenario reporting packs for monthly demand review meetings
  • Partner with Supply Planning so item-level forecast changes translate smoothly into capacity planning
  • Identify opportunities to refine planning spreadsheets and models to remove manual friction and improve data integrity

What You Bring To The Team
  • Demand Planning, Merchandise Planning or Merchandising experience in a fast-paced environment like Retail, E-Commerce or FMCG
  • Experience forecasting sales value and ASP, not just volume, and using category and product mix to give margin visibility
  • Proven track record of managing item-level planning, category and product mix modelling, and promotional uplift analysis
  • Hands-on experience challenging commercial, trading or marketing teams on forecast assumptions using clear data
  • Advanced MS Excel or Google Sheets data modelling skills with complex multi-category and multi-country datasets
  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to manage defined processes independently
  • Practical problem-solving approach that favours workable tools over complex theoretical models

What Sets You Apart
  • Career experience with exposure to adjacent functions like Supply Planning, Trading, Marketing, or Finance
  • Background in seasonal, promotion-led, high-volume direct-to-consumer or multi-market businesses, along with experience using Demand or Merchandise Planning systems
  • Relevant formal education or degree in business, supply chain, or a related analytical field

Why Storio?
You will join a function that is investing in its planning capability and has the scale to make your work genuinely matter — millions of orders, dozens of markets, seasonal peaks that test every part of the supply chain. You will have a clear scope, a supportive manager, and real opportunity to grow your expertise within a business that takes supply chain seriously.

No two months look the same.

If you want to build your demand planning career in a business where accuracy has real consequences and planning as a concept is step-changing every year, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us
At Storio Group, we help people hold onto life's moments. We make personalised photo products that turn fleeting memories into things you can keep, share, and re-live.

Every person at Storio Group helps create our products and shape our company. You will see the impact of your work daily. We invite you to make your mark on our business, products, and customers' lives.

We act with heart by putting people first and valuing diverse perspectives. We give our best and aim for high standards in all we do. We own our work, taking initiative to find solutions. We embrace curiosity, always learning and trying new things. We find the joy in our work and create a positive environment.

Equal Opportunities & Right to Work

Storio Group is an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and fostering an inclusive environment. If you require reasonable adjustments during interviews please contact our HR team.

Applicants must also have the legal right to work in the position's country without requiring sponsorship.

title: Production Planner
description:
Senior Production Planner


Company: DART Aerospace

Department: Production / Planning

Reports to: Master Planner

Location: Kirkland, Montreal, QC – 100% On-site

Experience: 8–10 years

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Languages: Fluent French & English – Mandatory


About DART Aerospace


DART Aerospace is a global aerospace manufacturer specializing in mission-critical equipment, aftermarket solutions, and certified products for the helicopter and aerospace industries.


With more than 1,100 Supplemental Type Certificates (STCs) and over 5,000 products distributed worldwide, DART supports civil, military, firefighting, utility, law enforcement, EMS, OEM, and other aerospace customers across more than 120 countries.


Our Kirkland facility supports specialized aerospace manufacturing activities, including aerial firefighting equipment, mission-critical systems, and technically regulated aerospace programs.

The Opportunity


We are seeking an experienced and highly autonomous Senior Production Planner to support production planning, scheduling, and operational execution at our Kirkland manufacturing facility.


Reporting to the Master Planner, you will play a critical role in translating the master production schedule into realistic, executable production plans while proactively identifying material shortages, capacity constraints, scheduling conflicts, and delivery risks.


This position requires a senior-level manufacturing professional with a strong understanding of production operations, ERP/MRP systems, material planning, and cross-functional coordination.


You will be expected to take ownership of production priorities, anticipate operational challenges, recommend practical solutions, and drive continuous improvement in planning processes.


We are looking for someone who brings more than scheduling experience: a seasoned planner who understands manufacturing realities, can make informed decisions under pressure, and takes accountability for production execution.


Key Responsibilities

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Independently manage daily and weekly production planning activities in alignment with the master production schedule.
  • Create, release, monitor, and close production jobs and work orders in Plex ERP.
  • Establish and adjust production priorities based on customer demand, material availability, manufacturing capacity, and operational constraints.
  • Analyze production schedules to anticipate bottlenecks, shortages, and potential delivery delays.
  • Monitor work-in-progress (WIP), production output, and order completion against established schedules.
  • Develop and recommend recovery plans when production falls behind schedule.
  • Coordinate competing priorities across multiple production lines, work orders, and departments.
  • Provide accurate production status updates, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations to the Master Planner.


Manufacturing Execution & Operational Coordination

  • Act as a key planning partner to Production Supervisors and shop-floor teams.
  • Maintain strong visibility into manufacturing activities, production constraints, and operational priorities.
  • Proactively address scheduling disruptions caused by material shortages, quality issues, labor constraints, or equipment availability.
  • Coordinate with Production, Purchasing, Quality, Engineering, and Warehouse teams to resolve operational issues.
  • Support production ramp-up activities and changing manufacturing requirements.
  • Ensure production commitments remain realistic and aligned with available capacity and resources.


Material Planning & Readiness

  • Review material requirements against production demand and scheduled work orders.
  • Ensure availability of raw materials, components, and production kits before releasing jobs.
  • Identify and anticipate material shortages that could impact production schedules.
  • Collaborate closely with Purchasing and Warehouse teams to improve material readiness and reduce production interruptions.
  • Coordinate with Quality Control regarding inspection status, quarantined materials, and release requirements.
  • Support First Article Inspection (FAI) readiness and production-related material staging.


ERP, MRP & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate production planning information in Plex ERP.
  • Analyze production orders, material consumption, labor reporting, and job completion data.
  • Ensure accurate work order transactions, job closure, and variance reconciliation.
  • Review and maintain planning parameters, including lead times, lot sizes, and production quantities.
  • Use ERP reporting and advanced Excel tools to identify trends, evaluate risks, and support operational decisions.
  • Ensure data accuracy, planning discipline, and strong transactional controls.


Process Improvement & Planning Optimization

  • Identify opportunities to improve production scheduling, material flow, and planning efficiency.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to planning processes and ERP utilization.
  • Support the development of planning KPIs, reporting tools, and operational performance indicators.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on schedule adherence, productivity, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery.
  • Share planning expertise and best practices with operational stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance and technical support on complex planning issues.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in production planning, manufacturing scheduling, materials planning, or manufacturing operations.
  • Proven senior-level experience in a manufacturing environment, with responsibility for complex production schedules and operational priorities.
  • Fluent bilingual communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken – mandatory.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems. Plex is preferred; SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms are acceptable.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of MRP principles, Bills of Materials (BOMs), work orders, inventory management, and production scheduling.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage material shortages, capacity constraints, production delays, and competing priorities.
  • Experience coordinating production activities across multiple departments.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate manufacturing data into actionable decisions.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and proactively resolve operational issues.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Comfortable working directly with shop-floor teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.


Strong Assets

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, medical devices, or another regulated manufacturing industry.
  • Experience in high-mix / low-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Previous involvement in production ramp-up, manufacturing transfers, or operational expansion.
  • Advanced knowledge of multi-level BOMs and complex material requirements.
  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings and technical manufacturing documentation.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing capacity planning and production sequencing.
  • Experience with Power Query, Power BI, or advanced planning analytics.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, or production optimization methodologies.
  • APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.


The Senior Profile We're Looking For


You are an experienced manufacturing planner who understands that successful production planning requires more than maintaining schedules.


You anticipate issues before they affect production, understand the relationship between materials, capacity, quality, and delivery commitments, and know how to prioritize effectively in a changing manufacturing environment.


You are comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, making recommendations based on data, and working directly with operational teams to find practical solutions.


You bring:

  • Autonomy: You manage your responsibilities independently and require minimal supervision.
  • Manufacturing expertise: You understand production processes, material flows, and shop-floor realities.
  • Proactive problem-solving: You anticipate risks rather than simply reacting to them.
  • Strong decision-making: You can assess competing priorities and recommend effective solutions.
  • Accountability: You take ownership of planning accuracy, execution, and results.
  • Cross-functional leadership: You influence and coordinate stakeholders without necessarily having direct reports.
  • Continuous improvement mindset: You actively look for ways to improve planning performance and operational efficiency.


Compliance & Eligibility Requirements


Due to the nature of DART Aerospace's operations, including work involving controlled aerospace and defence programs, technical data, military-related products, and export-controlled information, this position is subject to applicable international trade compliance and export-control requirements.


For this specific position, candidates must be Canadian citizens in order to meet the required access and compliance requirements.


Eligibility will be verified as part of the recruitment and onboarding process in accordance with applicable DART Aerospace policies and regulatory requirements.


Why Join DART Aerospace?

  • Join a global aerospace manufacturer supporting mission-critical operations worldwide.
  • Play an important role in supporting production growth and operational performance at our Kirkland facility.
  • Work closely with experienced manufacturing and supply chain professionals.
  • Contribute directly to production efficiency, manufacturing reliability, and customer delivery performance.
  • Bring your expertise to a hands-on, technically demanding aerospace environment.


Ready to take ownership of complex production planning challenges?

title: Frozen Food Manager
description:

ITOMMEY Group is backed by experienced professionals, robust technologies, and deep expertise in IT digital architecture and processes. Team members contribute to solutions that strengthen clients’ IT capabilities and readiness for ongoing digital transformation.


IT Engineer Level 0 (IT Service Desk)

Location: On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Working Arrangement: 3 Shift 24/7


About the Role


We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented IT Engineer L0 to join our IT Service Desk team. In this role, you will serve as the first point of contact for IT-related incidents, service requests, and inquiries while ensuring the stability and availability of mission-critical applications. You will work in a 24/7 operational environment, providing first-level support, monitoring applications, and escalating issues when necessary.


Key Responsibilities


Provide first-level IT support for incidents, service requests, and inquiries from internal and external users.

Perform daily operational tasks, including application support and helpdesk activities.

Monitor applications and operational systems to ensure service availability.

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve basic application-related issues.

Escalate incidents requiring further investigation to IT Engineer Level 1 while ensuring complete documentation.

Monitor and manage trouble tickets in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Maintain a minimum ticket resolution performance target of 99.9%.

Record, update, and maintain incident and service request documentation within the ticketing system.

Collaborate effectively with internal teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

Follow operational procedures, security standards, and escalation processes.

Perform all assigned tasks under the supervision of the APS Group IT Service Desk team.

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma (D3/S1) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

Up to 1 years of experience in IT Helpdesk, IT Service Desk, Technical Support, Application Support, or IT Operations is preferred.

Basic understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes.

Knowledge of Incident Management and Service Request Management.

Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.

Basic understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).

Familiarity with application monitoring and system operations.

Basic troubleshooting skills for applications and IT infrastructure.

Experience with IT ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Remedy, Freshservice, or similar) is an advantage.

Basic SQL knowledge and understanding of client-server architecture are considered a plus.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Customer service-oriented mindset.

Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced operational environment.

Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

Good documentation and reporting skills.

High level of responsibility, discipline, and attention to detail.

Willing to work shift schedule.

Willing to work weekends and public holidays as required.

Able to work on-site.

Physically fit to work in a shift-based operational environment.

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
Logistics Analyst

Location: Westerville, Ohio
Work arrangement: Onsite, five days per week


Position Overview

A growing global organization is seeking a Logistics Analyst to support its international transportation operations. This newly created position will focus on carrier performance, transportation analytics, TMS data, and continuous improvement across a high-volume logistics network.
The Logistics Analyst will work closely with carriers, logistics providers, and internal teams to improve freight visibility, service levels, costs, and overall transportation performance. The ideal candidate has worked directly within a shipper's transportation organization and understands how to turn logistics data into actionable recommendations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support and optimize the lead logistics provider model across the Americas.
  • Manage relationships and performance expectations with carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers.
  • Analyze freight spend, carrier performance, service levels, transit times, and on-time delivery.
  • Develop and monitor transportation KPIs and carrier scorecards.
  • Use TMS data to identify service issues, trends, exceptions, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain transportation data accuracy and support data flow between systems.
  • Build reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to resolve transportation issues and improve shipment visibility.
  • Map current and future transportation processes using Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools.
  • Recommend improvements related to cost, service, carrier performance, reporting, and process efficiency.
  • Support both international and domestic inbound transportation initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of transportation, logistics, or supply-chain experience.
  • Previous transportation experience directly within a manufacturer, distributor, retailer, or other shipper organization.
  • International shipping experience, with meaningful exposure to air freight.
  • Hands-on experience using a transportation management system.
  • Experience managing or evaluating carriers, freight forwarders, 3PLs, 4PLs, or lead logistics providers.
  • Ability to analyze transportation data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Proficiency with Excel and transportation reporting.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work onsite five days per week in Westerville.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Power BI experience.
  • Oracle TMS or Oracle ERP experience.
  • Kinaxis experience.
  • Ocean-freight experience.
  • Experience supporting shipments across APAC or EMEA.
  • Experience managing a lead logistics provider or 4PL relationship.
  • Process-mapping experience using Visio or Lucidchart.
  • Exposure to AI, reporting automation, or logistics workflow automation.
  • Spanish-language skills.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be curious, proactive, and comfortable working without a fully established playbook. This person should take ownership of problems, ask thoughtful questions, identify improvement opportunities, and build practical solutions rather than waiting for detailed direction.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Join a growing organization with a large, complex transportation network.
  • Gain broad exposure to international freight, carrier management, TMS operations, and transportation analytics.
  • Take on meaningful responsibility and visibility early.
  • Help shape a newly created role and improve logistics processes.
  • Work in an environment where initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement are valued.

title: Planning & Order Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing Chinese premium automotive and EV brand building our European after-sales organisation from the ground up and now looking for a Spare parts Planning & Order Specialist.

This is a hands-on planning and order-management role. You will own spare-parts demand planning, distributor order processing and the commercial side of the spare-parts flow for European markets. You will work closely with the Spare Parts Supply Chain Supervisor and Chinese colleagues on site to keep fill rates healthy, reduce order and tax risks, and support reliable parts supply to distributors.


What you will do

  • Gather demand from European distributors, analyse historical consumption and propose safety-stock levels and replenishment orders to the China procurement team.
  • Process and manage distributor spare-parts orders end-to-end (including the early manual phase): create, check and approve orders, maintain master data, and communicate lead times, back-orders and changes.
  • Support the integration between our internal system and the 3PL WMS; check data consistency and flag issues.
  • Act as the primary business contact for distributors on order status, claims, returns and supply updates.
  • Provide order, sales and cost data to finance and tax teams for VAT and cross-border accounting; flag anomalies.
  • Help identify and reduce slow-moving and obsolete stock, and support inventory counts and reporting.


What we are looking for

  • Based within a workable commute of Amsterdam / Schiphol — this is a hybrid model of office (Amsterdam) and on site at 3PL spare parts warehouse (Schiphol-Rijk)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business Administration or similar.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in automotive spare-parts planning and B2B order management.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Dutch or German is a plus.
  • Strong Excel and practical experience with ERP / spare-parts systems; WMS integration experience is an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of EU cross-border trade and VAT.
  • Meticulous, organised and comfortable with high volumes of distributor communication.


What we offer

  • On-Target Earnings (base salary plus a 1-month performance-based On-Target bonus) in the range of €52,000 to €65,000 gross per year
  • Travel allowance.
  • Pension Plan
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays.
  • A hands-on role where you help build the European spare-parts operation of a growing premium brand.


A reference and background check will be part of the selection process.


WE WILL ONLY BE ACCEPTING APPLICATIONS FROM CANDIDATES, WITH AN UNRESTRICTED RIGHT TO WORK IN BENELUX.


About FAW Europe / Hongqi

FAW Europe is a subsidiary of the China FAW Group Corporation, which is one of the oldest and largest automotive manufacturers in China. Originally founded in 1953 as First Automotive Works, the corporation operates internationally to export and manufacture vehicles in over 70 countries. Ranging from heavy-duty and commercial trucks (through FAW Trucks) to municipal transit buses, construction machinery, and passenger cars. Flagship brands include JIEFANG (commercial trucks), BESTUNE (passenger cars) and HONGQI (high-end luxury vehicles; https://www.hongqi.nl).

Through various international subsidiaries, joint ventures and assembly plants, FAW has a massive presence outside of China, particularly across markets in Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. In addition to our own brands, FAW-Volkswagen and FAW Toyota are partnerships that build and sell vehicles within China and globally.

title: Global Transportation Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Global Transportation Analyst is responsible for managing and supporting international inbound transportation and domestic outbound transportation, with a strong focus on ocean container management, U.S. import compliance, transportation cost management, and carrier performance.


This position serves as a key point of contact for inbound ocean containers, customs clearance, HTS classification, freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and 3PL providers. The role is responsible for tracking international shipments from origin through final delivery, resolving transportation and customs issues, and ensuring imported products move efficiently and in compliance with U.S. Customs requirements.

The Global Transportation Analyst will also support domestic outbound transportation, carrier management, freight analysis, RFPs, cost-saving initiatives, and transportation KPI reporting.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Manage and track international inbound and domestic outbound shipments, including ocean containers, truckload, LTL, and other transportation modes.
  • Coordinate inbound international container shipments from factory/origin through ocean transit, port arrival, customs clearance, drayage, warehouse receipt, and final delivery.
  • Monitor container milestones, including booking, vessel departure, transshipment, arrival, customs clearance, port availability, last free day, drayage, and delivery.
  • Work closely with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, ocean carriers, drayage providers, domestic carriers, and 3PL partners.
  • Review and maintain accurate import documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other required customs documentation.
  • Maintain and support accurate HTS classification of imported products.
  • Support U.S. customs compliance activities, including HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, duties, tariffs, and applicable exclusions or trade programs.
  • Monitor changes in HTS codes, tariffs, duties, and U.S. trade regulations that could impact landed cost or supply continuity.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce freight, duties, tariffs, demurrage, detention, storage, accessorial, and transportation costs while maintaining compliance.
  • Maintain proactive communication regarding shipment status, delays, exceptions, and potential supply disruptions.
  • Manage relationships with international and domestic transportation providers.
  • Support and lead transportation RFPs, carrier negotiations, rate analysis, and carrier selection for inbound and outbound.
  • Analyze freight rates, routing options, and transportation modes to identify the most cost-effective solutions for inbound and outbound.
  • Establish and monitor transportation KPIs, including on-time performance, transit time, freight cost, container dwell time, accessorial charges, and carrier service performance.
  • Develop reporting and analysis around freight spend, landed cost, carrier performance, container activity, and transportation trends.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Strong understanding of international inbound and domestic outbound transportation operations.
  • Hands-on experience managing international ocean containers and U.S. imports.
  • Working knowledge of HTS tariff classification, U.S. Customs requirements, duties, tariffs, country of origin, customs valuation, and import documentation.
  • Experience working directly with customs brokers, freight forwarders, ocean carriers, drayage providers, domestic carriers, and 3PL providers.
  • Understanding of container shipping processes and terminology, including FCL/LCL, port operations, demurrage, detention, free time, drayage, and customs clearance.
  • Experience reviewing commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, customs entries, and related import documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify transportation cost-saving opportunities.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; proficiency in Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with ERP systems and transportation/shipment data.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across suppliers, carriers, brokers, warehouses, purchasing, planning, sales, and other internal teams.
  • Ability to independently manage shipment exceptions and resolve transportation and customs-related issues.
  • General negotiation and carrier-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly around customs documentation, HTS classifications, freight rates, and shipment data.


Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, International Business, or a related field; or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in transportation, international logistics, supply chain, customs compliance, or freight management.
  • Experience managing international containerized freight and U.S. imports strongly preferred.
  • Experience with HTS classification and U.S. Customs requirements strongly preferred.


Compensation Package

  • Strong benefits
  • Multiple medical plans including HSA availability with company contributions
  • Company paid disability & life insurance coverage
  • Generous 401k matching
  • Competitive pay
  • Casual atmosphere/dog-friendly environment

title: Inventory Analyst
description:

Chicken of the Sea is an iconic American brand that was founded in 1930. Today, Chicken of the Sea enjoys broad distribution across all major retail channels, with growth opportunities in foodservice and outside the U.S. Besides its eponymous brand, Chicken of the Sea also sells Genova and King Oscar premium seafood products.


Chicken of the Sea International (COSI) has been wholly owned since 2000 by Thai Union (TU), the largest global producer of ambient seafood. Chicken of the Sea Frozen Foods is a sister U.S. company that focuses on frozen and chilled seafood sales. Other iconic seafood brands in the TU Global portfolio include John West, Mareblu, and King Oscar. Under the leadership of CEO Thiraphong Chansiri, Thai Union has more than tripled its revenue to over $4 billion annually and has an aggressive growth agenda.


Chicken of the Sea International operates under the common corporate vision, mission and values of Thai Union, an industry leader in sustainable fishing practices and manufacturing processes that capture the freshness, nutritional value, and sensorial experience of seafood. The global organization lives by the 6 deeply held values: Passionate, Humble, Respectful, Responsible, Collaborative, and Innovative.


COSI is an organization that is very proud of its heritage. First established as VanCamp seafood company more than 100 years ago (1914), the company celebrates its story as one of the oldest food companies in the country that is still in operation. The company is currently undergoing a significant business transformation aimed at accelerating business growth.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimising production plans that balance customer demand, capacity, inventory, service levels, and cost in a fast-paced FMCG manufacturing environment.

Reporting to the Head of Supply Chain APAC and leading one direct report, you will play a key role in driving planning excellence, ensuring effective execution of production schedules, and supporting the ongoing development of planning capability within the team.

Working cross-functionally across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations, this role plays a critical part in ensuring uninterrupted supply, efficient use of resources, and minimal waste. What You’ll Do:

2. Demand, Supply & Inventory Coordination: Align production with demand forecasts, customer orders, and inventory targets by monitoring raw materials, WIP, and finished goods, while managing shelf-life and avoiding excess or obsolete stock.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration & S&OP: Partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Logistics, Sales, and Customer Service, contributing planning inputs to S&OP and providing clear production updates.

4. Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement: Track schedule adherence and key KPIs (DIFOT, production attainment, utilisation, inventory, waste), investigate variances, and drive improvements in planning accuracy and execution.

5. Systems & Planning Transformation: Support the transition from Excel-based planning to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central by designing, testing, and embedding automated planning, MRP, and scheduling processes.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description – Fullstack Developer (.NET)


Posisi: Fullstack Developer (.NET)

Departemen: Information Technology / Software Engineering

Tipe Pekerjaan: Full-Time

Level: Junior – Middle


Deskripsi Pekerjaan


Kami mencari Fullstack Developer .NET yang memiliki kemampuan dalam mengembangkan, mengimplementasikan, dan memelihara aplikasi berbasis web menggunakan teknologi Microsoft .NET.


Kandidat akan bertanggung jawab atas pengembangan aplikasi dari sisi frontend hingga backend, integrasi API, pengelolaan database, serta memastikan aplikasi berjalan dengan baik, aman, dan memiliki performa optimal.


Tanggung Jawab


1. Mengembangkan dan memelihara aplikasi web menggunakan C#, ASP.NET Core, dan .NET 8/9/10.

2. Membangun antarmuka pengguna yang responsif menggunakan Blazor, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, atau framework frontend lainnya.

3. Mengembangkan dan mengintegrasikan RESTful API untuk kebutuhan internal maupun pihak ketiga.

4. Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan database menggunakan SQL Server atau PostgreSQL.

5. Mengimplementasikan Entity Framework Core untuk akses dan pengelolaan data.

6. Menerapkan prinsip Clean Code, SOLID, dan Separation of Concerns.

7. Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, serta perbaikan bug pada aplikasi.

8. Mengimplementasikan autentikasi, otorisasi, validasi input, dan keamanan aplikasi sesuai prinsip OWASP.

9. Menggunakan Git untuk version control dan kolaborasi pengembangan.

10. Melakukan monitoring, logging, serta optimasi performa aplikasi.


Kualifikasi


1. Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, bidang terkait, atau pengalaman profesional yang setara.

2. Memahami bahasa pemrograman C# dan ekosistem .NET.

3. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan ASP.NET Core, MVC, Web API, atau Blazor.

4. Menguasai HTML, CSS, JavaScript, dan responsive web design.

5. Memahami database SQL Server atau PostgreSQL.

6. Memiliki pengetahuan menggunakan Entity Framework atau Entity Framework Core.

7. Memahami konsep REST API, JSON, dan integrasi sistem.

8. Memahami Git dan workflow pengembangan aplikasi.

9. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan debugging yang baik.

10. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.


Nilai Tambah


1. Berpengalaman menggunakan .NET 10 dan Blazor Web App.

2. Memahami arsitektur aplikasi N-Tier.

3. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan Docker dan Linux Ubuntu Server.

4. Memahami konfigurasi Nginx sebagai reverse proxy.

5. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan GitHub Actions atau Azure DevOps.

6. Memahami implementasi JWT, OAuth 2.0, dan Role-Based Access Control.

3. Database Management: Mampu merancang struktur database dan mengoptimalkan query.

4. Code Quality: Menghasilkan kode yang bersih, dapat diuji, dan mudah dikembangkan.

6. Collaboration: Mampu bekerja sama dengan tim dan memahami kebutuhan bisnis.


Indikator Keberhasilan (KPI)

5. Dokumentasi teknis yang lengkap dan diperbarui secara berkala.

title: Vice President - Operations
description:
Farmers for Forests (F4F) is seeking a full-time employee for the Vice President - Operations position to manage field operations in the organization. The VPO will be responsible for supporting the COO in managing the operations team and supporting the VPRC in field data collection. We are looking for someone with 3-6 years of experience in a similar role.


Position:


The Vice President - Operations will be based in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and will be responsible for ensuring that F4F's field operations across Madhya Pradesh run smoothly and efficiently, with travel to field locations across the state as required. The day-to-day job will involve managing field teams, procurement, inventory management, quality implementation, SOP adherence, government relations, etc. There is significant travel involved in this position. We will only consider applicants able to travel or spend at least 70% of their time in field locations. You will also be working closely with local implementation partners and our government partners in district administrations and the forest department.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Project Budgeting: Prepare block-wise project budgets for agroforestry implementation, ensuring alignment with project scope, targets and available resources.
  • Plan vs. Actual Tracking: Monitor project progress and budgets against planned targets, identifying deviations and ensuring timely corrective actions.
  • Quality & SOP Compliance: Ensure field implementation is carried out as per defined SOPs, quality standards and project-specific requirements.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the key coordination point between donors, investors, operations, field and technology teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Expense Management: Track project expenses end-to-end against approved donor budgets, ensuring effective utilization and timely reporting of variances.
  • Team Performance & Reviews: Conduct regular team reviews to assess progress, identify operational bottlenecks and drive timely solutions and corrective actions.
  • Procurement & Inventory: Ensure timely procurement, availability and distribution of project inputs while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and controls.
  • Vendor Management: Coordinate with vendors for quotations, agreements, invoices, documentation, payments and timely delivery of project requirements.
  • Implementation Partner Management: Coordinate with implementation partners and field agencies to ensure adherence to project timelines, quality standards and agreed deliverables.
  • Field & Project Monitoring: Conduct regular field reviews and audits to assess plantation progress, farmer engagement, survival rates and overall project performance.
  • Project Reporting & Escalation: Consolidate operational updates, highlight key risks and deviations to senior management, and ensure timely project reporting to internal and external stakeholders.


Requirements:

  • Someone who is entrepreneurial, self-motivated and operates with a growth mindset.
  • Someone who doesn't give up easily-the work we do is full of challenges and requires a fair amount of out-of-the-box and jugaad thinking.
  • Someone who functions well in an unstructured, start-up environment.
  • Someone who is excited about building a company and a team.
  • Someone who is passionate about rural development, ecological restoration and fighting climate change.
  • Someone who enjoys working with a diverse set of people and managing large teams, and is collaborative.
  • Someone who is comfortable taking on all types of tasks (including the unglamorous and menial ones) and is humble, generous and kind.
  • Someone with an MBA (Operations, Agriculture, Rural Management).
  • Someone with 5-8 years of experience overall and with extensive experience working in rural India.
  • Someone who has valid driving licences for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers.
  • Someone who is willing to be based in Jabalpur and travel to field locations across Madhya Pradesh, as required by project and field operations.

title: Stock Control Analyst
description:
Who are we?

You've probably seen our work without even realising it!

Bauer Media Outdoor is behind many of the adverts, bus shelters and digital screens you see every day, from busy high streets and shopping centres to roads, transport hubs and local neighbourhoods.

We're one of the UK's leading Out of Home media and infrastructure companies, operating more than 33,000 sites nationwide and looking after nearly 22,000 bus shelters. With teams across the UK, we combine advertising with the delivery and maintenance of public infrastructure that communities rely on every day.

We're part of Bauer Media Group, one of the world's largest privately owned media groups, with a rich heritage in media and a commitment to developing our people.

About The Role

We are looking for an organised and analytical Service Parts & Inventory Analyst to take ownership of our digital screen buffer stock across the UK and Europe. Working within BMOT, our manufacturing depot who are responsible for designing and producing our digital advertising screens, you ‘ll play an important role in maintaining stock availability and ensuring service uptime.

You will manage stock levels, ordering, replenishment, demand planning, returns and reporting across multiple product groups and locations. Working closely with Depots, Operations, Production, Procurement and external suppliers, you'll ensure stock is available when needed, identify potential shortages and proactively resolve supply issues.

What will I be doing?

  • Take ownership of digital screen buffer stock across UK and European locations, ensuring accurate stock records, reconciliations and availability
  • Manage stock requests, purchase orders, ordering and replenishment, ensuring requests are processed and dispatched on time
  • Work closely with Production and Repairs to forecast demand, manage production and supplier lead times and maintain a reliable delivery pipeline
  • Monitor stock levels, identify potential shortages and proactively manage replenishment to avoid disruption to service
  • Coordinate returns, repairs and stock movements across internal teams, depots and external suppliers
  • Produce monthly stock reports and KPI updates, working with depots to ensure stock records are accurate and fully reconciled
  • Investigate discrepancies, chase outstanding information and purchase orders, and escalate issues to ensure timely resolution
  • Support the introduction of new and inherited product ranges, helping establish stock requirements and processes as the role develops

What We're Looking For

  • At least 2 years' experience in stock management, inventory control or supply chain, ideally within a manufacturing environment
  • Experience managing stock across multiple locations, including stock reconciliations and reporting, preferably within UK and European operations
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent Excel and spreadsheet knowledge
  • Experience using ERP or stock management systems, ideally Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics or a similar inventory management platform
  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes, production lead times, replenishment and returns
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across different teams, locations and cultures
  • A proactive problem-solver with strong decision-making skills and the confidence to chase outstanding actions through to completion
  • Highly organised, detail-focused and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

What's in it for you?

  • £32,000 per annum + bonus
  • 25 days plus bank holidays
  • This role is Monday to Friday 8am - 4pm, with Fridays worked from home
  • Standard workplace pension - matched at 5%
  • Full Private Medical Cover
  • Employee Assistant Programme
  • Free parking with electric charging points
  • Social events and activities

If this sounds like to job for you, why not apply today!

At Bauer Media Outdoor, we are committed to treating everyone with fairness and respect, regardless of their race, gender, age, ethnicity, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other differences. We work hard to foster an inclusive environment, a place you can be yourself. We support reasonable adjustment requests from candidates and employees.
