title: Inventory Analyst
description:
Evermark is a newly formed beauty and personal care company bringing together a portfolio of iconic, everyday brands with enormous reach and untapped potential: Suave, ChapStick, Q-tips, Caress, St. Ives, TIGI Bed Head, Noxzema, Pond’s, Lever 2000. These are brands people know, trust, and use daily - and we are building their next chapter.


Backed by a growth-oriented YellowWood Partners, we operate with speed, focus, and accountability. Our goal is simple: modernize these brands, accelerate growth, and build a company that consistently outperforms expectations. That means sharpening strategy, raising the bar on execution, and making smart, decisive moves across the enterprise - from how we plan and operate to how we go to market.


This is a company in motion. We are scaling quickly, building new capabilities, and creating the operating model as we go. For the right people, that means rare access, real influence, and the opportunity to help shape not just a role, but a company.


Position Summary:

The Inventory Analyst is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing finished goods inventory across the distribution network and collaborating with customer service on inventory allocation. This role ensures accurate inventory shipping & receiving records are maintained across suppliers and 3PLs ensuring high service levels while balancing inventory investment, cost, and operational constraints. Working closely with Planning, Logistics, and Customer teams, the Inventory Analyst helps anticipate risks, identify inventory imbalances, and supports consistent service performance as the distribution network matures. Position ensures inventory is reconciled across 3PL WMS inventory systems and internal Business Central ERP inventory records.


Core Responsibilities:

Replenishment, Inventory & Network Flow

  • Build and manage dashboards to assess inventory positions, allocation, and precut process and ensures inventory record accuracy across 3PLs and internal ERP systems.
  • Manage inventory variances and reconciliation with 3PLs and suppliers and proactively communicates variances and works with planning team on PO updates/changes
  • Receives inventory into ERP and verifies quantities and processes supplier invoices for payment
  • Audits cycle count reporting with 3PLs and audits receiving and shipping records

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Coordinate with Manufacturing, co-packers, Logistics, and DC Operations to align supply plans with warehouse and transportation capacity
  • Recommend customer replenishment strategy changes to drive case pick to full layer and pallet pick volumes with customer service and sales teams
  • Support customer supply teams with allocation decisions and service issue resolution
  • Support peak and seasonal planning to ensure network readiness – space planning

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive EDI integrations for ASNs to improve inventory accuracy and enhanced 3PL reporting and automation with 3PLs and IT team
  • Identify opportunities to improve stock slotting with 3PL partners to improve warehouse productivity performance through detailed analysis.


Primary Requirements:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in distribution planning, logistics, or inventory management
  • Experience in CPG, food & beverage, or consumer goods
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with imperfect data
  • Experience w/Kinaxis and/or MS Business Central and Korber WMS preferred
  • Ability to prioritize, make judgment calls, and move fast
  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, finance, or business-related field.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments and with external suppliers.


People Who Thrive Here

We look for people who take ownership, move with urgency, and care deeply about results.


Across every level and function, success here comes from thinking like an operator, not waiting to be told what to do but seeing what needs to happen and driving it forward. The individual must be comfortable working across teams, influencing without hierarchy, and making progress even when the path isn't perfectly defined.


This is a fast-moving environment with high standards and real accountability. In return, you'll have meaningful responsibility, autonomy to lead your work, and the opportunity to grow alongside brands, and a company, that are being actively shaped.

title: Senior Material Planner
description:
We are looking to add a Senior Material Planner to our growing team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about supporting new product development and manufacturing for an exciting product line of satellite communications equipment, we would like to hear from you.

In this position, you will support production and supply planning activities by developing material strategies, balancing supply and demand requirements, and coordinating material availability to support manufacturing schedules and customer commitments. This role contributes to operational performance by optimizing inventory levels, mitigating material risks, and improving planning processes that support efficient supply chain execution.

Working cross-functionally with supply chain, operations, engineering, program management, manufacturing, quality, and finance, this role supports production planning, material planning, inventory management, and supply chain execution while ensuring material availability aligns with production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated material plans that support production schedules, inventory objectives, and customer delivery requirements.
  • Analyze material requirements, inventory levels, demand forecasts, and supply commitments to ensure material availability.
  • Evaluate inventory performance and implement corrective actions to resolve shortages, excess inventory, and material constraints.
  • Support planning activities associated with new product introductions, engineering changes, production transitions, and demand fluctuations.
  • Coordinate with operations and manufacturing to support production schedules and material readiness.
  • Evaluate supply and demand requirements while identifying material constraints and recommending recovery plans.
  • Support execution of production planning, inventory replenishment, and material allocation activities.
  • Maintain planning parameters and material planning data within ERP and MRP systems.
  • Coordinate with supply chain, engineering, program management, manufacturing, quality, and finance to support material planning objectives.
  • Communicate material shortages, schedule impacts, supply risks, and recovery plans to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and supply chain personnel to resolve material availability issues and improve supplier performance.
  • Maintain planning documentation, reports, and material status updates.
  • Drive implementation of planning process improvements and operational initiatives.
  • Build productive working relationships with supply chain, operations, engineering, program management, manufacturing, quality, and finance.
  • Maintain planning documentation, planning parameters, inventory records, and performance metrics.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of planning processes, inventory performance, and supply chain execution.

Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of material planning, production planning, inventory management, and supply chain principles.
  • Understanding of material requirements planning (MRP), demand planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and supply planning methodologies.
  • Experience utilizing ERP systems, MRP systems, inventory planning processes, and business reporting tools.
  • Demonstrates analytical thinking with the ability to evaluate inventory performance, material requirements, production demand, and supply risks.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple planning priorities, schedules, and material requirements.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills with supply chain, operations, engineering, program management, manufacturing, quality, and finance.
  • Attention to detail when maintaining planning data, inventory records, and material requirements.
  • Applies strategic thinking to improve planning effectiveness, inventory performance, and supply chain execution.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, such as Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or equivalent platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and supply planning systems.
  • Experience with business intelligence, data visualization, and reporting tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent applications.

title: Purchaser
description:
About District Mechanical

Are you a purchasing professional who wants to be more than an order-taker and play a real role in delivering landmark projects? District Mechanical is looking for a Purchaser ready to take ownership of procurement for our projects, and to grow alongside a company where your work is seen and valued.

District Mechanical is an employee-owned mechanical contracting company based in Edmonton, Alberta, delivering complex institutional, commercial, healthcare, industrial and large-scale residential projects across the province, with significant opportunities for continued growth. This is an opportunity to join a hands-on, entrepreneurial environment where initiative is valued, ideas are welcomed, and individual contributions make a meaningful impact.


Working closely with project managers, site teams, vendors and our fabrication facility, you will be the go-to person for getting the right materials, equipment, tools and services to the right place at the right time. Along the way, you will gain exposure to the operational and financial side of how a growing mechanical contractor delivers its work.


Who You Are

You are a purchasing or procurement professional with 3+ years of experience, ideally in construction, mechanical contracting, plumbing, HVAC or industrial environments. You understand construction materials and procurement processes, and you know that a late delivery or a wrong part can hold up a whole crew. You take pride in getting it right, from the quote to the purchase order to the delivery on site.

You are organized and detail-oriented but also see the bigger picture. You can juggle multiple projects and priorities at once, you look for better pricing and smarter ways to source, and you build strong relationships with suppliers and manufacturers. You are a confident negotiator and a clear communicator, comfortable working with everyone from site personnel to project managers.

Most importantly, you take ownership of your work and are interested in building a long-term career with a company where your growth can align with the growth of the business.


Key Responsibilities

This role will evolve based on your experience, strengths, and career objectives. As part of the operations team, you will be accountable for:


Procurement and Supplier Management

  • Sourcing and Procurement: Source and procure mechanical materials, equipment, tools and services for construction projects.
  • Quotations and Evaluation: Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations to ensure best value, availability and delivery schedules.
  • Purchase Orders: Issue purchase orders and track order status through to delivery.
  • Supplier Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and manufacturers.
  • Cost Savings: Identify cost-saving opportunities and alternative procurement strategies.


Project and Operations Support

  • Delivery Coordination: Coordinate material deliveries with project teams and site personnel.
  • Inventory and Prefabrication Support: Monitor inventory levels and support warehouse and prefabrication operations.
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve purchase order discrepancies, delivery issues and supplier concerns.
  • Budgeting and Planning: Support project managers with budgeting, forecasting and material planning.
  • Records and Documentation: Maintain accurate purchasing records and procurement documentation.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in construction, mechanical contracting, plumbing, HVAC or industrial environments.
  • A strong understanding of construction materials and procurement processes.
  • Knowledge of mechanical construction materials and equipment is highly desirable.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with suppliers, site teams and project managers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with ERP, project management or purchasing software considered an asset.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the initiative to identify opportunities and take ownership of responsibilities.


Why Join District Mechanical?

  • A career, not just a job. This is an opportunity to build your career with an employee-owned company that offers the potential for long-term growth and advancement.
  • Real ownership of your work. Be a key part of project delivery, with the trust and autonomy to shape how we source, buy and supply our projects.
  • Landmark projects. Support complex institutional, commercial, healthcare, industrial and residential projects across Alberta.
  • Room to grow. As the business expands, you will have opportunities to take on increasing responsibility, develop new skills, and shape your own career path.
  • Innovation and continuous improvement. Join a team with a strong focus on prefabrication, innovation and doing things better, in a collaborative culture built on accountability and respect.
  • Think like an owner. We’re employee-owned, and our people are our greatest asset. A competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits program come with a real stake in a growing company.


How to Apply

If you are a purchasing professional looking for a role where your expertise is valued and your growth is supported, we would love to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to have a confidential conversation about your experience, career ambitions, and what the next stage of your professional journey could look like with District Mechanical.

We look forward to connecting with professionals who are ready to take the next step in their careers.

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
About Excelligence Learning Corporation


Excelligence Learning Corporation is the world’s leading tech-enabled platform company in early childhood and elementary education. Educators, parents, and children in more than 40 countries use our 20,000+ innovative, high-quality educational products and teaching solutions to teach, learn, and grow.


With over 30 years of experience, Excelligence is a developer, manufacturer, distributor, and multi-channel retailer serving early childhood learning centers, elementary schools, PTAs, and consumers. Our portfolio includes industry-leading brands such as Discount School Supply®, Really Good Stuff®, Children’s Factory®, Angeles®, Learning Carpets®, Colorations®, BioColor®, and Frog Street®.


Position Overview

The Logistics Analyst supports transportation operations across small parcel, Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and international ocean freight by monitoring shipment activity, analyzing carrier performance and costs, and ensuring timely, cost-effective delivery performance. This role works closely with carriers, freight forwarders, and the company’s third-party logistics transportation provider (3PL), supporting shipment execution, issue resolution, vendor compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Primary responsibilities are assigned by transportation mode based on business needs. Assignments may change over time, and analysts are expected to cross-train and support one another across all modes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and experienced in small parcel and/or freight transportation operations, carrier management, and Transportation Management Systems (TMS). This individual will play a key role in driving transportation efficiency, service performance, and cost optimization across the company’s logistics network.

This position is based on site in Gardner, KS and requires in-office attendance five days per week.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day small parcel shipping operations by monitoring carrier performance, transit times, and delivery exceptions to ensure timely, cost-effective delivery while communicating shipment updates to internal stakeholders.
  • Analyze parcel shipping data, carrier invoices, and accessorial charges to identify cost savings, billing errors, and service-level optimization opportunities.
  • Manage parcel claims for lost or damaged packages and coordinate resolution of parcel delivery exceptions with carriers, warehouse teams, and Customer Service.
  • Tender and manage LTL and FTL loads through MercuryGate TMS, selecting carriers based on cost, service performance, transit requirements, and customer needs.
  • Monitor inbound ocean freight shipments to ensure timely milestone updates, shipment visibility, documentation accuracy, and delivery performance.
  • Escalate and support resolution of transportation issues, parcel and freight claims, OS&D, delays, and delivery exceptions by coordinating with carriers, vendors, warehouses, Customer Service, and internal teams.
  • Develop strong working relationships with parcel and freight carriers, brokers, freight forwarders, vendors, and logistics partners to improve transportation execution and service performance.
  • Train internal associates and vendors on TMS processes, routing guides, and parcel and freight shipping requirements while monitoring compliance with transportation standards.
  • Analyze transportation data across all modes to identify cost savings, mode optimization opportunities and process improvements.
  • Cross-train on and support all transportation modes, adjusting primary responsibilities as business needs change.


Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or freight operations, with required hands-on experience in small parcel shipping operations and exposure to other transportation modes such as LTL, FTL, or ocean freight.
  • Strong knowledge of small parcel shipping operations is required, including UPS, FedEx, or similar carriers, shipping services, rate structures, dimensional weight pricing, accessorial charges, and carrier performance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required, with demonstrated experience analyzing transportation data, identifying cost-saving opportunities, evaluating shipping performance, and recommending operational improvements.
  • Experience working with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) such as MercuryGate or similar logistics and shipping platforms.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reporting, data manipulation, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Ability to analyze parcel shipping costs, carrier invoices, transportation trends, and service-level performance to identify opportunities for cost reduction and operational efficiency.
  • Working knowledge of additional transportation modes, including LTL, FTL, or ocean freight, with the willingness and ability to expand expertise as business needs evolve.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with carriers, vendors, third-party logistics (3PL) partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to analyze information, improve productivity, support data-driven decision-making, and drive process improvements.




Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, business, or a related field.
  • Experience across multiple transportation modes, including small parcel, LTL, FTL, and ocean freight.
  • Experience working with third-party logistics providers (3PLs), in a distribution or retail supply chain environment.
  • Experience with transportation optimization initiatives such as parcel-to-LTL mode conversion, LTL consolidations, multi-stop routing, or carrier rationalization.
  • Familiarity with transportation KPIs, parcel and freight auditing, and logistics performance reporting.
  • Experience with carrier contract negotiations, parcel rate shopping, or multi-carrier shipping platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time shipment execution and improved visibility across all transportation modes.
  • Strong working relationships with carriers, freight forwarders, vendors, and 3PL partners that support service and operational goals.
  • Increased routing guide compliance and reduced transportation exceptions, claims, and billing errors.
  • Identification and implementation of parcel and freight savings and mode optimization opportunities.
  • Effective cross-mode support that keeps transportation operations running smoothly as assignments change.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Excelligence Learning Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Java + microservices - senior IC with mentorship responsibility


Role Overview:


We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer with deep experience in Java and microservices to build, scale, and operate the backend systems that power Valeo's healthcare platform across KSA and UAE. You will own services end-to-end - design, build, ship, operate - while mentoring junior engineers and raising the technical bar of the team. This is a senior individual-contributor role focused on technical depth. You will spend most of your time writing code, designing systems, and reviewing your peers' work. You will not manage people, but you will mentor 2-3 junior engineers, drive technical standards, and be the senior voice in architecture decisions for your area. It is the right role if you want to grow as an engineer rather than into management.


The Mindset We Hire For:


These three traits matter more than any specific framework on your CV. If they don't describe you, this is not the right role.

  • Ownership: You don't wait for permission. When a service you own breaks, you fix it. When a junior engineer is stuck, you pair with them. When the design is unclear, you write it down.
  • Deliver Results: You measure yourself in services shipped and reliability improved, not PRs merged. You can tell us what you built last quarter, what changed for users or the business because of it, and what you would do differently.
  • Quick to Learn: You taught yourself something significant in the last three months and can describe it without preparation - a new framework, architecture pattern, or operational tool.


Key Responsibilities:


Technical Ownership:

  • Design, build, and operate Java-based microservices that handle sensitive healthcare data at scale.
  • Own technical design for services in your area - write design docs, lead design reviews, make architecture tradeoffs.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Debug production issues across services; own root-cause analysis and remediation.
  • Drive performance, reliability, and cost improvements in owned services.


Mentorship:

  • Mentor 2-3 junior backend engineers through pairing, code reviews, and design reviews.
  • Run technical brown-bag sessions and learning sessions for the backend team - share patterns, post-mortem learnings, and new tools.
  • Help juniors grow toward SDE II and Senior Engineer levels - identify stretch projects, give structured feedback.
  • Be the first technical escalation point in your area for less senior engineers.


Collaboration:

  • Partner with frontend and mobile engineers on API design and contracts.
  • Work with Product Managers on solution design and technical tradeoffs.
  • Work with DevOps/SRE on infrastructure, deployment, and incident response.
  • Participate in hiring - review resumes, conduct technical interviews, calibrate signal.


Security & Compliance:

  • Ensure code and design decisions meet HIPAA, UAE PDPL, and KSA PDPL requirements for healthcare data handling.
  • Implement secure patterns for PII/PHI: encryption at rest and in transit, audit trails, access controls.
  • Maintain documentation needed for security audits and reviews.


Required Qualifications:


Experience:

  • 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend systems.
  • 3+ years building production systems in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar frameworks).
  • Direct experience designing and operating microservices in production - not just consuming them.
  • Demonstrated mentorship experience - you have meaningfully grown more junior engineers, formally or informally.
  • Startup experience is a plus - comfort with ambiguity, speed of decision-making, and wearing multiple hats.
  • Exposure to healthcare, fintech, or other regulated, high-trust domains is a plus.


Technical Skills:

  • Strong expertise in Java (8 or later) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data).
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture patterns - service discovery, API gateways, async messaging, circuit breakers, idempotency.
  • Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS) and event-driven design.
  • Familiarity with AWS or GCP - compute, networking, IAM, and managed services.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design; experience with gRPC or GraphQL is a plus.
  • Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or similar).
  • Solid grounding in testing - unit, integration, and contract testing.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of data security, encryption, and PII/PHI handling.


Engineering Mindset:

  • Strong systems thinking - you can reason about correctness, performance, and operability simultaneously.
  • Crisp communication: you can write a clear technical spec, run a productive design review, and have a hard architectural conversation when needed.
  • Calm under pressure during incidents.
  • Curious about the domain - you care about why a healthcare feature matters, not just how to build it.


What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months):

  • You ship 2-3 significant backend services or major upgrades, owned end to end, with measurable reliability or performance impact.
  • Junior engineers you mentor grow visibly - broader scope, harder problems, promotion readiness.
  • Production incidents in your area decrease quarter over quarter.
  • You become the first person teammates ask when they hit a hard backend or systems question.
  • You contribute meaningfully to engineering hiring - both interview throughput and signal quality.

title: Inventory Planner
description:
Inventory Planner Bare Home Forest Lake, Minnesota, United States (On-site)

Bare Home | Forest Lake, Minnesota | On-Site | Full-Time


"Put Your Math to Work: Turn Data into Inventory Decisions Across a Global Supply Chain"


About Us

JP Ecommerce has been named one of the top-ten fastest-growing businesses in Minnesota by Inc. 5000 for four consecutive years. We provide customers with high-quality bedding through our brand Bare Home and are expanding into USA-made mattresses. As a leading textile retail company, we source premium products from China, India, Pakistan, and Turkey, and we have built a reputation for sustainable and ethical sourcing.

What sets us apart is an entrepreneurial, collaborative environment where team members see their ideas turn into action quickly. We are a Minnesota-based company with small-town values and big dreams, where you can help shape not just this role, but the company culture itself.


Position Overview

The Inventory Planner is the analytical entry point into Bare Home's planning team. Reporting to the Planning Manager, you will plan inventory for assigned product categories: reviewing replenishment recommendations from our forecasting system, preparing purchase orders and Amazon FBA shipment plans for approval, tracking stock position across every channel, and flagging stock-out and overstock risk before it costs us sales or storage fees.


This is an applied math problem with real money attached. Our inventory moves from factories in China, India, Pakistan, and Turkey, with long lead times, into our own distribution center, Amazon fulfillment centers, and third-party warehouses serving the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada. Demand is seasonal, exceptions are constant, and factory minimum order quantities rarely line up neatly with what the forecast says we need. We want someone who can do more than report the numbers: someone who can interpret them, explain what is driving them, and recommend what to do next.


You do not need a supply chain background. We will teach you international trade, e-commerce, and inventory management from the ground up. What you need to bring is a strong quantitative mind, real skill in Excel, and the curiosity to keep asking why. People with backgrounds in statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, economics, and analytics have done very well in this seat, and it leads to senior planning and analyst roles as you grow.


Why On-Site Matters

Planning is learned fastest next to the people and the product. You will sit with the Planning Manager, senior planners, and our buying, logistics, and warehouse teams at our Columbus, MN headquarters and distribution center, where you can walk out to the floor to see what the data is describing, get a question answered in minutes, and watch your recommendation turn into a purchase order the same week.


Key Responsibilities

Inventory and Replenishment Planning

  • Review replenishment recommendations from our forecasting and planning system (Slimstock) for assigned categories, and prepare proposed order quantities and timing for Planning Manager review and approval
  • Prepare purchase orders for approved orders and track each one from release through production, shipment, and receipt
  • Prepare factory-to-Amazon and warehouse-to-Amazon replenishment plans that protect in-stock rate without exceeding storage limits
  • Monitor inventory position by location, open purchase orders, in-transit stock, and weeks of cover across our distribution center, Amazon, and third-party warehouses in the US, UK, and Canada
  • Anticipate seasonality, and manage the exceptions: late production, demand spikes, and delayed shipments

Analysis and Interpretation

  • Apply A-through-E inventory classification and Pareto analysis of sales, cost, and inventory value so our top-driving products stay in stock and capital is not tied up in slow movers
  • Work with the buying team to solve trade-offs between factory minimum order quantities, supplier capacity, and lead times
  • Build and maintain inventory and replenishment reports and dashboards in Excel and Power BI
  • Pull and combine data from our planning, order management, and marketplace systems to answer planning questions
  • Track fill rate, stock-out days, inventory turns, and weeks of cover, and explain what is driving the changes
  • Identify slow-moving, excess, and aged inventory and report your findings

Data Accuracy, Process, and Tools

  • Keep item, lead-time, minimum order quantity, and open-order data accurate across systems for assigned products
  • Track vendor production status and ship dates, and coordinate with logistics and warehouse teams on inbound timing, receipts, and transfers
  • Use forecasting tools and AI to speed up analysis, and apply the judgment to check the output before it drives a decision
  • Help build and document planning processes and policies as the function grows; many of ours are being written now, and you will have a hand in them


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Economics, Business or Data Analytics, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related quantitative field; or an associate's degree plus 2 or more years of directly related inventory, purchasing, or analytics experience
  • 0–2 years of experience in analytics, inventory planning, purchasing, or supply chain; relevant internships, capstone projects, and quantitative coursework count
  • Strong Excel skills, demonstrated in work or coursework: pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and working with large data sets
  • Working ability in at least one of SQL, Power BI, or Tableau, from coursework, an internship, or work experience
  • Solid grounding in statistics and quantitative reasoning: distributions, variability, trends, and seasonality, and comfort drawing conclusions from imperfect data
  • Ability to interpret results and explain what the numbers mean, in plain language, to people who are not analysts
  • High attention to detail in quantities, dates, and data


Preferred

  • SQL for data extraction (highly desired)
  • Power BI, including Power Query or data modeling
  • Coursework or experience in forecasting, time series, or optimization
  • Experience with R or Python for analysis
  • Familiarity with supply chain fundamentals: lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and minimum order quantities (we will teach you)
  • Exposure to e-commerce or marketplaces such as Amazon FBA, Walmart, or Target
  • Experience with an inventory planning or ERP system (training provided)


Required Skills

  • Excel: advanced working proficiency, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and large data sets
  • Analytical thinking: spots trends and anomalies in data and asks why
  • Interpretation: turns analysis into a clear recommendation
  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication with planners, buyers, and managers
  • Organization: manages many products, open orders, and deadlines at once
  • Adaptability: comfortable working in an environment where processes are still being built



Schedule and Location

Full-time, on-site at our Columbus, MN headquarters and distribution center, just outside Forest Lake. Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. This position is eligible for overtime pay; the busy season and occasional early-morning calls with overseas vendors may require additional hours, approved in advance. This role works primarily at a computer, occasionally lifts and carries up to 20 lbs, and is occasionally on the warehouse floor for receipts, cycle counts, and inventory reviews, where PPE is required.


We are only considering candidates who:

  • Live in, or are relocating to, Minnesota or the immediate surrounding area
  • Can reliably commute to our Columbus, MN location daily
  • Are available for in-person interviews at our office


Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary Range: $55,000 – $65,000 (based on education, relevant internship or work experience, and demonstrated analytical and technical skills)
  • Medical coverage through a company-funded Individual Coverage HRA (ICHRA), which helps pay for the individual health plan you choose
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Minnesota Paid Family and Medical Leave (private plan through Guardian)
  • Employee discount on Bare Home products — you will sleep well knowing you are making a difference


Application Process

Ready to put your analytical skills to work at one of Minnesota's fastest-growing brands? To be considered for this opportunity, please submit:

  • A resume highlighting your education, quantitative coursework, internships or work experience, and your skills in Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools
  • A short note (one page or less) describing one class project, internship, or job where you analyzed a data set and reached a conclusion or recommendation: what the question was, how you approached it, which tools you used, and what you found


Submit your application to: wyeargan@barehome.com or AKeyes@barehome.com


Visit us: https://barehome.com/


At Bare Home, we strive to create a culture where all people come first. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce and to sustaining an inclusive culture that supports growth for everyone. Bare Home is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, status with regard to public assistance, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview, please contact wyeargan@barehome.com.

title: Logistics Analyst (Contract)
description:
Logistics Analyst – 12-Month Contract

Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands | Onsite


About CBMM

CBMM is a global company built on technology and innovation, with a unique focus on niobium (Nb) products. We invest in research and development to create advanced solutions for industrial applications and sustainable growth. Our teams work across disciplines to improve processes, products and customer outcomes. CBMM encourages continuous learning, innovation and responsible practices, so you will contribute to impactful projects and to the long-term transformation of our industry.


About the Role

We are looking for a Logistics Analyst to join our team at our Amsterdam-Zuid office on a 12-month contract. Depending on performance, the role may become permanent.

You will coordinate daily logistics operations, including shipments, order tracking and the timely delivery of materials and products. You will work closely with internal teams, 3PLs, freight forwarders, suppliers and customers to resolve logistics issues, keep documentation accurate and support compliance with international trade regulations. Proactive problem-solving and regular communication with stakeholders are key to this role.


Key Responsibilities

Documentation Management

  • Plan and coordinate the efficient transportation and distribution of materials.
  • Validate incoming orders (quantities and material codes) and enter them accurately into SAP.
  • Prepare and manage all import and export documentation, including commercial invoices, bills of lading, packing lists, certificates of origin, legalisation, insurance, and inspection and fumigation certificates.
  • Make sure shipping documents are complete and reach customers, banks and freight forwarders on time.
  • Arrange courier services for document dispatch.

Inventory Management

  • Manage inbound shipments into the warehouses.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records in SAP.
  • Own the monthly inventory closing and stock reconciliation in SAP.
  • Coordinate the subcontracting production process and internal warehouse transfers.

Order Processing & Customer Service

  • Coordinate shipping schedules, deliveries and collections with the Commercial Team, agents, customers and HQ.
  • Process orders accurately and on time.
  • Act as the logistics point of contact for the Commercial Team, advising on logistics requirements, Incoterms and transport solutions.

3PL Management

  • Coordinate with 3PLs and freight forwarders on vessel bookings, import arrivals, transport and shipping documentation.
  • Monitor 3PL and carrier performance, review freight invoices and support rate negotiations.
  • Help optimise transport routes and solutions.

Compliance & Audit

  • Support compliance with international trade and European logistics regulations.
  • Handle internal and external audit queries independently and keep logistics processes documented and audit-ready.

Logistics Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse logistics data (freight costs, lead times, stock levels) and report on key logistics KPIs.
  • Identify and drive process improvements, including standardising logistics procedures (SOPs).
  • Support the logistics budget and cost-saving initiatives with data-driven analysis.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Management or a related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain or export operations.
  • Solid hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (SD/MM).
  • Good knowledge of Incoterms and import/export documentation and procedures.
  • Knowledge of supply chain management, including inventory, transportation and warehouse coordination.
  • Advanced Excel skills (data analysis, pivot tables, formulas) and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret logistics data, identify issues and support process improvements.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills to work with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Fluent English. Intermediate Dutch.


What We Offer

  • A 12-month contract, with the possibility of becoming permanent based on performance.
  • An onsite role at our Amsterdam-Zuid office.
  • The chance to work in an international, innovation-driven company.

title: Material Planner (1-Year Contract)
description:
Are you ready to make a real impact and grow your career in an industry that nourishes the nation? Join us at Trophy Foods Inc. in Mississauga, ON, where exciting opportunities await you! Whether you’re looking to launch your career or take it to the next level, we offer the perfect platform to thrive in the dynamic world of food manufacturing.

Now’s the time to be part of our growth and success! Ready to start or accelerate your journey with us? Come be part of something bigger at Trophy Foods!


We are looking for a Material Planner to join our dynamic team at Trophy Foods. This position is for an existing vacancy and offers the opportunity to:

  • Contribute to our mission of inspiring, creating, and delivering high-quality snacks with exceptional service.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and meet the evolving needs of our customers and consumers.
  • Ensure the highest standards of food safety, quality, and customer satisfaction are met.
  • Uphold Trophy’s strong commitment to caring for customers, our community, and the environment.


This is a fixed-term contract for (1) one year.

Shift & Working Hours: 9:00am-5:00pm, subject to change based on business needs


Overview: The Material Planner ensures continuity of supply for assigned raw materials, packaging materials, and direct purchase finished goods. The role aligns purchasing and delivery schedules with production and business requirements while managing inventory within approved stocking parameters and working capital objectives.


Working closely with Production Planners, Category Managers, Quality, Warehouse teams, and suppliers, the planner identifies supply risks early, maintains reliable planning information, and follows actions through to resolution.


Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Material planning and inventory control

  • Review demand, production requirements, inventory availability, open purchase orders, and supplier commitments to develop and maintain material replenishment plans.
  • Plan purchases using approved weeks of coverage targets, lead times, minimum order quantities, order multiples, shelf life, and storage constraints. Identify conflicts between supply requirements and inventory objectives and recommend a course of action.
  • Regularly review shortages, excess inventory, slow-moving materials, and expiry or obsolescence exposure. Recommend expediting, rescheduling, reducing, or cancelling orders within contractual commitments and approval requirements.
  • Assess the impact of forecast changes, production schedule changes, and new or discontinued items on material supply. Coordinate actions to support launches and minimize residual inventory.


Purchase order execution and delivery follow-up

  • Release purchase orders accurately in the ERP system, ensuring alignment with contract terms and material requirements.
  • Confirm supplier acceptance, quantities, pricing, and delivery dates. Maintain current order status and follow up from dispatch through warehouse receipt.
  • Coordinate delivery schedules and required documentation with suppliers and internal teams. Investigate overdue orders, partial shipments, and receipt discrepancies, and track corrective actions to completion.
  • Communicate supply delays promptly, including the affected materials, expected business impact, recovery options, action owners, and next update.


Supplier and contract coordination

  • Monitor contract balances, committed volumes, and renewal needs with Category Managers. Flag potential gaps early enough to support sourcing and negotiation activities.
  • Provide Category Managers with supplier delivery trends, lead time changes, minimum order constraints, and recurring service issues to support supplier reviews and improvement plans.
  • Collaborate with Procurement, Quality Control, suppliers, and warehouse teams to support the resolution of issues related to out-of-specification materials, assess supply impacts, and adjust material plans to reflect quality holds, release status, and agreed corrective actions.


Planning data and reporting

  • Maintain accurate and current ERP planning data and purchase order information within the assigned scope of responsibility and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate teams for correction.
  • Prepare accurate inventory, supply risk, open order, and exception reports. Validate material variances and explain the drivers, operational impact, and recommended actions.
  • Participate actively in cross-functional planning meetings, arriving with current information, prioritized exceptions, and clear recommendations. Maintain action owners and due dates and close the loop on commitments.
  • Identify recurring planning issues and improve reporting, data quality, replenishment practices, and follow-up processes in collaboration with the Materials Manager and relevant teams.


Ownership and prioritization

  • Organize daily and weekly activities around production continuity, customer requirements, inventory exposure, and agreed deadlines. Escalate competing priorities or capacity constraints before commitments are missed.
  • Take ownership of the assigned portfolio, investigate exceptions, maintain supporting records, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Perform other duties relevant to the position assigned.

Experience, Qualifications, and Educational Requirements:

  • College/university diploma with a minimum of 5 years’ experience – ideally in the field of Supply Chain Management.
  • Prior experience conducting planning activities using a Tier 1 ERP - direct experience with JD Edwards an asset.
  • Experience working as part of a cross functional team.
  • APIC Qualifications – (CPIM) or (CSCP) preferred.
  • Ability to respond appropriately in pressure situations with a calm and steady demeanor.
  • Strong customer service focus.
  • Driven and motivated by continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication skills – written & verbal.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and analysis of large datasets; proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.


Why Should You Join Us?

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that is driving innovation in the food industry.
  • Career Growth: We offer opportunities for continuous learning and advancement within the company.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a dynamic, friendly, and inclusive work environment where your voice is heard, and your contributions are valued.
  • Employee Benefits: We offer competitive salary and benefits package, Employee Assistance Programs, Flexible Health Spending Account, Product Giveaways, etc.
  • Community Involvement: We foster greater success when making a positive difference in our communities by donating our time, resources, and expertise.


Apply today and help us create snacks that bring joy and togetherness to our customers and consumers!

title: SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst based in India.

The SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst will play a key role in expanding and optimising a global supplier network for A2P (Application-to-Person) messaging. This position combines telecom traffic analysis, supplier onboarding, commercial evaluation, and route optimisation to support reliable, cost-effective SMS delivery worldwide. You will identify and test routes for customer requirements, monitor traffic quality, and assess performance across delivery rates, conversion, and speed. By analysing pricing, negotiating with suppliers, and improving existing routing strategies, you will directly contribute to stronger margins and business growth. Working in an international, fast-paced telecommunications environment, you will collaborate with a global team and help strengthen the company's position in the evolving A2P messaging market.

Accountabilities

  • Identify, research, test, and evaluate SMS A2P routes that meet customer requirements, including A2P and OTP traffic delivery.
  • Expand the global SMS supplier network by identifying suitable providers and supporting supplier evaluation and onboarding.
  • Monitor and analyse traffic quality using key performance indicators such as delivery receipt rates (DLR), conversion rates, and delivery speed.
  • Evaluate the price-to-quality ratio of existing and potential routes to ensure competitive and reliable service.
  • Optimise existing routing strategies to reduce delivery costs, improve margins, and maintain traffic quality.
  • Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics.
  • Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop commercial proposals that reflect customer requirements, pricing expectations, and available routing options.
  • Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in the A2P SMS industry is essential.
  • Proven experience identifying, evaluating, and onboarding SMS suppliers is essential.
  • Strong understanding of SMS traffic management and routing, including experience with iGaming traffic.
  • Good knowledge of global SMS markets, supplier dynamics, pricing structures, and commercial trends.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess route performance, interpret traffic statistics, and evaluate cost and quality.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reporting, pivot tables, and statistical analysis.
  • Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to assess supplier offers and develop competitive proposals.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, internationally focused team.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: Attractive compensation package.
  • International exposure: Opportunity to work with a global team and gain experience across international telecommunications markets.
  • Professional development: Build and deepen expertise in the fast-growing A2P SMS and telecom routing industry.
  • High-impact responsibilities: Direct contribution to revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier network expansion, and business performance.
  • Dynamic environment: Join an energetic, fast-paced organisation experiencing significant growth and transformation.
  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues in an international and supportive team.
  • Opportunity to make an impact: Help shape routing strategies and contribute to the development of the global messaging ecosystem.

description:

You will lead cross-functional engineering teams spanning Backend, Frontend, Mobile, DevOps, QA, Data, and AI/ML.

    • Translate business and product goals into a clear engineering roadmap and execution strategy.
    • Drive scalable, resilient, and maintainable platform architecture.
    • Lead technical design, architecture reviews, and engineering best practices.

  • Engineering Execution & Operational Excellence

    • Drive predictable delivery, sprint execution, release management, and engineering productivity.
    • Establish strong engineering metrics covering delivery, quality, reliability, and performance.
    • Lead incident management, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements.
    • Improve CI/CD, automation, testing, observability, and developer productivity.
  • Platform Architecture, Cloud & AI

    • Drive cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, high availability, and infrastructure cost optimisation.
    • Architect systems supporting multi-market operations across KSA and UAE.
    • Enable AI/ML capabilities, data platforms, analytics, and intelligent healthcare solutions.
    • Ensure responsible AI adoption, secure model deployment, and protection of sensitive healthcare data.
  • People Leadership & Team Building

    • Establish clear ownership, accountability, career progression, and performance standards.
    • Drive a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning.

  • Security, Compliance & Engineering Governance
    • Embed security and privacy principles into the engineering lifecycle.
    • Drive engineering practices aligned with HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, UAE PDPL, and KSA PDPL requirements.
    • Establish secure SDLC practices, access management, encryption, audit trails, and data governance.
    • Partner with Compliance and Security teams to maintain audit readiness and regulatory requirements.

    • Good understanding of Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, SRE, and infrastructure automation.
    • Experience building secure, scalable, high-availability platforms.
    • Understanding of databases, data pipelines, analytics, and modern data architectures.
    • Exposure to AI/ML platforms and production AI systems is a plus.
  • Leadership & Mindset
    • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives independently.
    • Excellent people management, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to connect technology decisions with business outcomes.
    • Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments.
    • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
    • Passion for building products, teams, and engineering cultures.


What Success Looks Like:

In your first 12 months, you will:

  • Build a stable, secure, scalable, and high-performing engineering platform.
  • Improve engineering velocity, delivery predictability, and production reliability.
  • Establish clear ownership across engineering teams and critical systems.
  • Strengthen technical architecture, automation, and engineering standards.
  • Build a strong engineering leadership pipeline and high-performing teams.
  • Ensure technology platforms remain aligned with security and regulatory requirements.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Contractual)
description:
Key responsibilities:

  • Cloud security (AWS and GCP) Design, implement and continuously audit security baselines across AWS accounts and GCP projects: IAM, networking, encryption, logging and organization-level policies.
  • Run cloud security posture management and close misconfigurations before they reach production.
  • Enforce least-privilege access, short-lived credentials, workload identity and strong secrets management.
  • DevSecOps and pipeline security Build security into CI/CD: SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container and IaC scanning, and artifact signing, with clear pass/fail gates.
  • Secure infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) using policy-as-code and review standards.
  • Harden Kubernetes and container workloads (EKS, GKE), images and registries.
  • Detection, response and resilience Own cloud logging, monitoring and alerting: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Cloud Audit Logs and Security Command Center, feeding a central SIEM.
  • Lead technical triage and containment for security incidents, run post-incident reviews and drive remediation to closure.
  • Maintain and test incident response runbooks and recovery procedures.
  • Vulnerability and risk management Run vulnerability management across infrastructure, dependencies and images, with severity-based SLAs and tracked remediation.
  • Perform threat modelling and security reviews on new services and architecture changes.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and act on their findings.
  • Governance and enablement Support compliance and audit readiness (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and applicable data-protection requirements) with automated evidence collection.
  • Document standards, coach engineers on secure practices and be the go-to security partner for product and platform teams.


Requirements:

  • Required qualifications 5+ years in security engineering, DevSecOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security.
  • Hands-on, production-level depth in both AWS and Google Cloud security: IAM design, VPC/network segmentation, KMS, logging, organization-level guardrails (AWS Organizations and SCPs; GCP Organization Policy).
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform (CloudFormation or Pulumi a plus), including policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel, Checkov or similar).
  • Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Cloud Build) with integrated security scanning.
  • Hands-on experience with security tooling in at least four of these areas: CSPM, SAST/DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, SIEM, EDR and vulnerability scanning.
  • Practical Kubernetes and container security experience (EKS and/or GKE).
  • Real incident response experience: triage, containment, forensics on cloud workloads, root cause analysis and written post-incident reports.
  • Proficiency in Python, Go or Bash for automation and tooling.
  • Solid grasp of application and infrastructure security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, zero trust, encryption and key management.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief both engineers and leadership.


Preferred qualifications:

  • Certifications: AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, CKS or GCSA.
  • Experience in a regulated environment such as fintech or payments, including PCI DSS or SOC 2 audits.
  • Experience with SOAR, security data lakes or detection-as-code.
  • Experience with cloud forensics, DFIR tooling and tabletop exercises.
  • Contributions to security tooling, open-source projects or published research.

description:

The role combines strong practical knowledge of supply-chain processes with advanced expertise in Power BI, SQL, Oracle, OBIEE, Databricks and Microsoft Power Platform technologies.

title: Senior Inventory Planner
description:
Senior Demand & Inventory Planner

Our client is seeking a hands-on Senior Demand & Inventory Planner to support forecasting, replenishment, inventory allocation, and planning across a growing consumer products business. This role will partner closely with Operations, Production, Finance, Marketing, E-commerce, and leadership to turn sales trends and business plans into clear inventory recommendations.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. This person will help improve forecast accuracy, product availability, inventory health, and planning processes while balancing growth, margin, and working-capital needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own demand forecasting across product categories, sales channels, warehouses, and markets. Use historical sales, product lifecycle data, launches, restocks, marketing activity, inventory levels, and customer demand to develop accurate forecasts and scenario plans.
  • Manage replenishment planning and provide recommendations on reorder quantities, purchase timing, and inventory investments. Proactively identify potential stockouts, excess inventory, aging product, and other risks, then work with cross-functional partners to address them.
  • Support inventory allocation across multiple locations and channels. Monitor incoming inventory, production timing, shipment schedules, warehouse receipts, and inventory performance to help ensure the right products are available in the right place at the right time.
  • Develop reporting, dashboards, and analysis that give leadership visibility into demand, inventory position, supply risks, and growth opportunities. Translate data into clear recommendations that support purchasing, allocation, launches, promotions, and inventory strategy.
  • Lead regular planning discussions and partner with internal teams to improve forecasting tools, reporting standards, purchasing processes, and overall planning discipline.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in demand planning, inventory planning, merchandise planning, forecasting, or a related field within apparel, fashion, footwear, activewear, or another consumer products category.
  • Strong experience working with SKU-level forecasting, product lifecycles, replenishment, allocation, sell-through, and inventory health. Experience supporting multiple channels, warehouses, or international markets is preferred.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills are required, along with experience using planning, inventory, ERP, or business-intelligence systems. Experience with e-commerce platforms is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills are essential. This is a full-time, primarily on-site role with flexibility needed during key launches and peak planning periods.

title: Founder's Office - Operations
description:
Location: Pune (On-site)


Role Overview:


Run our international patient business as if it were your own company. You'll own the P&L end-to-end, know the revenue, margin, and unit economics of every specialty, hospital, and source market, and act on those numbers through pricing, package design, and cost control. You'll work directly with the founding team as a thought partner on where the business goes next. This is a founder-style, business-owner role, not a process-management role.


What you'll do:

  • Own the P&L for patient services: revenue, gross and contribution margin, budgeting, and forecasting.
  • Track unit economics by specialty, hospital, and source market, and turn them into decisions on pricing, packages, and cost control.
  • Identify and test new growth bets, such as new specialties, packages, or source markets, and build the business case for the ones worth scaling.
  • Work with the partnerships team on hospital commercial terms: rate cards, volume commitments, and quality-linked pricing.
  • Work with finance on budgets, cost estimates, and monthly reporting.
  • Drive patient operations and customer success outcomes (turnaround times, retention, referrals, patient satisfaction) through the ops and CS team, and stay accountable for their impact on margin.
  • Flag and escalate critical and high-risk cases to the founders.
  • Build dashboards and a regular business review that show where we make and lose money, and bring recommendations, not just reports, to the founding team.


What you'll bring (must-have):

  • 4-6 years of total experience, with 2+ years owning or closely managing a P&L, business unit, or budget.
  • 3+ years of full-time experience in a startup or scale-up. This is mandatory: you're comfortable with ambiguity, thin processes, and wearing multiple hats.
  • An entrepreneurial track record: you've built something from scratch, launched a new line of business, or founded or co-founded a venture.
  • Strong command of unit economics, margins, and forecasting, and comfort building models in Excel or Sheets.
  • Ability to negotiate and structure commercial terms with external partners.
  • Clear communication and comfort working with clinical, ops, finance, and partnership stakeholders across time zones.


Good to have:

  • Background in strategy, consulting, business-unit management, or finance business partnering.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical travel, hospitality, or another high-touch service business.

title: Meta Ads Scriptwriter | Performance Strategist
description:
We are looking for a creative, research-driven Meta Ads Scriptwriter / Performance Creative Strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch an advertisement, connect with a product, and ultimately make a purchase.


This is not a conventional content-writing role.


We need someone who can research successful advertisements, identify new creative angles, develop compelling hooks, write high-converting video scripts, and work closely with our marketing and creative teams to produce performance-driven advertisements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ad Research & Competitor Analysis
    • Research advertisements across Meta Ad Library, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
    • Study successful D2C advertising strategies and creative formats.
    • Identify interesting hooks, storytelling techniques, messaging angles, and visual styles.
    • Maintain a library of competitor ad references and creative inspiration.
    • Convert research findings into original advertising concepts.
  • Meta Ads Scriptwriting
    • Develop compelling video ad scripts for Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
    • Write strong opening hooks that capture attention within the first 3 seconds.
    • Create UGC-style, product demonstration, storytelling, educational, and direct-response video scripts.
    • Develop multiple creative angles for the same product.
    • Write scripts in Hindi, Hinglish, and English as required.
    • Create multiple hook and script variations for creative testing.
    • Continuously improve existing scripts based on advertising performance.
  • Creative Strategy & Ideation
    • Research customer motivations, product-related concerns, objections, and purchasing behaviour.
    • Develop fresh advertising concepts instead of repeatedly using the same messaging.
    • Identify opportunities for creative diversification.
    • Brainstorm new advertising approaches with the performance marketing team.
    • Review existing advertisements and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Script Direction & Production Coordination
    • Prepare detailed scene-by-scene scripts.
    • Provide visual references, shot lists, dialogues, voiceovers, and on-screen text.
    • Give clear instructions for video shooting and editing.
    • Coordinate with photographers, videographers, and video editors.
    • Review edited advertisements and suggest improvements before launch.
  • Performance-Based Creative Improvement
    • Work closely with the performance marketing team to understand campaign results.
    • Study winning and underperforming advertisements.
    • Identify patterns in hooks, storytelling, messaging, and creative formats.
    • Develop new concepts based on actual campaign learnings.
    • Maintain a structured creative testing and iteration process.


What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience in Meta Ads scriptwriting or performance creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and D2C marketing.
  • Ability to research competitors and identify creative opportunities.
  • Excellent storytelling and copywriting skills.
  • Understanding of hooks, audience psychology, customer objections, and conversion-focused messaging.
  • Experience writing UGC and short-form video advertisements.
  • Ability to translate a creative idea into a detailed production-ready script.
  • Good understanding of current Instagram and Facebook advertising formats.
  • Ability to collaborate with marketing, design, and video production teams.
  • Strong research skills and an experimental mindset.


Preferred:

  • Experience working with D2C, e-commerce, nutraceutical, health, or wellness brands.
  • Experience developing advertisements that have delivered measurable advertising results.
  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and creative performance metrics.
  • Understanding of AI-assisted creative research and content production.


What You'll Get to Work On:

  • Multiple products and advertising campaigns.
  • Indian and international markets.
  • Continuous creative experimentation.
  • Collaboration with an in-house design, video production, and performance marketing team.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of performance creative strategy.


Experience: 2-5 years preferred, with flexibility for exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong work.


Employment Type: Full-time

title: Account Planner

title: Inventory Planner
description:
About Williams-Sonoma DC - San Francisco, CA


Since it was founded in 1956, Williams - Sonoma has grown from Chuck Williams’ single store in Sonoma, CA into one of the largest retailers in the country, with some best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings, including Williams – Sonoma, Pottery Barn and West Elm.


Our Distribution Centers serve as vital connections between factories and our retail, online and mail-order customers around the world. The Supply Chain environment is dynamic and fast-paced, and the network is expanding rapidly. If you have a background in distribution, manufacturing, engineering, transportation, finance, human resources, or home delivery – and are looking for a job with a strong opportunity for gaining new skills and for advancement – our Supply Chain Organization could be just the place for you.


Williams-Sonoma, Inc Supply Chain Overview


By managing resources responsibly, caring for our people, and uniting around our values, we lead our industry and are proud to be recognized for our continuous action and progress in the following areas: Barron's 100 Most Sustainable Companies; Forbes Best Employers for Women and Diversity; Newsweek America's Most Responsible Companies; and USA Today Customer Service Champions. These honors reflect that we are truly a people-first organization.

  • Over 4,000 Full-Time Associates across the Supply Chain
  • 14.5M square feet of small parcel, personalization, furniture, and manufacturing space in the domestic US, Williams-Sonoma has developed an agile and capable distribution network consisting of the following:
  • Large package / furniture distribution centers located in Southern California, Northern California, Texas, Georgia, and New Jersey totaling 9.2M square feet plus another 1.2M square feet of standalone final-mile furniture hubs.
  • Small package eCommerce distribution centers located in Mississippi and Arizona totaling 3.2M square feet, consisting of over 1,000 full-time associates and 1,500 seasonal/temporary associates in Mississippi
  • Sutter Street Manufacturing upholstery factories located in North Carolina and Mississippi totaling with over 1,400 full-time employees producing approximately $900 million to $1 billion in sales of upholstered furniture
  • Transportation Department for Ocean, Air, Trucking, and Rail consisting of over 30 transportation professionals located in Memphis, TN
  • 700 associates in our Sourcing offices in 10 countries in Asia and Europe including China, Vietnam, Singapore, India, Italy, and Turkey


The Inventory Planner (Omni) is responsible for supporting inventory planning and execution for our Omni services, including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Buy Online Ship from Store (BOSFS), and Buy Online Ship to Store (BOSTS).


This role partners with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Distribution, Store Operations, E-commerce, and IT to help maximize sales, optimize inventory turn, support in-stock goals, and deliver a best-in-class customer experience across Omni fulfillment channels.


The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, and comfortable using data to identify business trends, support recommendations, and help improve inventory outcomes across stores and digital channels.


The Inventory Planner - Omni is located in San Francisco, CA.


You’ll be excited about this opportunity because you will....


  • Support inventory planning for Omni services, including BOPIS, BOSFS, and BOSTS, to help drive sales, improve inventory productivity, and support customer fulfillment goals.
  • Review Corporate Open-To-Buy plans submitted by Inventory teams, along with historical Omni performance, to help build store-level forecasts for BOSFS and BOPIS labor planning.
  • Analyze Omni sales, inventory availability, fulfillment trends, backorder opportunities, cancellation risk, and store performance to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Support BOSFS inventory strategies that help maximize sales, leverage available store inventory, reduce aged or clearance inventory, and mitigate backorder risk.
  • Partner with Store Operations to monitor store fulfillment performance and identify opportunities to improve on-time service, reduce delays, and support customer experience goals.
  • Partner with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Visual, and Store Operations to review floor set plans, key-item representation, presentation minimums, and safety stock needs to help protect in-store selling and display quantities.
  • Leverage historical data to identify key learnings around product, pricing, seasonality, inventory, and Omni fulfillment behavior, and apply those learnings to future planning decisions.
  • Prepare recurring reporting and analysis to support Omni planning conversations, business reviews, and cross-functional decision-making.
  • Partner with Distribution, Inventory, and IT teams to help troubleshoot Omni inventory, reporting, fulfillment, and process issues.
  • Support standardized processes, documentation, and reporting routines that improve visibility, reduce manual work, and create consistency across Omni inventory planning workflows.
  • Use approved AI tools, automation, reporting tools, or planning systems to support analysis, improve recurring workflows, and identify opportunities to work more efficiently.
  • Operate a computer and communicate via telephone.


Check out some of the required qualifications we are looking for in amazing candidates….


  • At least two years of experience in Inventory Management, Inventory Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Merchandise Planning, E-commerce Planning, or a related retail function.
  • Data-driven individual with a curious, analytical, and collaborative mindset.
  • Omnichannel, e-commerce, store fulfillment, or retail inventory experience preferred.
  • Proven ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Proficiency in retail math, including sales, inventory, turn, receipts, margin, markdowns, and open-to-buy concepts.
  • Experience supporting forecasts, reporting, inventory analysis, or recurring business review processes.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel; experience with planning systems, reporting tools, dashboards, or data visualization tools preferred.
  • Curious and proactive in adopting approved AI tools, automation, and reporting enhancements to improve analysis, reduce manual work, and support better decision-making.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Inventory, Merchandising, Store Operations, Distribution, E-commerce, and IT.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload, manage deadlines, and follow through on multiple tasks.
  • Flexible and adaptive to changing priorities, business needs, and process changes.


Review these physical requirements, as they play a major part in this role….


  • Must be able to walk, stand, and bend
  • Able to use a computer for an extended period
  • Repetitive movement with hand and fingers to operate a computer, phone, and keyboard
  • Transport materials and equipment and lift, move, and carry objects up to 50 pounds on a limited basis.


Our company benefits are second to none in the industry….


  • A generous discount on all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands
  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
  • Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
  • Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits
  • Tax-free commuter benefits
  • A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

EOE
