title: Manufacturing Planning Analyst
description:
We are a rapidly growing fabrication and systems integration company (~500

employees) seeking a Manufacturing Planning Analyst to own and improve production

planning processes. In this hands-on role you will resolve complex Bill of Materials

(BOM) and routing issues, drive accurate supply chain planning, and ensure materials

and capacity are aligned to support production of large, heavy-fabricated and integrated

equipment. The ideal candidate has strong Made2Manage experience and familiarity

with Oracle Fusion.


Key Responsibilities

 Develop, maintain, and optimize the master production schedule and detailed

work-order schedules to meet customer delivery commitments while maximizing

throughput and resource utilization.

 Analyze and resolve complex multi-level Bill of Materials (BOM) and routing

discrepancies, including engineering changes, phantom assemblies, alternate

routings, and fabrication-to-integration process flows.

 Execute and improve material requirements planning (MRP) runs; investigate

and clear exceptions related to shortages, lead times, safety stock, and capacity

constraints.

 Partner with Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, and Quality to validate and

cleanse BOMs, routings, work centers, and calendars so that plans accurately

reflect how product is built.

 Coordinate supply chain planning activities, including long-range material

forecasts, inventory targets, and supplier capacity alignment for critical fabricated

and purchased components.

 Identify and implement process improvements in planning parameters, lot-sizing,

lead times, and shop-floor feedback loops to increase plan accuracy and reduce

expediting.

 Provide regular reporting on schedule adherence, material availability, capacity

loading, and planning-related KPIs to operations leadership.

 Support new product introduction (NPI) and continuous improvement initiatives

by ensuring planning data and processes scale with company growth.

 Act as a subject-matter resource for Made2Manage (and Oracle Fusion where

applicable) planning modules; train and coach planners and buyers as needed.


Required Qualifications

 3–7 years of experience in manufacturing planning, production scheduling, or

materials planning in a discrete manufacturing or fabrication environment.

 Hands-on experience with Made2Manage (Aptean) ERP for production planning,

scheduling, MRP, BOMs, and routings. We will consider relevant experience with

similar systems.

 Demonstrated ability to analyze and correct complex multi-level BOMs, routings,

and work-order structures.

 Strong understanding of supply chain planning concepts, including capacity

planning, lead-time management, and inventory optimization.

 Proficiency with Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables, data analysis)

and experience extracting and interpreting ERP data.

 Excellent problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration

skills.

 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly growing manufacturing

environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP (Planning, Manufacturing, or Supply

Chain modules).

 Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering,

Manufacturing Engineering, Business, Data Science or related field (or

equivalent experience).

 Background in heavy equipment, structural fabrication, welding, machining, or

systems integration environments.

 APICS CPIM, CSCP, or similar supply chain certification.

 Experience supporting shop-floor execution, finite capacity scheduling, or

advanced planning tools.

 Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement

methodologies.

title: Operations Planning & Business Process Specialist
description:
Zonder goede planning geen medicijn op tijd. Jij vertaalt de plannen van Supply Chain naar een productieplanning die op de werkvloer ook echt uitvoerbaar is, en maakt de processen erachter slimmer.


Je werkt binnen Chemical Operations in Oss, waar we werkzame bestanddelen voor medicijnen produceren. Je start met een uitgebreid inwerktraject in de chemische operatie. Je leert de processen, systemen en uitdagingen van dichtbij kennen, zodat je niet alleen begrijpt wat er gebeurt, maar vooral ook waarom. Van daaruit ontwikkel je je verder in scheduling, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering. Een goede basis om door te groeien.


Jouw taken als Operations Planning & Business Process Specialist zijn als volgt:

Je puzzelt dagelijks met capaciteit, voorraden en prioriteiten en stemt af met Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service en andere afdelingen. Knelpunten los je het liefst op voordat ze ontstaan, en het resultaat van jouw planning zie je terug op de werkvloer. Daarnaast werk je samen met IT aan oplossingen die onze processen efficiënter, betrouwbaarder en toekomstbestendig maken.

  • Klantvraag en plannen van Supply Chain vertalen naar een uitvoerbare productieplanning;
  • Voortgang, capaciteit, voorraden en prioriteiten bewaken en de planning bijsturen als omstandigheden veranderen;
  • Knelpunten op tijd signaleren en verstoringen voorkomen of oplossen, samen met Operations, Supply Chain en Customer Service;
  • Productie, onderhoud en verbeterinitiatieven op elkaar afstemmen;
  • Zorgen voor betrouwbare masterdata in SAP en andere digitale systemen;
  • De beschikbaarheid van materialen, analyses en capaciteit bewaken;
  • Productievoortgang, capaciteit en knelpunten inzichtelijk maken;
  • Bijdragen aan digitalisering, systeemverbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties en vanuit Scheduling uitgroeien tot sparringpartner binnen de operatie.


Jouw profiel als Operations Planning & Business Process Specialist:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, door opleiding en/of ervaring;
  • Affiniteit met planning, supply chain, logistiek of productieomgevingen;
  • Ervaring met het ERP-systeem SAP heeft de voorkeur;
  • Analytisch sterk: je doorziet complexe situaties snel en vertaalt data naar concrete acties;
  • Grote affiniteit met digitalisering, data-analyse en procesverbetering;
  • Zelfstandig, resultaatgericht en nieuwsgierig: nieuwe systemen en werkwijzen maak je je snel eigen;
  • Een verbinder die helder communiceert en makkelijk schakelt met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en niveaus.


Dit krijg je als Operations Planning & Business Process Specialist

  • Een salaris tussen de €4.689 en €6.465 bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband, vallend in schaal P1 tertiel 2 en 3 (zie Cao), passend bij je kennis en ervaring.
  • 8% vakantiegeld en een bonusschema tot 5,5%.
  • Uitstekend pensioen bij Stichting Pensioenfonds PGB.
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 12,5 ATV-dagen per jaar.
  • Korting op sport, sportkleding, Hello Fresh, een fiets en een collectieve zorgverzekering.
  • Jaarlijks een bedrijfsdag, afdelingsborrels en themabijeenkomsten.


Ben jij onze nieuwe Operations Planning & Business Process Specialist?

Solliciteer via de ‘solliciteer direct’ button rechtsboven of onderaan deze pagina. We ontvangen graag je cv, een motivatiebrief hoeft niet. Eerst nog vragen over de functie, het team of de procedure? Mail ons op oss.hr.flexcenter@nl.aspenpharma.com of bel of app naar +31 6 11 62 59 53. Je krijgt binnen twee werkdagen antwoord.


Werken bij Aspen API in Oss

Bij Aspen API in Oss draag je bij aan medicijnen die mensen over de hele wereld gebruiken. Je werkt met collega’s die hun vak verstaan, in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Dat betekent ruimte om initiatief te nemen, te leren en door te groeien, binnen heldere veiligheidskaders. Onze chemie verbindt.


Voor bureaus

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij vullen onze vacatures zelf en via vaste partners in en nemen ongevraagd voorgestelde kandidaten niet in behandeling. Ongevraagde toezending van cv’s of profielen leidt niet tot een opdracht en geeft geen recht op een bemiddelingsvergoeding. Het bovenstaande e-mailadres en telefoonnummer zijn uitsluitend bedoeld voor potentiële nieuwe collega’s en niet voor bureaus.

title: Senior Forecast Analyst
description:
The Forecast Analyst III is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving accurate demand plans and forecasts for assigned customer accounts. This role analyzes customer sales, inventory, and market trends to identify opportunities and risks, supports the annual sales budget, and partners with customers and cross-functional teams to align forecasts, inventory strategies, and business plans. The Forecast Analyst III serves as a subject matter resource and provides insights and recommendations to improve forecast accuracy and business performance.


Forecast Management

  • Updates and maintains data, assumptions, and formulas used in forecast review files.
  • Develops and maintains sales forecasts for assigned customer accounts.
  • Analyzes historical POS trends and customer data to project future sales.
  • Maintains and evaluates seasonal profiles to support forecast accuracy.
  • Develops and maintains customer inventory plans.
  • Evaluates inventory levels and recommends appropriate build or burn strategies.
  • Incorporates customer promotions, events, and other business factors into forecasts.


Budget Management

  • Develops and maintains sales projections for the assigned account territory.
  • Develops and maintains monthly plans at the warehouse, customer, and SKU levels.
  • Maintains and analyzes year-over-year budget files.


Rollout Management

  • Enters forecasts for non-replenished items and replenishment programs.
  • Partners with customers and internal teams to develop and align rollout plans.
  • Establishes initial order and inventory strategies to support new program launches.
  • Aligns expected sales rates with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Provides feedback to the National Account Manager (NAM) and rollout team when actual plans differ from expectations.


Discontinued Item Planning

  • Partners with customers to establish remaining inventory requirements and last order dates.
  • Determines residual inventory requirements based on customer collaboration plans.
  • Partners with Operations and the NAM to develop strategies for managing residual inventory, including inventory cancellation or sell-off opportunities.


ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 4+ years of experience in forecasting, demand planning, or a related supply chain function.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of forecasting principles, supply chain processes, and inventory planning.
  • Ability to lead forecasting activities and facilitate collaboration across customers and internal teams.
  • Advanced analytical and statistical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

title: Inventory Planning Analyst
description:
Trove Brands is a privately-held house of brands including BlenderBottle®, Owala®, Whiskware®, and Eco-Brite®. Our patented and best-selling products are designed to simplify and improve everyday life with leading-edge innovation, incomparable quality, and aspirational style.

A career at Trove Brands is not about punching the clock. It’s about embracing exciting and fast-paced opportunities that sharpen your skills, drive innovation, and play an integral role in growing our global reach. Your work will not only impact the company, it will impact the lives of millions of people around the world. When you step up to a career at Trove, you step up to cutting-edge excellence. You sign up for bold action and invigorating synergy. You agree to face—and break through—new challenges every single day.

As an Inventory Planning Analyst, you'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Purchasing, Transportation, Product Development, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service to manage inventory for assigned customers and distribution locations. You'll use data, forecasting tools, and business insight to make recommendations that directly impact customer service, inventory health, and company performance. The Inventory Planning Analyst is responsible for managing inventory and replenishment planning for assigned customers, brands, and distribution centers. This role ensures product availability while minimizing excess inventory through accurate forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory analysis, and collaboration with internal business partners. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, sound business judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively across multiple departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage inventory planning and replenishment for assigned customers, warehouses, and distribution centers.
  • Utilize Blue Ridge Demand Planning and Acumatica ERP to analyze inventory positions and generate purchase recommendations.
  • Review forecasts, sales trends, seasonality, promotions, new product launches, and historical demand to ensure inventory plans align with business needs.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to understand customer initiatives, promotional events, and future demand changes.
  • Work closely with Purchasing to place and manage purchase orders while balancing lead times, vendor constraints, and inventory investment.
  • Coordinate with Transportation and Logistics teams to optimize inventory flow across distribution centers.
  • Evaluate inventory health by identifying stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving inventory, and obsolete products.
  • Develop recommendations to reduce excess inventory through inventory transfers, demand alignment, and inventory optimization strategies.
  • Monitor customer service levels and inventory performance to support company service objectives.
  • Participate in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) meetings and provide inventory insights and recommendations.
  • Analyze large data sets to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics that support business decision-making.
  • Support new product introductions, product transitions, and end-of-life inventory planning.
  • Ensure data integrity across planning systems and collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reporting, and inventory performance.
  • Maintain high product availability while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Improve forecast accuracy through proactive planning and collaboration.
  • Make timely, data-driven replenishment decisions.
  • Communicate inventory risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Purchasing, Operations, Transportation, and Finance.
  • Identify process improvements that increase planning efficiency and inventory accuracy.
  • Take ownership of assigned customers and distribution centers with minimal oversight.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Finance, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in inventory planning, demand planning, supply chain, purchasing, operations, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience working with ERP systems.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with demand planning or inventory optimization software (Blue Ridge, SAP IBP, Kinaxis, o9, Logility, Anaplan, or similar).
  • Experience supporting major retail customers or omnichannel fulfillment operations.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Snowflake.
  • Understanding of forecasting methodologies, inventory management principles, and replenishment planning.
  • APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) is a plus.

title: Process/Inventory Analyst
description:
The Process & Inventory Analyst is an early-career role supporting inventory accuracy, supply chain reporting, and process improvement across CSP plants. Working under the guidance of the Manager, Supply Chain Systems & Excellence, the analyst collects and checks data, maintains Plan for Every Part (PFEP) record, and supports plant improvement activities. The role provides practical development in QAD, inventory control, planning, and standard work through coaching and on-site experience.


Essential Job Functions

  • Collect, organize, and maintain PFEP information with plant teams, including demand, lead times, replenishment settings, packaging, storage, and points of use.
  • Prepare recurring inventory reports using established templates; check data for completeness and accuracy and flag unusual results for review.
  • Assist with analysis of raw material, purchased components, work-in-process, and finished goods to identify shortages, excess stock, and slow-moving inventory.
  • Compile cycle-count results, track count completion, and help document variances; support physical inventory preparation and follow-up activities.
  • Help trace inventory discrepancies through receiving, production reporting, transfers, scrap, and shipping transactions with experienced team members.
  • Gather planning parameters and compare them with approved standards; document potential gaps for review by the manager and plant Materials team.
  • Participate in plant assessments and improvement workshops; take process observations, maintain action logs, and follow up on assigned tasks.
  • Help update work instructions and training materials; assist with the rollout of approved process changes under the direction of COE and plant leads.
  • Support trade compliance documentation for the Logistics & Supply Chain Optimization Manager, including country-of-origin and shipment records.
  • Support Material-availability, capacity, and inventory-bank studies by gathering data and completing defined analyses; submit findings for review.


Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and practical experience.
  • Zero to two years of relevant experience; recent graduates, internships, co-ops, and relevant project work are welcome.
  • Basic understanding of inventory or supply chain concepts and a willingness to learn manufacturing processes.
  • Working knowledge of Excel, including sorting, filtering, and basic formulas; willingness to develop pivot-table, lookup, and data-analysis skills.
  • Attention to detail, clear communication, task organization, and willingness to ask questions and raise issues promptly.


Preferred Experience

  • Internship, co-op, or hands-on exposure to manufacturing, warehousing, production planning, or inventory control.
  • Exposure to an ERP system such as QAD, or to inventory transactions and cycle counting; QAD experience is not required.
  • Exposure to pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, or Power BI. Professional certifications are not required.


Skills & Competencies

Curious, dependable, and comfortable learning on the plant floor. Checks work carefully, accepts feedback, and follows assigned actions through to completion.

  • Working Relationships & Accountability
  • Works under the Systems & Excellence Manager’s guidance and supports plant Materials teams. The manager reviews analyses and recommendations. This role does not independently approve inventory adjustments, master-data changes, or policy changes.
  • Performance Measures
  • Accuracy and timeliness of assigned reports, PFEP data completeness, action-log upkeep, completion of assigned tasks, and demonstrated development of inventory, Excel, and QAD skills.
  • Work Environment & Travel
  • Based in the Auburn Hills, MI main office, with 50% travel to CSP facilities, including overnight stays, for assessments, workshops, training, and implementation. Work includes office analysis and on-site activity in manufacturing environments. Follow applicable site safety and PPE requirements.

title: Sr SDE (Full Stack Engineer - AI)
description:

This role goes beyond simply using AI coding assistants. You will have strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Vibe Coding, Rework Rate Reduction and leverage Custom Agents, and integrations built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will apply strong software engineering fundamentals to assemble, integrate, and operationalize AI capabilities into real production systems being accountable for full-stack solutions.


The goal of this role is to significantly shorten development and feedback cycles by automating routine engineering work, augmenting human decision-making, and embedding intelligence directly into our development workflows and the applications we deliver.

  • Own software solutions end-to-end, including system design, architecture, implementation, testing, observability, deployment, and lifecycle support.
  • Develop and implement custom AI agents to support workflow automation, decision support, summarization, and multi-step reasoning capabilities.
  • Integrate AI services, large language models (LLMs), embeddings, search technologies, and external tools through secure and scalable APIs.
  • Build and maintain MCP-based integrations to enable structured communication between AI models, tools, and business systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices while ensuring code quality, architectural integrity, security, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Harden AI components for 24x7 critical physical manufacturing systems with attention to reliability and resiliency, latency and performance, security, permissions, data boundaries, observability, and maintainability.


On your first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience developing production-grade full stack or backend software applications, including API design, service integration, and data persistence.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Experience working with both relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling and storage architecture design.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying AI-enabled applications, including custom AI agents and RAG-based systems.
  • Demonstrated experience with prompt engineering and Vibe Coding prototypes, AI tool integration, and evaluating AI system reliability, security, and failure modes.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience building enterprise-scale distributed applications in cloud environments.
  • Experience building and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable structured context sharing between models, tools, and agents; tool and capability exposure to LLM-based agents; interoperability across AI components without hard-coded integrations.
  • Proficiency with modern technology stacks such as C#, ASP.NET, Angular, SQL, NoSQL, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing AI agent skills, tool invocation frameworks, and multi-agent workflow solutions.
  • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context window management, chain-of-thought design, and AI workflow optimization.
  • Experience architecting highly available, critical systems with focus on performance, resiliency, observability, and security.
  • Track record of leading architecture discussions, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering standards and guidelines.

title: Retail Planner (Apparel)
description:
Role Brief:

To drive data-driven retail planning and business performance by leveraging advanced analytics, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and assortment planning. The role is responsible for identifying growth opportunities, improving inventory productivity, and enhancing profitability through effective pre-season and in-season planning. As the organization adopts AI-driven automation, the incumbent will play a key role in solving complex business problems, developing analytical models, and enabling strategic decision making that improves sales, margins, and customer experience.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead Demand Planning, Merchandise Planning and OTB for Apparel and General Merchandise categories.
  • Develop and manage Open-to-Buy plans aligned with business targets, AOP, sales plans and inventory budgets.
  • Prepare demand forecasts using historical sales, seasonality, trends, promotions, pricing and external factors.
  • Drive store/category/SKU-level assortment, allocation and replenishment planning.
  • Monitor and optimize key KPIs including: Sell-through, Stock cover, Inventory days, Weeks of supply, GMROI, Markdown, Gross margin & Forecast accuracy
  • Conduct sales, inventory and trend analytics to identify business opportunities and risks.
  • Partner closely with Buying, Merchandising, Category, Supply Chain, E-commerce and Business teams.
  • Develop dashboards and automated reporting for planning and business performance.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and predictive analytics for demand forecasting, inventory optimization and planning automation.
  • Build forecasting models and analytical solutions using Python, SQL and BI tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement and automation of existing planning processes.
  • Lead and mentor the Retail Planning/Analytics team and manage deliverables effectively.


Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in the Retail industry, preferably with large-scale fashion/apparel or hypermarket businesses.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Retail Planning, Demand Planning, Merchandise Planning and OTB.
  • Strong understanding of Apparel and General Merchandise planning dynamics.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to translate data into business decisions.
  • Exposure to AI/ML, predictive analytics and automation in retail planning is highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, Tableau etc.

Position Purpose: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all aspects of the job. Directs and controls the operation of the Front End in the absence of store management to achieve sales and profit objectives.

title: Technical Procurement & Materials Coordinator (Semiconductors & Electronics Hardware)
description:
This job requires experience of Semiconductors & Electronics Hardware products.


About the job

We’re looking for a Technical Procurement & Materials Coordinator to join our team and help ensure the parts, materials and subcontracted services required to manufacture and test our advanced satellite communications products are available when needed.

This is a hands-on role combining supplier coordination, materials planning, ERP / MRP administration and inventory control. You will work closely with Engineering and Production to support prototype builds, new product introduction and ongoing production of a cutting egde satellite product.

You will play an important role in maintaining an accurate and resilient supply chain, ensuring materials are correctly controlled and traceable from receipt through to production, while helping identify and resolve potential supply risks before they affect the build programme.


Your responsibilities will include:


MRP and Materials Management

  • Maintain accurate stock, purchasing and manufacturing records within the ERP / MRP system
  • Create and manage work orders, including multi-level sub-assemblies
  • Maintain part masters, bills of materials and manufacturing routings
  • Add new parts and approved BOM structures to support new product introduction
  • Monitor stock shortages and plan to purchase against upcoming build requirements
  • Maintain system records for repairs and rework


Goods-In, Stores and Inventory Control

  • Manage the receipt, booking-in and storage of incoming components
  • Carry out basic visual and dimensional inspections where appropriately trained
  • Identify, record and manage supplier non-conformances, including incorrect, damaged or out-of-specification parts
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange replacement or corrective action and track the issue through to closure within the MRP system
  • Maintain component-to-product traceability through the MRP system and ensure relevant certificates, test reports and inspection records are stored
  • Conduct periodic stock checks, investigate discrepancies and maintain inventory accuracy


Procurement & Supply Chain

  • Manage the purchase of components. Obtain and compare supplier quotations
  • Track open purchase orders, monitor supplier acknowledgements, pricing, lead times and delivery dates
  • Identify potential alternative parts and sources
  • Resolve routine commercial, delivery and documentation queries
  • Coordinate straightforward technical supplier queries


Logistics and Operational Support

  • Coordinate outbound shipments of products, components and subcontracted work
  • Manage packaging for products
  • Prepare or obtain the necessary delivery and shipping documentation including export control processes


Requirements:

A minimum of 4 years of experience in procurement, materials coordination, supply chain or a similar role within an engineering or manufacturing environment

title: Safeway Assistant Store Director-Washington DC
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.

The Assistant Store Director (ASD) is actively involved in and provides friendly, courteous, and helpful customer service daily. The ASD is also responsible for assisting the Store Director (SD) with the total operations of the store and performs various duties personally or through supervision of store employees (100+ bargaining unit and non-contract employees).

Pay Transparency: The salary range is $68k to $94k annually with quarterly bonus potential. Starting salary will vary based on criteria such as location, experience, and qualifications. There may be flexibility for exceptional candidates. The total comp package yearly can include 12 days PTO, 40 hrs of sick time, 6 recognized holidays, 401k match of up to 7%, Pet insurance, EPA benefits, and so much more!

The ASD manages the entire store with the authority to operate the store at maximum efficiency during the absence of the SD. The ASD is responsible for the supervision of all store employees. This includes orienting new employees, training and developing, scheduling and payroll, performance evaluation, and personnel actions (e.g., hiring, promoting, disciplining, etc.). Our ASD’s also performs or delegates security and cash control procedures, the handling of customer complaints, the reporting of accidents/injuries, the maintenance of sanitation standards, office and accounting functions, the maintenance of in-stock conditions, and ensuring communication between departments and among store personnel.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Overall management responsibility for operation of retail grocery store during absence of the Store Director, including store performance, control of cash, inventory and security, customer services, and management of staff.
  • Track, analyze and take action to improve store performance by forecasting weekly/daily sales goals and meeting or exceeding established goals.
  • Communicate sales goals, department performance and sales opportunities with staff to ensure positive results.
  • Forecast, schedule, and monitor labor to be consistent with store sales and productivity guidelines and wage budgets; create action plan to address cost control issues.
  • Support Store Director with development and direction in the execution of strategies to improve product placement and appearance.
  • Monitor display accuracy and appearance to implement promotions. Ensure that products are properly displayed and ordered in a manner to maintain in-stock conditions.
  • Manage issues relating to store maintenance, cleanliness, safety and sanitation.
  • Oversee and monitor handling of cash and accounting; ensure store is secured.
  • Prioritize, plan, and coordinate work activities, and manage time and resources so that work objectives are met.
  • Ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies and procedures, including check cashing, security, safety, sanitation, wage and hour, etc.
  • Focus on customer satisfaction and needs; ensure that employees provide customers with superior customer service through use of best practices and communication of the importance of superior customer service.
  • Select, train, develop, and manage job performance of store employees, with assistance of other management personnel.
  • Provide constructive suggestions and encouragement, set performance expectations, provide honest feedback, and identify assignments to provide others with developmental opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate professional relationships with union officials and ensure compliance with collective bargaining agreement provisions if applicable.
  • Preserve positive working relationships with direct reports, peers, supervisors, suppliers, and customers effectively handling complex or difficult situations involving others.
  • Motivate others to perform the job and work towards common objectives. Serve as a role model to others instilling a positive attitude in his/her employees.

  • May perform other management duties to keep the store functioning effectively at all times.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of one year of assistant manager experience responsible for managing a department/team within a multi-department operation within the retail or service industry - OR - Two years' experience as a department manager with responsibility for managing a department/team within a multi-department operation within the retail or high-volume service industry
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree is preferred
  • Strong customer service and supervisory skills
  • Perishable inventory management (no exceptions)
  • Solid understanding of overall store operations
  • Proven ability to demonstrate strong leadership skills
  • Will be required to repeatedly use hands, arms, legs, and feet for sustained action (e.g. walking around the store, stocking, rotating product).
  • Ability to stand 100% of the shift and work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Schedule writing
  • Inventory Ordering
  • Shrink Management
  • 2+ Years experience managing in a food-based industry
  • Union experience

Travel: May be required to travel for training or participation in corporate programs and focus groups. Additionally, travel to other stores to assist when necessary, may be required. Respond to: Interested candidates are encouraged to submit a resume by visiting: www.albertsonscompanies.com/careers

Schedules: With many of our stores operating 24 hours per day, interested applicants must allow for a variety of shifts and long hours including nights, holidays, and weekends. Days off during the work week are seldom taken consecutively. As an Assistant Store Director, a significant portion of your day will be spent on the sales floor managing employees and interacting with customers.

title: Business Analyst WMS
description:
Are you ready to combine your passion for IT and logistics in the dynamic role of Business Analyst WMS?


As an international extension of our central IT department in Belgium, we are looking for a Business Analyst to join our team on-site in Frankfurt, Germany.


Discover below the challenges and rewards that come with this role at H.Essers.


YOUR CHALLENGES


You will play a unique role in the team, as you will work from Germany and interact closely with the Belgian IT department of H.Essers. Your focus as a Business Analyst will be in Germany and occasionally you will engage in other projects in the broader European area. In this interesting key position, you will become the main point of contact for all questions and issues regarding the local warehouse management systems. Monitoring and supporting the existing systems but also providing training and troubleshooting assistance – as needed – will be part of your responsibility. What makes your job interesting is the great variety on the one hand but also the fact that you are a liaison between different stakeholders. After all, you are the bridge between the customer, the operational teams within H.Essers and the technical support team to build solutions in the in-house developed warehouse/transport management systems. In addition, you can use your creativity and analytical mind to contribute to discussions on the future direction of these applications.


More specifically, what can you expect from this opportunity?


  • Close collaboration with your Belgian colleagues from the IT department to analyze and improve the H.Essers warehousing and transportation systems.
  • Engaging and working together with several internal and external stakeholders to identify business requirements and develop solutions that meet their needs.
  • Lead or support the implementation of improvement projects to optimize warehousing and transportation processes.
  • Monitoring and troubleshooting IT systems related to warehousing and transportation will also be an important aspect of your job.
  • As a change of pace, you will team up with the IT department to provide basic infrastructure support, such as setting up new hardware and troubleshooting network issues, and provide technical support and training to end-users.
  • Coordinating projects in collaboration with external parties is one of your strengths.
  • This is an on-site position in Frankfurt.


YOUR TALENTS


  • You have a master’s degree (or equivalent to experience) in Management, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • In addition, you have minimum 2 years of experience in IT support or a related field.
  • German and English at C1/C2 level are mandatory requirements for this role.
  • Thanks to your analytical insights, strong problem-solving mindset and outstanding communication and collaboration skills you make the difference.
  • Working independently and managing multiple tasks simultaneously offers you the variety you need.
  • If you already have knowledge of warehousing or transportation systems and you are familiar with basic infrastructure tasks, then this will be a great asset.
  • Experience in the logistics or supply chain management area is an added benefit.
  • You excel in stakeholder management, effectively engaging and communicating with various stakeholders to ensure project success.


YOUR REWARDS


  • Of course you have an attractive salary package.
  • You can also count on a very extensive leave scheme and the possibility to work from home maximum two days a week.
  • Supported by our vision of ‘Lifelong Learning’, the H.Essers Academy offers you a free choice of various training courses that contribute to your personal development.
  • Your physical and mental health are strengthened through H.Essers’ Fit2Grow health program.
  • Your greatest asset is undoubtedly your place within the close-knit H.Essers family.


7000 REASONS TO CHOOSE H.ESSERS


  • Family values: have provided a strong foundation of trust and commitment for both employees and customers since 1928
  • Job security: in a rapidly changing world
  • Ambitious team: with 7000 dedicated colleagues, we strive for excellence and have an abundance of ambition and opportunity
  • Innovation: in our processes and services, enabling us to serve our customers ever more efficiently and sustainably
  • Sustainable international growth: recognizing our social, economic, and environmental responsibilities as an organization to have a positive impact on society as a whole
  • Diversity and inclusion: are crucial to a healthy and productive work environment and are actively embraced within H.Essers


These are just a few reasons why H.Essers is an attractive choice, we are eager to discover your reason(s).

title: Manager, Patient Advocacy
description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. Our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission\: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

Position Summary

The Manager of Patient Advocacy provides leadership to City of Hope’s Patient Advocacy team and serves as an important liaison between patients, families, physicians, staff and organizational leadership. In this highly visible role, you will help ensure that complex patient concerns and grievances are addressed thoughtfully, thoroughly and in a timely manner.

You will oversee patient advocacy services across inpatient, outpatient and community practice settings while partnering with clinical and operational leaders to resolve concerns, identify opportunities for improvement and strengthen the overall patient experience. This is an opportunity to combine leadership, advocacy, problem-solving and healthcare expertise to make a meaningful impact for patients and families.

As a successful candidate, you will\:

  • Recruit, train, mentor and manage the Patient Advocacy team, creating an environment that supports professional growth and achievement.
  • Oversee the timely investigation and resolution of patient and patient-representative complaints and grievances across the enterprise.
  • Coordinate sensitive physician reassignment requests while maintaining privacy and following City of Hope guidelines.
  • Partner with physicians and the Medical Group on complex patient discharge matters, including investigation, coaching and formal patient communications.
  • Categorize, analyze, trend and report data related to complaints and grievances, using findings to recommend opportunities for organizational improvement.
  • Represent Patient Advocacy on key organizational committees and collaborate with stakeholders focused on quality, ethics, patient experience and performance improvement.
  • Partner closely with Risk Management, Quality and Human Resources on sensitive concerns involving patients, families, employees, contractors and physicians.
  • Serve as a resource for staff and physicians regarding complaint and grievance processes, helping maximize patient satisfaction, reduce liability risk and maintain regulatory compliance.

  • Collaborate across the organization to help ensure patients and families receive responsive, compassionate and effective support.

Job Description: As a primary contact for customers, the Grocery Fourth/Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

  • Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

  • Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.

  • Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

  • Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

  • Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.

title: Material Planner
description:
About the role

Project North PES is Pangeo's new aluminum die casting and machining plant in Vaughan, Ontario. As Logistics Coordinator, you turn customer demand, internal capacity, and inventory status into executable production plans, and you keep material moving end to end from supplier and inbound logistics through production to on-time shipment and customer delivery.

This is a coordination-heavy role at the hub of the plant's material, production, and logistics flow. You'll set and adjust the schedule, issue internal and supplier orders, coordinate transportation, act as a direct point of contact for the production line on order status, and report clearly on plan attainment, delivery, and fulfillment. It suits someone highly organized and data-minded who coordinates well across teams and partners under time pressure.


Capacity Evaluation and Production Planning

  • Regularly evaluate internal production capacity and inventory levels against customer demand, and develop, adjust, and issue internal production plans to meet delivery requirements.
  • Develop production schedules and work orders in coordination with the production team.
  • Conduct capacity and workload analyses and adjust production plans accordingly.
  • Apply lean scheduling principles to optimize shop-floor sequencing and minimize waste.


Internal Coordination and Scheduling

  • Issue internal production instructions and coordinate scheduling and handoffs across processes and work cells.
  • Promptly address production exceptions and scheduling disruptions to keep production plans on track.
  • Organize and lead production coordination meetings and weekly production review meetings.


Supplier Material Ordering and Tracking

  • Issue bulk material purchase orders to suppliers based on agreed delivery terms and production requirements, and monitor and follow up on order status.
  • Ensure material availability to support volume production while avoiding excessive inventory accumulation.


Transportation and Customs Coordination

  • Coordinate inbound and outbound ocean, air, and ground transportation, including delivery appointments and shipment schedules.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and overseas suppliers to monitor shipment status and coordinate customs clearance.
  • Ensure customs documentation is accurate and complete, and arrange for the timely return of empty containers before free-time deadlines to avoid detention and demurrage charges.
  • Track inbound and outbound shipments, proactively resolve transportation delays, and monitor carrier performance and freight costs.


Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Compile and analyze production plan attainment, delivery performance, and inventory data, and provide timely reports.
  • Track operational anomalies and corrective actions through to resolution.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by providing data-driven recommendations to improve scheduling efficiency.


What we're looking for

  • Planning discipline. You balance demand, capacity, and inventory into a workable schedule.
  • Coordination. You keep processes, suppliers, carriers, and brokers aligned and handoffs clean.
  • Responsiveness. You catch and resolve exceptions before they hit delivery.
  • Data sense. You turn plan and delivery data into clear reporting and action.
  • Detail and improvement mindset. You keep things accurate and always look to tighten the flow.


Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. Minimum 2 years’ experience in a manufacturing and warehouse environment, including assembly/production planning, production coordination, material handling, and order fulfillment.
  • Experience with a multinational or foreign-invested manufacturer.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups), and working knowledge of SAP or another ERP and WMS.
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills, with strong interpersonal skills to communicate across departments and levels.
  • Strong written and verbal English skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to collaborate well with team members.
  • Strong attention to detail, the ability to multitask, and a high level of accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • English required, Mandarin an asset.


Working conditions

  • On-site at the Vaughan, Ontario plant, with regular time on the production floor.
  • Standard business hours.
  • Travel not typically required.


Equal opportunity & accessibility

Pangeo Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, family status, or disability.

Accommodations are available on request throughout the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

AI in hiring: We use artificial intelligence to screen and assess applications for this posting, in accordance with the job-posting disclosure requirements of Ontario's Employment Standards Act.

The compensation range above reflects the expected total compensation for this position, inclusive of performance bonus and standard employee benefits, and is provided in accordance with Ontario pay transparency requirements. Actual offers may vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity.

title: Superviseur(e) contrôle d’inventaire et analyse / Supervisor, Inventory Control and Analysis
description:
Bouclair est une entreprise fièrement québécoise, qui depuis les 50 dernières années, est reconnue pour son expertise dans la décoration intérieure et l’ameublement tendance à prix abordables.

Dynamique et en pleine croissance, Bouclair compte aujourd’hui 50 magasins à travers le pays, où travailler ensemble dans un esprit de collaboration et de respect est essentiel. Nous offrons un environnement stimulant où la créativité et l’humain occupent une place centrale, et où design et expérience client se conjuguent pour créer une atmosphère accueillante et conviviale.

Nous sommes fiers d’accueillir de nouvelles personnes motivées et impliquées, et nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un talent pour occuper le poste suivant :


SUPERVISEUR(E), CONTRÔLE D’INVENTAIRE ET ANALYSE

À titre de Superviseur(e), contrôle d’inventaire et analyse, tu joueras un rôle clé pour assurer que les bons produits se trouvent au bon endroit et que les données d’inventaire reflètent fidèlement la réalité sur le terrain. Tu contribueras également à une gestion rigoureuse des stocks, en maintenant des niveaux optimaux afin de minimiser les coûts d’entreposage, d’éviter les ruptures de stock et les achats excédentaires, ainsi que de contrôler les pertes.

Tu t’engageras aussi dans l’amélioration continue et l’optimisation des processus, et seras responsable des volets reporting, réconciliation, analyse et prévisions. Nous cherchons une personne prête à retrousser ses manches et à être sur le terrain, tout en possédant un solide esprit d’analyse et de bonnes connaissances en comptabilité. Si tu aimes autant le terrain que les chiffres, et que tu as de l’expérience en commerce de détail, ce poste est fait pour toi !


CE QUE TU FERAS AU QUOTIDIEN

  • Analyser les ajustements d’inventaire (magasins et entrepôt) pour identifier les sources de pertes et les pistes d’amélioration procédurale ;
  • Réconcilier les inventaires du centre de distribution avec les systèmes (Solo-MMS) et corriger les erreurs, ainsi que trouver les sources afin de prévenir leur récurrence ;
  • S’assurer de l’exactitude des transactions d’inventaire au système pour permettre une meilleure compréhension et prévision des pertes; évaluer la valeur des stocks ainsi que l’âge des items en inventaire ;
  • Organiser et coordonner le décompte physique annuel d’inventaire du centre de distribution ;
  • Réviser les processus pour garantir la validité de l’inventaire de l’entrepôt et optimiser l’utilisation des ressources ;
  • Documenter les procédures liées à la gestion de l’inventaire ;
  • Participer aux réunions mensuelles et collaborer avec l’entrepôt pour tous les projets ayant un impact sur l’inventaire ;
  • Participer à la réconciliation des décomptes physiques en magasin et analyser les écarts au besoin ;
  • Préparer la base de données utilisée par la firme externe pour les décomptes annuels des magasins ;

title: Analyst, Florist Operations Analytics
description:

  • 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, operational reporting, business analytics, or a related field.

Apply today and help us turn data into actionable insights!

title: Vacation Relief Operator - Milk
description:
Bellevue Milk Plant is looking for Vacation Relief Production Workers. The position will be onsite and based in Bellevue, WA.

Position Purpose

Provide flexible production and operational support across the Bellevue Milk Plant by assisting production teams with break relief, vacation and absentee coverage, material handling, and general line support.

This position is designed to improve staffing flexibility, maintain production continuity, reduce interruptions, and support efficient operation across all production areas.

Primary Responsibilities

  1. Break Relief & Staffing Coverage
    • Provide scheduled break and lunch relief for production employees across assigned production lines.
    • Cover positions during employee absences, call-outs, vacations, and other staffing shortages.
    • Become familiar with multiple production positions to provide flexible coverage where needed.

    • Maintain production continuity during employee transitions and shift changes.

  2. Production Line Support
    • Deliver raw materials, ingredients, and packaging supplies to production lines as needed.
    • Remove empty pallets, packaging waste, and unused materials from production areas.
    • Assist with staging materials and ensuring lines have the necessary supplies to maintain continuous operation.
    • Support operators with routine production activities, changeovers, and line preparation.
    • Assist with maintaining organized, clean, and safe production areas.

    • Identify and communicate material shortages, equipment issues, and potential production interruptions.

  3. Cross-Functional Production Support
    • Provide assistance across Gallon, Half Gallon, Pint, and Cottage Cheese production areas.
    • Support production teams wherever additional help is needed.
    • Assist with startup activities, product changeovers, and end-of-run activities within assigned training and qualifications.
    • Support material movement and finished-product flow as assigned.
    • Assist with general housekeeping and operational organization.

    • Perform other production-related duties as assigned by Production Supervision.

Safety & Quality Expectations

  • Follow all plant safety, food safety, GMP, and sanitation requirements.
  • Follow established operating procedures for assigned production positions.
  • Operate forklifts and other powered equipment only when properly trained and authorized.
  • Maintain awareness of product quality and immediately communicate potential quality or food safety concerns.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment.

Expected Results

  • Improved production continuity and reduced interruptions during breaks.
  • Better coverage during vacations, call-offs, and staffing shortages.
  • Reduced downtime associated with material shortages and handling.
  • Improved material availability and production line support.
  • Greater flexibility across production departments.
  • Improved overall production efficiency and teamwork.

Operating Principle

  • The Relief & Line Support Operator is a flexible, cross-trained production resource whose primary responsibility is to support continuous plant operations.
  • This position moves between production areas based on operational needs, providing break relief, staffing coverage, material handling, and hands-on production support wherever the greatest need exists.

title: Senior Vice President - Operations
description:
Farmers for Forests (F4F) is seeking a full-time employee for the Senior Vice President - Operations position to manage field operations in the organization. The role will support the COO in managing the operations team and the VPRC in field data collection.


Position:


The Senior Vice President - Operations will be based at our head office in Pune and will be responsible for ensuring that all field operations at F4F run smoothly and efficiently across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Karnataka, where we currently operate. The day-to-day role will involve managing field teams, procurement, inventory management, quality implementation, SOP adherence and government relations. This position involves significant travel. We will only consider applicants who can travel or spend at least 70% of their time in field locations. You will also work closely with local implementation partners and our government partners in district administrations and the forest department.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Operations Strategy and Scale: Lead the overall operations strategy and build systems that enable F4F to scale projects efficiently across geographies.

  • End-to-End Operations: Oversee the complete project lifecycle, from planning and budgeting to implementation, monitoring, quality assurance and closure.
  • Client and Stakeholder Management: Lead relationships with key clients, donors, investors and implementation partners, ensuring timely delivery, satisfaction and resolution of escalations.
  • Budget and Cost Management: Drive effective budget planning, plan-versus-actual tracking and cost optimization to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets.
  • Procurement and Supply Chain: Oversee procurement strategy, vendor management, inventory and logistics to ensure timely availability of quality inputs at optimal costs.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Ensure seamless coordination between Operations, Finance, Procurement, Technology, Biodiversity, Carbon and Fundraising teams for effective project delivery.
  • Risk Management and Problem Solving: Identify operational risks and bottlenecks proactively and lead timely interventions, escalations and solutions to ensure business continuity.

Requirements:

  • Entrepreneurial, self-motivated and operates with a growth mindset.

  • Passionate about rural development, ecological restoration and fighting climate change.
  • Enjoys working with a diverse set of people, managing large teams and collaborating with others.
  • Comfortable taking on all types of tasks, including unglamorous and menial ones, and is humble, generous and kind.

title: D365 FinOps Consultant
description:

title: Analyst/Sr. Analyst, Operations
description:
About the team:


The Operations team at OakNorth's Gurgaon office is the backbone of our deposit products business. We manage the full lifecycle of retail deposit accounts - from onboarding through to maturity - and act as the primary point of contact for UK-based customers. As an Analyst or Senior Analyst in Operations, you'll be responsible for processing and managing retail deposit accounts across their full lifecycle - including account creation, payment processing, documentation validation, and customer communications. This role has a direct impact on the experience of thousands of savers who trust OakNorth to handle their money with precision and care.

  • Familiarity with banking terminology and payment schemes (e.g. CHAPS, BACS, Faster Payments).

title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Finance & Strategy - Transportation
description:
The Senior Analyst, Commercial Finance & Strategy - Transportation provides critical financial support and actionable insights for JD Group North America’s Supply Chain and Transportation functions. title: Corporate Order Processor

title: Sourcing Specialist Industry
description:
Sourcing Specialist Industry

Germany

Position overview

The Sourcing Specialist works closely with supply partners to keep Optimas International competitive in a changing market.

The Sourcing Specialist is responsible for supporting global sourcing activities by identifying and evaluating suppliers to ensure continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, and service excellence. The role involves RFQ management, supplier communication, market research, data analysis, and cross-functional coordination to support business objectives and customer requirements.

This role plays a key part in driving sourcing efficiency through effective management of unit pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQ), lead times and supplier performance to support total cost of acquisition and operational efficiency. If you’re an experienced sourcing professional looking to contribute within a fast paced, collaborative environment with strong opportunities for professional growth and impact, Optimas is the place to advance your career.

The Sourcing Specialist will report onto the NBS & Sourcing Director.

Main responsibilities:

  • Prepare and issue RFQ packages while managing sourcing events through completion.
  • Maintain sourcing databases, pricing records, and supplier documentation, building commercial and technical insights to support sourcing and resourcing decisions.
  • Track sourcing progress and provide regular status updates.
  • Resolve supplier-related and market pricing issues through proactive supplier engagement and internal coordination.
  • Manage minimum order quantities (MOQ), lead times, and inventory considerations to support operational efficiency and free cash flow objectives.
  • Work closely with cross functional teams to help identify, evaluate, and deliver cost reduction opportunities that add value to the business and customers.
  • Contribute to the execution and continuous improvement of sourcing strategies using market pricing trends, supplier intelligence and commercial analysis.
  • Build collaborative and professional relationships with supply partners and internal customer-facing teams.
  • Coordinate with Optimas support teams to ensure clear communication and effective delivery of sourcing activities.

Key Competencies:

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Results & data driven mindset with focus on delivering commercial value.
  • An openness to change, with the ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication and influencing skills across cross functional teams.
  • Proactive problem-solving approach with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Independent thinking with attention to detail.
  • Strong team player with ability to contribute positively to shared goals and outcomes.

Skills and Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, operations, business or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in sourcing and procurement for Industrial Fastener Products; ideally for the following verticals: Off-Highway, HDT, Power & Energy and Industrial Equipment & Robotics

Soft skills and mindset:

  • Operational excellence: You are hands-on, detail-oriented, and thrive in executing end-to-end sourcing projects.
  • Autonomy & ownership: You take initiative, manage your priorities independently, and drive projects to completion.

About us

United by our mission to ‘Make the Complex Simple', we connect some of the world's most recognised brands with consumers across retail, media, and premium environments. We're the UK's leading magazine distribution business and a leading retail solutions partner across publishing and home entertainment, made up of three business units - Frontline Distribution Solutions, Frontline Retail Solutions, and Gold Key Media.

Through our three business units, we deliver market-leading solutions across publishing, home entertainment, and global brand engagement. From managing the retail journey for iconic titles like Vogue, Grazia, Radio Times and Good Housekeeping, as well as leading children's brands such as Pokémon, Frozen and Barbie, to working with major publishers, film and music studios, and leading UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons and Waitrose, we play a critical role in bringing products to market. Our reach also extends to premium global environments, with brand placements across major travel hubs, four- and five-star hotels, airport lounges, and internationally renowned events - partnering with world-leading hospitality venues to engage high-value audiences.

Whether it's magazines, collectibles, books, music, film, or global brand campaigns, we combine deep industry expertise, strong partnerships, and innovative execution to deliver commercial success for our clients.

Our Culture

title: Senior Analyst, Logistics & Materials Management
description:
About Us
Solar Landscape is the nation’s leading distributed energy infrastructure company, transforming commercial real estate into a source of new power by deploying solar and storage at scale. Partnering with more than 170+ commercial real estate owners, the company develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed energy projects that deliver new capacity to the grid in as little as 12 months while generating long-term income for commercial and industrial property owners.

Proven by our performance, backed by institutional capital, and trusted by the biggest names in commercial real estate, we’re building the future of energy, and it shows:


  • Recognized by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. in 2025
  • Named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies
  • Ranked the #1 commercial rooftop solar developer by Solar Power World in both 2025 and 2026



That doesn’t happen without a team of smart, driven, and down-to-earth people who are serious about doing excellent work—and fun to work with. At Solar Landscape, you’ll be challenged, trusted with responsibility, and surrounded by people who thrive in our fast-paced environment. Career growth here isn’t limited by title or a rigid path: people who take ownership and deliver are given opportunities to stretch, lead, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll be supported by great benefits, professional development, and a culture that values authenticity, collaboration, and accountability.

Across our headquarters in Asbury Park, New Jersey and our offices in New York City, Chicago, and Baltimore, Solar Landscape employees are building something that matters, deploying critical energy infrastructure that creates long-term value for communities, property owners, and the grid. Come join us.

About The Role
We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Logistics & Materials Management Analyst to support our Supply Chain & Logistics team. This role will coordinate inbound logistics, support warehouse and 3PL operations, maintain inventory accuracy and visibility, and contribute to operational reporting and process improvements. The Analyst will work with Procurement, Logistics, Construction, Finance, and warehouse partners to support reliable material flow to projects.

  • Coordinate inbound logistics, including shipment scheduling, tracking, warehouse receiving readiness, and resolution of delivery issues. Provide backup support for outbound transportation and carrier coordination as needed
  • Support day-to-day warehouse and 3PL operations, including receiving, storage, inventory movements, staging, and operational issue resolution
  • Maintain inventory accuracy and visibility through regular reconciliations, cycle counts, discrepancy resolution, and tracking of inventory quantities, locations, and allocation status
  • Monitor warehouse capacity, inventory availability, and material readiness to identify potential shortages, storage constraints, and other risks to project execution
  • Support the development and maintenance of operational reporting and KPIs, including inventory accuracy, warehouse utilization, 3PL performance, and inbound/outbound activity
  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse, inventory, and logistics processes, including supporting system enhancements, data accuracy, and standardized workflows



Required Qualifications

  • Two or more years of relevant experience in supply chain, warehousing, inventory management, distribution, or logistics preferred
  • Working knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory controls, transportation coordination, or 3PL management
  • Strong analytical and Excel skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, interpret operational data, and identify improvements
  • Experience using ERP, WMS, inventory management, or shipment tracking systems
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and coordinate across multiple teams



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Zoho, Power BI, or comparable systems
  • Familiarity with solar, construction materials, or project-based supply chain operations
  • Experience developing operational KPIs, improving processes, or supporting inventory reconciliation initiatives



Work Environment

  • Hybrid or in-office work, depending on project requirements
  • Fast-paced and dynamic work setting, focused on renewable energy and sustainability



Benefits And Perks
We offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work:


  • Training / Professional development opportunities
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Summer Fridays
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work options
  • Paid parental leave
  • Team lunches, events, and stocked kitchens
  • Modern, collaborative office spaces in Asbury Park, New York City, Boston, Chicago, and Baltimore
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance

Solar Landscape is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@solarlandscape.com.

title: Commodities Analyst- Capital Markets Analyst Program
description:
Zions Bancorporation’s Capital Markets Analyst Program positions are not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H-1B visa). This includes, for example, situations where a candidate may have temporary work authorization while enrolled in school or upon graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT) but would need H-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment in order to maintain employment eligibility.

Zions Bancorporation (NASDAQ\: ZION) is one of the nation’s premier financial services companies operating as a collection of great banks under local brands and management teams in high-growth western markets. Zions is regularly recognized by American Banker as one of the “Best Banks to Work For” and as having a top banking team in its list of “The Most Powerful Women in Banking.” Our customers consistently vote us as the best bank in our local markets.

We value our employees, and we are committed to search out, recognize, and create fulfilling opportunities for outstanding people within our organization, rewarding them for their contributions to our success. We recognize that banking is a “local” business, and that to be successful, we must have very strong ties to the communities we serve and strong relationships with our customers.

Zions Capital Markets

Zions Capital Markets (“ZCM”) operates as a division of Zions Bancorporation and comprises five product areas that operate as a unified, national platform with deep regional expertise. Our teams collaborate to deliver targeted, client-driven solutions to help companies raise capital and execute strategic transactions efficiently and effectively.

  • Investment Banking\: Provides advisory and execution services, specializing in mergers and acquisitions (sell-side/buy-side transactions), capital raising, and strategic advisory. Customized engagements assist clients in achieving strategic milestones throughout their business lifecycle, including growth and transition strategies, with meticulous attention to detail and process
  • Debt Capital Markets\: Provides debt solutions to clients through Loan Syndications and Securities Underwriting. Loan Syndications structures and arranges multi-bank credit facilities ranging in sizes from $50MM to $1B+. Securities Underwriting* provides execution capabilities for capital raising activities including underwriting debt and equity for public and private securities issuances
  • Power & Project Finance\: Originates and executes custom financing solutions for owners of power generation assets and power-related infrastructure projects across the U.S. via a specialized team of experienced industry experts
  • Real Estate Capital Markets\: Provides nationwide direct lending solutions across the commercial real estate lifecycle through two primary lending platforms\: CMBS Lending and Agency Lending (Fannie Mae DUS and Freddie Mac Optigo). The team directly originates and underwrites fixed-rate commercial and multifamily mortgage loans, delivering non-recourse financing solutions for income producing commercial real estate. Through its CMBS platform, RECM originates loans for securitization, while its Agency platform provides multifamily financing through Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac programs.
  • Sales & Trading\: Provides a full array of foreign exchange, commodities and interest rate risk management solutions to assist clients with managing exposure to changes in price volatility in the market

Our approach is simple - help companies we know well connect with and tell their story to investors and capital providers we also know well.

Investment banking and securities underwriting activities are offered through Zions Direct, Inc., member FINRA / SIPC. For more information, please see our website at www.zionscapitalmarkets.com.

Full-Time Capital Markets Analyst Program\:

The ZCM 2-year Analyst Program offers a unique experience to join a rapidly growing platform and team. The program offers the opportunity to maximize Analysts’ potential in these early professional years, providing foundational knowledge, skills, and experiences that will last a professional lifetime. Analysts will immediately take an active role within their team (while completing a formal training program), working alongside seasoned banking professionals to successfully meet the needs of our clients.

The Commodity Derivatives desk, within the Sales and Trading business in Zions Capital Markets, is responsible for advising, pricing, and hedging commodity price risk for our reserve based lending (Oil and Gas), energy consumers, metals, and agriculture clients of the bank. The analyst will play a critical role in supporting senior marketers throughout the lifecycle of the deal process, including pitch book creation, market updates, deal pricing updates, etc. facilitating the delivery of hedging products to clients.

Location\:

Zions Capital Markets has offices throughout the U.S. including in Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, Houston, Charlotte, and Fort Lauderdale.

Zions Capital Markets has analyst openings in the following groups\:

  • Debt Capital Markets, Syndicated & Leveraged Finance – Los Angeles and Houston
  • Debt Capital Markets, Securities Underwriting – Los Angeles
  • Investment Banking – Houston
  • Sales & Trading, Commodities – Charlotte
  • Real Estate Capital Markets – Fort Lauderdale or Charlotte

Zions Capital Markets is looking for candidates who have\:

  • Completed BA/BS degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, and/or related majors, with a scheduled graduation prior to the annual June 7th start date
  • Overall GPA of 3.5 or above
  • Strong interest in finance and capital markets
  • High degree of academic and extracurricular achievement

  • Solid leadership and interpersonal skills
  • Superior written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Comfortable working with peers at all levels, ranging from fellow analysts through Managing Directors

Benefits\:

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
We are looking for a resourceful generalist who enjoys figuring things out and getting work done.


You will work directly with the founders on business priorities spanning research, marketing, growth experiments, coordination, and operations. Your work could involve researching a new tool, fixing an operational bottleneck, testing a growth idea, or coordinating a project across teams.


You should be comfortable taking a problem, researching possible solutions, choosing an approach, and driving it through to completion. Using AI tools effectively to get work done is a must-have requirement.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Work directly with the founders to execute business priorities and solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Take ownership of varied tasks from understanding the objective through execution, verification, and closure.
  • Research unfamiliar problems, evaluate possible solutions, and implement practical fixes.
