  • Verify AI-generated outputs for accuracy and usefulness before putting them into action.
  • Help execute marketing initiatives, growth experiments, competitor research, and new business ideas.
  • Identify gaps in existing processes and introduce improvements that save time or improve results.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and external partners to keep projects moving.
  • Learn new tools and workflows independently as tasks require.
  • Track progress, follow through on dependencies, and communicate outcomes clearly.


What We're Looking For:

  • At least 1 year of full-time professional experience, excluding internships.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to complete real work. You should be able to explain what you used them for and what you delivered.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn information into action.
  • A willingness to work across marketing, growth, operations, and other business needs.
  • The ability to learn unfamiliar tools and concepts quickly.
  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, documents, presentations, and digital tools.
  • The judgment to work independently and flag decisions, access requirements, or blockers early when needed.


The Mindset That Matters:


When given an unfamiliar task, your instinct should be: "Let me figure out how to get this done."


We expect you to investigate, try solutions, and keep moving without needing instructions for every step. When you need help, bring the context, what you have already tried, and a recommended next step. Own the task until the result has been checked and the work is complete.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www.spreetail.com.



Work Your Way:


At Spreetail, we believe in empowering our employees to work in the way that suits them best through our Work Your Way approach. Each team member has the flexibility to choose where they work most effectively each week—whether that's from home, a coffee shop, or the office. While flexibility is key, we also value the power of in-person connection. That’s why we bring our corporate team together in Lincoln each quarter for a week of intentional collaboration, team building, community engagement, and our All-Hands meeting. It’s the best of both worlds: the freedom to work your way, with meaningful opportunities to connect and grow together. Please scroll to the bottom of the job posting to confirm that your state qualifies for the Work Your Way program.



Spreetail is looking for a Senior Analyst who drives results that impact our larger goals, owns their work and outcomes, and is eager to advance quickly, with the opportunity to earn two promotions in 3-5 years. In this role, you'll design and manage advanced analytics models and tools, like our Supply Chain Dashboard, to automate reporting, predict key fulfillment metrics a year or more in advance, and deliver data-driven insights that optimize fulfillment center labor and operations. You'll also partner across teams from Site Directors to FP&A, build solutions that scale, and mentor entry-level analysts to foster a culture of excellence and continuous learning.

In addition to a generous vacation policy, we also offer paid time-off for your wedding week, paid parental leave and support for parents of growing families.


• We celebrate accomplishments. Each year at Spreetail is a milestone with the opportunity to receive special gifts, swag store credit, or donations to a nonprofit of your choice. We also recognize people pursuing impacts with Spreetail Spotlight Awards.

We offer affordable medical, dental and vision plans with coast-to-coast coverage. We also provide free telehealth and on-demand mental health resources.


• We create the opportunity to revolutionize your community. We encourage Spreetailers to give back and make a social impact, and we offer paid time off to do it.

Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

title: L2 Soc Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities:


  • Investigate and handle security alerts and incidents escalated from L1 SOC Analysts.
  • Perform security event analysis, threat identification, and incident impact assessment.
  • Conduct incident response activities, including containment, eradication, and recovery recommendations.
  • Perform proactive threat hunting using SIEM, EDR, and network security tools.
  • Analyze IoCs, TTPs, and attacker behaviors using the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
  • Perform log analysis, threat intelligence analysis, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Identify security gaps and recommend improvements to SIEM detection rules and monitoring capabilities.
  • Prepare incident investigation reports, threat hunting reports, and security recommendations.
  • Coordinate with client IT and security teams regarding incident response and remediation activities.


Requirements:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in SOC, Blue Team, or Cybersecurity Operations, with at least 1 year in L2 SOC or Incident Response.
  • Strong understanding of network security, TCP/IP, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, DNS, and OSI Layers.
  • Good knowledge of Windows and Linux Server security, system logs, and application logs.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as ELK Stack, Wazuh, or equivalent.
  • Experience in security incident investigation, alert triage, log analysis, and incident response.
  • Understanding of threat hunting methodologies, MITRE ATT&CK Framework, IoCs, and TTPs.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability assessment tools such as Nessus, OpenVAS, or Qualys.
  • Knowledge of Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), OSINT, and MISP is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively in a SOC environment.


Preferred Certifications


  • CompTIA CySA+
  • GIAC GCIH / GCIA
  • Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1)
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Other relevant cybersecurity certifications.

title: Corporate Administration Executive
description:
At Wellversed, we are committed to fostering growth, innovation, and operational excellence. We are looking for a highly motivated, detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support leadership and core teams by managing travel, calendars, vendors, documentation, and day-to-day administrative operations with precision and ownership.


Responsibilities:

  • Administrative Operations: Handle routine administrative requests, correspondence, data entry, document circulation, printing, scanning, filing, and coordination with internal teams. Track tasks, deadlines, and pending issues, escalating delays when required.
  • Travel, Visa & Hospitality: Coordinate travel bookings, accommodation, transport, itineraries, visa documentation, appointments, and visitor arrangements. Track expenses, cancellations, and reimbursements, ensuring all bookings have prior approval and comply with company policies.
  • Vendor Sourcing & Procurement: Identify vendors and service providers, obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, and coordinate purchase requisitions, purchase orders, work orders, invoices, deliveries, and payment follow-ups. Maintain vendor records and ensure approvals and budget limits are followed.
  • Meetings & Site Visits: Schedule meetings, appointments, and site visits; confirm availability, venues, visitor access, attendance, materials, and transport. Maintain records and follow up on assigned action items.
  • Workplace & Office Administration: Coordinate workspace, meeting rooms, visitor access, internet, facilities, housekeeping, security, and IT requirements. Monitor stationery, consumables, stock registers, and replenishment; report maintenance issues and support office setup, relocation, and onboarding logistics.
  • Local Outreach & Ground Operations: Research and contact local vendors, agencies, businesses, and service providers. Coordinate local purchases, deliveries, transport, site visits, and other ground activities; verify service completion and resolve or escalate execution issues.
  • Documentation, Data & Reporting: Maintain accurate administrative records, vendor databases, contact lists, invoices, quotations, travel and reimbursement documents, and operational trackers. Update dashboards and prepare status reports on completed tasks, pending actions, expenses, and issues while protecting confidential information.
  • Stakeholder Follow-ups: Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to track commitments, approvals, deliveries, and documentation. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly, escalate delays promptly, and close tasks only after confirming completion and updating records.
  • Process Improvement: Follow SOPs, checklists, and approval workflows. Maintain process documentation, identify recurring inefficiencies or documentation gaps, and suggest practical improvements to strengthen accountability and operational efficiency.


Skills Required:

  • Strong organisational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
  • Effective communication, coordination, and follow-up abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, including spreadsheets, email, documents, and calendars.
  • Attention to detail in documentation, bookings, and financial records.
  • Basic knowledge of administration, procurement, vendor management, and travel coordination.
  • Cost-conscious decision-making and the ability to work independently within approval processes.
  • Professionalism, confidentiality, accountability, and a proactive, service-oriented approach.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Graduate in any discipline; a degree in Business Administration, Travel Diploma, IATA Certification, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in administration, operations, office coordination, procurement, travel coordination, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience in vendor coordination, cross-functional communication, and maintaining operational trackers is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, email, documentation, and digital record management is essential.

title: Teaching Coordinator (Adults)
description:
Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract, 2 years


Closing Date: Monday, 30th November 2026 - 23:59 Malaysia Time (GMT +8)


Role Purpose:


The role is responsible for promoting high-quality English language teaching and effective learning while supporting the British Council's wider objectives and cultural relations mission. It involves guiding, supporting, and developing teachers in delivering a full range of courses, providing training, coordinating and developing teaching materials, and contributing to the management of teaching quality, academic programme content, and day-to-day operations.


Role Accountabilities:

  • The role is responsible for delivering high-quality English language teaching in line with British Council Global Teaching Standards, meeting learner needs and supporting the organisation's global English strategy.
  • Key responsibilities include teaching across various course types, developing teaching and assessment materials, supporting teacher development through training and lesson observations, line-managing teachers, assisting with teacher recruitment and talent retention, and deputising for Senior Teachers when required.
  • The role also involves contributing to teaching centre operations, administrative duties, continuous professional development, and the sharing of best practices, while promoting the British Council's reputation in English language teaching and ensuring compliance with safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI), and health and safety policies.


Role specific skills, knowledge and experience:


Essential Requirements:

  • Cambridge DELTA/DipTESOL or Trinity Cert TESOL.
  • At least one further specialist qualification, such as YL extension to CELTA, IELTS examiner status, e-moderator certificate.
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent.
  • As appropriate within Global British Council Teaching Standards at a Higher level.
  • Demonstrate subject knowledge.
  • Engage and motivate learners.
  • Create a positive and inclusive learning environment.
  • Plan and deliver coherent lessons.
  • Make use of assessment and feedback.
  • Manage teaching and learning resources.
  • Uphold professional responsibilities and values.
  • Evidence of high performance in class (from evaluations, observation reports, feedback).
  • Ability, or demonstrable interest in at least some of the following: syllabus design, teacher timetabling, class scheduling, course planning, teacher observations, teacher training, line management and professional development of teachers.
  • Ability to work in a way that promotes the safety and well-being of children and vulnerable adults.
  • Effective communication and engagement with children/protected adults and their families.
  • Knowledge and understanding of child development and its impact on learning and behaviour.
  • Experience of supporting learners to meet Equality, Diversity and Inclusion principles.
  • 4 years post-certificate i.e. CELTA/Trinity Cert TESOL experience including substantial experience in all of the following.
  • Young learners aged 800+ hours.
  • Adults English 1500+ hours, including IELTS.
  • At least 2 years experience in training and mentoring teachers.
  • Experience in materials development.
  • At least 2 years experience in managing quality to formal standards frameworks.
  • Line management experience, preferably academic/teacher.
  • At least 2 years experience in managing the classroom/customer services interface for business objectives (for example dealing with complaints, re-registrations, parent/student engagement, contracts, client meetings, school partners).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience of structured teacher development programmes from initial teacher training to advanced levels.
  • IELTS Examiner and training status.
  • Online teaching qualification and experience.
  • Problem based learning.

title: Production and Supply Control Associate
description:
About The Opportunity

This role is critical to ensuring the seamless execution of the production and supply plan within a fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) environment. The Production and Supply Control Associate acts as the operational guardian of the plan, ensuring that every planned production quantity and date is realized through to final allocation, thereby protecting inventory cover and preventing stockouts or expiry risks. The role operates on an exception-based model, proactively identifying and escalating deviations before they impact supply.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Run MRP immediately after the production plan is released and confirm the plan is fully covered.
  • Track raw material and packaging availability against the plan; raise PRs and POs with Procurement and Packaging on time.
  • Flag material shortfalls, long lead items and imported inputs before they stop a production run.
  • Track planned vs. actual production (quantity and date) for every SKU across in-house plants and contract manufacturers.
  • Hold daily and weekly calls with plants and vendors on schedule adherence and slippage.
  • Reconcile every plan change so no quantity or date is lost; maintain one live plan-vs-actual record.
  • Track dispatch from plant or vendor to the warehouse, with transit status and expected receipt dates.
  • Ensure GRNs are posted on time and goods are available in the system for allocation.
  • Follow up on QC holds, short receipts and damages.
  • Allocate received stock to channels (E-Com, Retail, Q-Com, Amazon, B2B / Export) as per the planning team's allocation rules.
  • Track fill rate, indent fulfilment and days of inventory cover by SKU and channel.
  • Manage short-supply and overstock alerts for rebalancing and hub transfers.
  • Run a daily control tower review of at-risk SKUs, open actions and escalations.
  • Escalate slippage to the Sr. Manager, Demand & Supply Planning with impact on cover and a recovery plan.
  • Publish a weekly plan-adherence and inventory-cover report and drive root cause closure on repeat misses.

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations or Commerce.
  • Minimum 1 year in production planning and material planning, and on overall experience of 2-3 years in supply chain execution roles, ideally in FMCG, food, supplements or cosmetics.
  • Hands-on experience running MRP and following up with plants, contract manufacturers and packaging vendors.
  • Strong command of Excel (pivots, lookups, dashboards).
  • Working knowledge of an ERP (Odoo preferred; SAP or similar acceptable).
  • Disciplined follow-up, clear written and verbal communication, and comfort escalating early.
  • Structured problem solving and ownership of outcomes, with attention to detail on quantities and dates.

Preferred

  • MBA or PGDM in Operations / Supply Chain.
  • Exposure to multi-channel inventory (E-Com, Retail, Q-Com, marketplaces).
  • Power BI or similar is a plus.

Skills: operations,supply chain,sap,supply,power bi,fmcg,excel

title: Network Security Engineer L3
description:
The Opportunity:


As a Network and Firewall L3 Engineer, you will assist in monitoring, maintaining, optimizing, and performing advanced-level troubleshooting on network and firewall infrastructure, ensuring system stability and security. This role is ideal for someone looking to gain hands-on experience in network administration, firewall management, and advanced troubleshooting. The position requires onsite presence at both Data Centre (DC) and Office locations.


Roles And Responsibilities:

  • Carry out advanced-level configurations and troubleshooting on network switches, routers, firewalls, and networking technologies such as EVPN BGP, VXLAN, SSL VPN, IPSEC VPN, and BGP.
  • Extend technical support to L1, L2, and clients over email, tickets, phone, and other communication channels.
  • 24 x 7 availability.
  • Provide response and resolutions to incidents, requests, changes, and problems as per SLA and, if required, escalate as per the escalation matrix.
  • Handle escalations, severity incidents, and critical projects.
  • Work on SIPs and assignments.
  • Adhere to process and procedures.
  • Manage and maintain availability and uptime of infrastructure.
  • Prepare handover checklist, POA, shift reports, KEDB, SOPs, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other team members and other teams to provide resolutions.
  • Ensure all tasks and work done are captured in ticketing systems and are updated accordingly.
  • Ensure early resolution of issues to meet SLA. Experience handling escalations and providing L3-level support/RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for critical incidents.


Primary Skills (Must Have):

  • Strong hands-on experience in configuring, managing, and troubleshooting firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco ASA/Firepower, Check Point).
  • In-depth knowledge of routing and switching concepts (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, VLANs, STP).
  • Strong hands-on experience with BGP (eBGP/iBGP, route reflectors, route policies, path attributes) in Data Centre environments.
  • Working knowledge of VXLAN overlay networking (VTEPs, VNI mapping, underlay/overlay design) and EVPN as its control plane, including MAC/IP route advertisement and multi-tenancy.
  • Understanding of Spine-Leaf Data Centre fabric architectures built on BGP EVPN VXLAN.
  • Expertise in VPN technologies (Site-to-Site, IPSec, SSL VPN, Remote Access VPN).
  • Experience with network security concepts - NAT, ACLs, IPS/IDS, DMZ architecture, Zone-Based Firewalls.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting network connectivity, latency, and performance issues at L3 level.
  • Sound knowledge of network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, or similar).
  • Hands-on knowledge of load balancers and proxy technologies.
  • Familiarity with network documentation, change management, and incident/problem management processes (ITIL framework).
  • Experience with DC (Data Centre) network operations, including uptime, redundancy, and failover mechanisms.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, DNS, DHCP, and network protocols.


Preferred Skills:

  • Basic understanding of SOC processes - incident detection, triage, and escalation.
  • Familiarity with SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or similar) for log monitoring and correlation.
  • Exposure to threat intelligence and common attack vectors (DDoS, malware, phishing, lateral movement).
  • Ability to correlate network/firewall logs with SOC alerts for effective incident response.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability management and patching processes.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (AWS/Azure VPC, VNet, cloud firewalls, hybrid connectivity).
  • Awareness of compliance and audit standards (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) as applicable to network/security infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP (Security or Enterprise), PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, or CompTIA Security+ are a plus.


Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa:


This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, large-scale infrastructure systems that power AI-driven platforms. You will play a critical role in maintaining system reliability, handling high-impact incidents, and shaping operational excellence in a fast-growing AI ecosystem.


You'll gain deep exposure to enterprise infrastructure, automation practices, and next-generation AI workloads while contributing to a high-performance environment.


Team Culture and Inclusion:

  • Work in a collaborative, high-impact, and fast-paced environment.
  • Be part of a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Thrive in an inclusive workplace where diverse ideas and perspectives are encouraged.

SAP Materials Management & Procurement

  • Configure integration between SAP MM and FICO, SD, PP, QM, EAM, and PS.
  • Support automatic account determination, material valuation, and inventory postings.
  • Prepare Business Process Design documents, functional specifications, and configuration documentation.
  • Support Material Master, Supplier Master, Purchasing Information Records, and opening stock data migration.
  • Conduct Unit Testing, Integration Testing, UAT, and end-user training.
  • Support cutover planning, go-live activities, and post-go-live hypercare.

  • Experience implementing SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud (GROW with SAP) and Private Cloud (RISE with SAP).
  • Participation in at least two end-to-end SAP implementations, preferably including S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Strong expertise in Procurement, Inventory Management, Material Master, Vendor Master / Business Partner, and Invoice Verification.

  • Good understanding of warehouse operations and physical inventory processes.
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori applications, SAP Activate methodology, and Fit-to-Standard workshops.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA data migration tools and master data validation.
  • Strong integration knowledge across SAP FICO, EAM, PP, QM, SD, and PS.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage functional deliverables and work with international business stakeholders.


4. Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related discipline (Mandatory).
  • MBA in Supply Chain Management or Operations will be an added advantage.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement certification preferred.
  • Valid US B1 or H1B visa preferred but not mandatory.


5. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with SAP MM implementation experience in the following industries will be preferred:

  • Mining and Metals
  • Iron Ore Mining and Beneficiation
  • Pellet Manufacturing Plants
  • Steel and Heavy Engineering
  • Manufacturing and Industrial Operations
  • Capital-Intensive Projects and Asset Maintenance


6. Employment & Deployment

Work Location: Mumbai

Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to the USA for project workshops, implementation, testing, go-live, and hypercare support, subject to business requirements and appropriate visa/work authorization.


7. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on SAP MM Consultant capable of independently managing procurement, inventory management, and warehouse-related implementation activities.


The ideal candidate should have strong SAP configuration skills, experience in SAP S/4HANA Cloud environments, and the ability to work closely with procurement, warehouse, finance, production, and maintenance teams.


Special Preference: Candidates with experience implementing SAP MM in mining, iron ore processing, pellet manufacturing, and large industrial operations will be highly preferred.

title: Sourcing Analyst
description:
Red Oak is a joint venture between two Fortune 20 leading healthcare companies, CVS Health and Cardinal Health, responsible for securing generic pharmaceuticals for both organizations. Pharmaceutical Sourcing team is comprised of industry experts, strategists, and entrepreneurial thinkers who apply innovative strategies to bring generic pharmaceuticals to market more efficiently.


Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid schedule! Work from the comfort of home on Mondays and Fridays and join the team in our welcoming office space on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays for collaboration and connection.


Position Summary:

The Analyst, Strategic Pharmaceutical Sourcing, will be analytical, organized, and personable and have the confidence to work with internal stakeholders and supplier partners to support and facilitate the portfolio management of one of the largest generic pharmaceutical purchasing programs in the United States. This individual will be responsible for contract administration (including reviews, corrections, and processing) and demand forecasting. The successful candidate will combine strong professional skills (e.g., analytical, organizational, and communication), attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple, time-sensitive deliverables, and a comfortability with building relationships, both cross-functionally within Red Oak and externally. In order to ensure the effective management of supplier contracts and demand forecasting, the Sourcing Analyst will also need to develop a strong working knowledge of the generic pharmaceutical industry and Red Oak Sourcing’s procurement program.


Responsibilities:

  • Contract Management
  • Review, correct, and process all new contracts for Red Oak Sourcing
  • Process edits and adjustments to existing contracts
  • Utilize workflow management tools to ensure timely and accurate contract (and contract change) processing
  • Establish strong communication and feedback loops with internal contract owners and supplier partners to achieve alignment and meet deadlines
  • Forecast Planning
  • Generate product-specific forecasts using historical data and incorporating other quantitative and qualitative factors
  • Manage a significant queue of usage (i.e., product volume) requests from supplier partners, prioritizing deliverables based on business need and ensuring timely delivery
  • Drive improvements and efficiencies with existing reporting tools and templates to efficiently manage the forecasting workflow, with an emphasis on tracking and reporting


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., business, supply chain, economics, finance)
  • Ability to prioritize and deliver on multiple concurrent initiatives with significant business impact
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deliverables while maintaining attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build long-term relationships with internal stakeholders (including cross-functional) and supplier partners
  • Results-driven with an ability to perform in a fast-paced yet collaborative environment
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with an aptitude for learning new subject matter (e.g., generic pharmaceuticals)
  • Confident, results-oriented mindset with a sense of urgency
  • Exhibits curiosity, critical thinking, and a continuous-improvement mindset
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Basic coding skills (e.g., Python, Java, etc.) and a familiarity with customer relationship management software and business-functional AI tools are a plus, but not required


The typical pay range for this role is: $56,000.00 - $67,000.00


This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a Red Oak bonus in addition to the base pay range listed above.


Employment Eligibility:

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

title: Program Manager - Inside Sales, Franchise Sales
description:
The Program Manager - Inside Sales, Franchise Sales (B2B) will lead and manage franchise sales programs for Edumilestones, focusing on building and expanding B2B relationships with educational institutions, counseling centers, and corporate clients. This full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru involves managing the entire inside sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to negotiation and closure, while maintaining accurate sales pipelines and reports. The role includes coordinating with internal teams to design and present suitable assessment and franchise solutions, conducting product demos, and delivering clear, consultative sales pitches to prospective partners. The Program Manager will also be responsible for onboarding new franchise partners, supporting them in achieving sales targets, and implementing sales strategies to drive growth in assigned regions. Ongoing responsibilities include monitoring performance metrics, providing feedback to improve processes, and representing Edumilestones in meetings and events as required.


Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in B2B inside sales, franchise sales, or account management, ideally within education, training, or related service industries.
  • Strong skills in stakeholder management, relationship building, and customer success to support and grow franchise and channel partner networks.
  • Proficiency in sales planning, pipeline management, and use of CRM or sales tracking tools to manage leads and opportunities.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities, with the capacity to explain assessment products and value propositions clearly.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to understand client needs, customize solutions, and align offerings with business objectives.
  • Ability to work in an on-site, fast-paced environment.

title: SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst based in Canada.

The SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst will play a key role in expanding and optimising a global supplier network for A2P (Application-to-Person) messaging. This position combines telecom traffic analysis, supplier onboarding, commercial evaluation, and route optimisation to support reliable, cost-effective SMS delivery worldwide. You will identify and test routes for customer requirements, monitor traffic quality, and assess performance across delivery rates, conversion, and speed. By analysing pricing, negotiating with suppliers, and improving existing routing strategies, you will directly contribute to stronger margins and business growth. Working in an international, fast-paced telecommunications environment, you will collaborate with a global team and help strengthen the company's position in the evolving A2P messaging market.

Accountabilities

  • Identify, research, test, and evaluate SMS A2P routes that meet customer requirements, including A2P and OTP traffic delivery.
  • Expand the global SMS supplier network by identifying suitable providers and supporting supplier evaluation and onboarding.
  • Monitor and analyse traffic quality using key performance indicators such as delivery receipt rates (DLR), conversion rates, and delivery speed.
  • Evaluate the price-to-quality ratio of existing and potential routes to ensure competitive and reliable service.
  • Optimise existing routing strategies to reduce delivery costs, improve margins, and maintain traffic quality.
  • Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics.
  • Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop commercial proposals that reflect customer requirements, pricing expectations, and available routing options.
  • Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in the A2P SMS industry is essential.
  • Proven experience identifying, evaluating, and onboarding SMS suppliers is essential.
  • Strong understanding of SMS traffic management and routing, including experience with iGaming traffic.
  • Good knowledge of global SMS markets, supplier dynamics, pricing structures, and commercial trends.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess route performance, interpret traffic statistics, and evaluate cost and quality.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reporting, pivot tables, and statistical analysis.
  • Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to assess supplier offers and develop competitive proposals.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, internationally focused team.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: Attractive compensation package.
  • International exposure: Opportunity to work with a global team and gain experience across international telecommunications markets.
  • Professional development: Build and deepen expertise in the fast-growing A2P SMS and telecom routing industry.
  • High-impact responsibilities: Direct contribution to revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier network expansion, and business performance.
  • Dynamic environment: Join an energetic, fast-paced organisation experiencing significant growth and transformation.
  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues in an international and supportive team.
  • Opportunity to make an impact: Help shape routing strategies and contribute to the development of the global messaging ecosystem.

title: Production Planner
description:
Production Planner


About RFI

RFI is a global technology solutions company specializing in wireless coverage and solar power. We develop, manufacture, and distribute world-class, high-performance wireless products, including antenna systems, rebroadcast and monitoring equipment, power systems, and cabling and connectors. Recognized as a market leader, we offer the best products backed by outstanding technical support.

We are currently seeking an experienced Production Planner to join our growing team on-site, based at our Bayswater, VIC/Melbourne site.

As a Production Planner at RFI Technology Solutions, you will play a critical role in ensuring our production team meets demand efficiently.   • Inventory Control & Demand and Supply Planning: Ensure inventory accuracy, facilitate supply planning, and manage material demand orders across multiple sites.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements as part of a team to enhance efficiency and productivity.

What We Offer

At RFI, we offer more than just a job – we offer a career. By joining our team, you’ll be a part of a dynamic, passionate, and innovative environment where your contributions matter. We value diversity, inclusion, and personal growth, providing you with the opportunity to make a meaningful difference while developing your career in an exciting, fast-paced industry.

  • Work in a supportive, dynamic, and diverse team environment.

title: Inventory Planner
description:
About Us:

Born from Loloi Rugs – an industry leader that has been trusted by thousands of the world’s top designers and retail stores – Joon Loloi is an e-commerce retail destination delivering an insider's perspective on home furnishings. Our online selection of furniture, rugs, lighting, and décor is a combination of exclusive in-house design, signature trademarks, and expertly curated pieces for every room and everyone.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

Protect yourself from potential fraud and verify the authenticity of any job offer you receive from Loloi. Rest assured that we never request payment or demand any sensitive personal information, such as bank details or social security numbers, at any stage of the recruiting process. Joon Loloi is seeking a full-time Inventory Planner. In this position, you’ll be responsible for forecasting and planning inventory for multiple textile and hard home categories—thousands of SKUs in total. The ideal candidate can analyze a breadth of data, factoring elements like trends, product lifecycles, minimum order quantities, lead times, timing, warehouse capacity, and more to forecast and plan inventory.

This position reports to our Director, Planning and Inventory Management, and at times works directly with leadership. This role is based in our Dallas, TX headquarters and is onsite 5 days a week. If you’re someone who enjoys the challenge of maintaining optimal inventory levels and timing within a fast-growing company, this is an ideal position for you.

Responsibilities

  • Determine proper inventory levels and re-order orders down to the SKU level based on selling trends.
  • Evaluate in-stock position across categories and communicate to cross-functional partners on opportunities.
  • Partner with the Director of Planning and Inventory Management on evolving planning model/ system for continual inventory management process improvement.
  • Oversee purchase orders with our manufacturers and effectively communicate and follow up on timing expectations.
  • Review, analyze, and present various inventory reports through Excel.
  • Communicate directly with manufacturers for updates on lead times and MOQs.
  • Work cross-functionally with Ecommerce, Merchandising, and Product Development to appropriately forecast inventory needs and prompt deliveries.
  • Steady communication with our manufacturers to ensure accurate ETAs on production orders, packaging requirements, etc.

Experience, Skills, & Ability Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Retail Management, Business Administration, or similar degree.
  • 4+ years of Retail experience in inventory management, forecasting, and planning.
  • Enjoys a team environment and collaborates well cross-functionally.
  • Detail-oriented and excels at multitasking.
  • Tenacious drive and a positive can-do spirit.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including and especially Excel.
  • Naturally analytical and data-driven.
  • Bonus points for prior experience working with planning system Toolio.
  • Bonus points for prior experience planning inventory within home space.
  • Willing and able to work in office 5 days a week.

What We Offer

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • A culture of meritocracy that fosters ongoing growth opportunities
  • A stable, growing family-owned company that looks after its employees

title: Purchasing & Inventory Analyst
description:
Aalchem is a fast-growing specialty chemical distributor based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving more than 1,550 customers across North America. We source and import products from manufacturing partners around the world, mainly in Korea, China and Taiwan, and deliver them to coatings, composites, adhesives and industrial customers.


The Purchasing & Inventory Analyst keeps our supply chain organized, on time and accurate. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you'll turn sales forecasts and buying history into purchase orders, work directly with overseas suppliers to keep shipments moving, and make sure inventory and open POs are always current. Getting the right product to the right warehouse at the right time is the core of our business, and this role is central to it.


Forecasting and planning

  • Work with the sales team each month to collect customer forecasts and turn them into a rolling purchase plan
  • Review sales and purchase history to set reorder points, safety stock and order quantities for each product
  • Flag forecast changes, slow-moving stock and potential shortages before they become problems

Purchase orders

  • Create, issue and maintain purchase orders in our ERP based on history, forecasts and lead times
  • Confirm price, quantity, packaging (drums, IBCs, ISO tanks, bags) and ship dates with suppliers
  • Keep a clean open-PO report: every order has a status, ETD/ETA and next action

Overseas suppliers and imports

  • Be a daily point of contact for suppliers in Korea, China and Taiwan, by email and messaging, across time zones
  • Track shipments from booking through vessel departure, port arrival, customs clearance and warehouse delivery
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers and our warehouses on documents (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, COA, SDS) and delivery appointments
  • Follow up on delays, short shipments and quality issues until they're resolved

Inventory control

  • Monitor inventory across our warehouses and reconcile system quantities against receipts
  • Support cycle counts and investigate discrepancies
  • Report weekly to Jeff on stock levels, open POs, inbound shipments and items at risk

Supporting the VP of Operations

  • Keep the purchasing calendar, supplier contacts, price lists and contracts organized and current
  • Prepare data and analysis for supplier reviews, price changes and cost comparisons
  • Take on follow-ups and projects that keep operations moving


Required Experience

  • 2+ years in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory control or a similar analytical role
  • Strong Excel skills: pivot tables, lookups, and building simple forecasts from history
  • Experience with an ERP or inventory system, and the ability to learn ours quickly
  • Highly organized, with a record of managing many open orders and deadlines at once
  • A sense of urgency and follow-through: you chase answers until an issue is closed
  • Clear written communication, including with suppliers whose first language isn't English
  • Comfort with numbers, unit conversions and cost calculations


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, finance or a related field
  • Experience importing from Asia: Incoterms, ocean freight, customs brokers, lead times
  • Background in chemicals, coatings, plastics or another industrial distribution business
  • Familiarity with SDS, COAs and handling regulated or hazardous materials
  • APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM) or a willingness to pursue it


Who thrives here

If you like a clean list and a closed loop, you notice when a number doesn't add up and you find out why. If you're happy sending a 7 a.m. follow-up to a supplier in Seoul, and just as comfortable walking a salesperson through why their customer's order needs another three weeks. If you'd rather solve a problem than escalate it, and you keep your manager informed without being asked. Then this job is for you!

Job Description

Job Description

Position: Engineer – Procurement (Civil Infrastructure – Design Projects)

Function: Procurement / Supply Chain Management

Industry: AEC / Civil Infrastructure / Engineering Consultancy

Location: As per business requirement



Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Procurement professional with exposure to the Civil Infrastructure and AEC (Architecture, Engineering & Construction) consulting sector. The incumbent will be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement activities for engineering and design consultancy projects, with a key focus on vendor identification, empanelment, evaluation, commercial negotiations and management of professional service providers.

The role requires close coordination with Project Managers, Design Heads, Technical Teams, Business Development and Finance to ensure timely onboarding of competent vendors and consultants, cost optimisation and adherence to project-specific requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Vendor Identification & Empanelment

  • Identify, evaluate and empanel vendors, specialist consultants and service providers for civil infrastructure design projects.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of qualified vendors across various engineering and design disciplines.
  • Assess vendor credentials, technical capabilities, relevant project experience, resource availability, financial stability and statutory compliance.
  • Establish vendor prequalification and evaluation criteria in coordination with technical and project teams.
  • Build a strong network of specialist consultants and design partners for project-specific requirements.

2. Project Procurement Management

  • Manage end-to-end procurement requirements for civil infrastructure design and engineering consultancy projects.
  • Understand project scope, technical requirements, deliverables and timelines to identify suitable procurement strategies.
  • Source and onboard external design consultants, specialist agencies and subcontractors for project execution.
  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely placement of work orders and service agreements.
  • Monitor procurement progress against project schedules and ensure timely mobilisation of external resources.

3. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimisation

  • Obtain and evaluate commercial proposals, quotations and fee structures from prospective vendors.
  • Conduct commercial negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favourable contractual terms.
  • Prepare cost comparisons, commercial evaluation statements and recommendations for vendor selection.
  • Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising technical quality and project deliverables.
  • Support budgeting and cost control for outsourced design and consultancy services.

4. RFQ, RFP & Contract Management

  • Prepare and issue Requests for Quotations (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and enquiries to prospective vendors.
  • Coordinate with technical teams for scope finalisation, BOQ / deliverable-based requirements and technical evaluations.
  • Review commercial terms, payment milestones, delivery schedules and contractual conditions.
  • Facilitate preparation and issuance of purchase orders, work orders and consultancy agreements.
  • Track contract validity, deliverables, variations, amendments and vendor performance.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Relationship Management

  • Work closely with Design, Project Management, Business Development, Finance and Legal teams.
  • Understand upcoming project requirements and develop a procurement plan aligned with business needs.
  • Establish and maintain long-term relationships with design consultants, specialist agencies and external service providers.
  • Resolve vendor-related commercial and coordination issues to ensure uninterrupted project delivery.

6. Compliance & Procurement Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the organisation's procurement policies, approval matrix and delegation of authority.
  • Maintain proper procurement documentation, vendor records, comparative statements and approval trails.
  • Monitor vendor performance through quality, turnaround time, cost and delivery parameters.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, contractual and organisational requirements.

Key Vendor Categories / Procurement Scope

  • Civil and structural design consultants.
  • Highway, expressway and transportation design consultants.
  • Bridge, flyover and elevated corridor design specialists.
  • Metro and railway infrastructure design consultants.
  • Geotechnical and survey agencies.
  • BIM and CAD design service providers.
  • MEP and utility design consultants.
  • Environmental and sustainability consultants.
  • Traffic engineering and transportation planning specialists.
  • Independent checking and proof-checking consultants.
  • Specialist engineering and technical service providers.

Experience

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience in procurement, preferably within Civil Infrastructure, Engineering Consultancy or AEC organisations.
  • Experience in procurement of professional services, design consultancy assignments and specialist engineering services.
  • Prior experience in vendor development, empanelment, commercial negotiations and contract management is essential.
  • Exposure to infrastructure projects such as highways, bridges, railways, metros, water and urban infrastructure will be preferred.





Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech) or Equivalent
  • MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain Management or Procurement would be an added advantage.

Additional Information

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of civil infrastructure design and engineering consultancy requirements.
  • Vendor sourcing, assessment, prequalification and empanelment.
  • Commercial evaluation, negotiation and cost optimisation.
  • RFQ / RFP management and contract administration.
  • Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
  • Analytical ability and commercial acumen.
  • Knowledge of procurement processes, documentation and governance.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement / ERP systems.

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Manufacturing & Planning Functional Consultant
description:

The successful candidate will possess strong functional expertise in Production Control, Master Planning, Product Information Management, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management, combined with proven experience delivering real-world D365 FSCM implementations from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare support. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, technical teams, and project managers to design, configure, test, and deploy scalable manufacturing and planning solutions that align with industry best practices and Microsoft standard functionality. Experience in discrete, process, or mixed-mode manufacturing environments is highly desirable

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end Dynamics 365 FSCM Manufacturing and Master Planning implementations.

Conduct business process workshops and gather requirements from production, planning, supply chain, and operations stakeholders.

Design capacity planning and finite scheduling solutions to improve shop-floor efficiency.

Support Production Floor Execution (PFE) implementation and shop-floor process transformation.

Create Functional Design Documents (FDDs), process flows, gap-fit analysis, and solution documentation.

Work closely with technical consultants to define integrations, customizations, reports, and data migration requirements.

Lead SIT, UAT, SAT, and production readiness activities.

Provide end-user training, super-user enablement, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Support data migration activities related to products, BOMs, routes, forecasts, and planning parameters.

Troubleshoot manufacturing and planning-related issues during testing and post-go-live support.

Lead cutover planning, go-live execution, and hypercare support.

Work with business stakeholders to improve inventory accuracy, production throughput, and planning effectiveness.

Ensure the adoption of Microsoft standard functionality and industry best practices wherever possible.

D365 - F&SCM - Manufacturing, Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Finance and Operations, Inventory and Warehouse Management

title: Engineering Manager - AI & Agentic Systems
description:
At Plum, AI isn't a side project. It's how our products work. We're building agentic workflows that read documents, reason over policies and help members get clear, dependable answers, starting with insurance claims.


What you will own:

  • Lead the team: hiring, coaching, performance and growth. Build a team that owns and operates what it ships.
  • Design and ship agentic AI workflows that are reliable in production: clear tool use, safe retries, failure handling, and a path to human review when needed.
  • Decide where AI fits: choose when to use fixed, tested code and when to use models or agents. Keep money-related calculations and policy rules in code you can trust.
  • Stay hands-on with architecture, code reviews and production debugging.
  • Own reliability and safety: safe releases, rollback, incident response, access controls and careful handling of sensitive member data.
  • Partner with product, operations and domain experts to turn real workflows, such as claims, into well-defined AI systems.
  • Champion AI-first engineering: use coding agents and AI tools in your own work and help your team do the same.


What you'll bring:

  • 8-10 years of software engineering experience.
  • Experience managing engineers and developing technical leaders: 1:1s, hiring, performance and growth.
  • Hands-on experience shipping and operating AI or agent systems in production, beyond prototypes. You can explain what went wrong, how you found it and what you changed.
  • Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, state management, data contracts and recovery.
  • A hands-on approach: you still write and review code and debug production issues.
  • Day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar).


Nice to have:

  • Experience with document pipelines: OCR, extracting data from bills or records, schema validation, deduplication and tracking where data came from.
  • Experience designing agent infrastructure: typed tool contracts, durable state, idempotent actions, timeouts.
  • Insurance, claims, fintech or healthcare experience, or working with domain experts on rules such as eligibility, limits and co-pay.
  • Experience with tracing and monitoring of AI systems: quality, latency and cost.


Your first 90 days:

  • Understand our AI workflows, starting with claims, and the biggest technical risks.
  • Set a quality baseline with product and operations.
  • Ship one well-scoped improvement with monitoring, a human fallback and a tested rollback, then plan next priorities from what you learn.

Position Overview

The 8th Judicial District Court seeks a part-time Case Manager to serve Native participants in the Veterans Treatment Court. This role is a vital member of the Treatment Court’s clinical team, working closely with participants to assess needs, develop treatment plans, connect them with resources, and monitor progress.

If appropriately licensed or qualified, the Case Manager may also provide direct clinical services such as counseling, therapy, cognitive-behavioral interventions, skills development, and rehabilitative support. The position also supports the Veterans Treatment Court Coordinator with daily operations, grant compliance, and reporting.

This position requires independent judgment, strong initiative, and a collaborative approach. Work is reviewed by the presiding District Judge and the Treatment Court Coordinator.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in providing comprehensive case management.

  • Participate in staffing and court hearings.

  • Conduct phone calls, office/home/employment visits as necessary.

  • Monitor and assist participant compliance and progress; suggest appropriate incentives and sanctions; and coordinate community-based services to improve participant stability.

  • Utilize and deliver cognitive-behavioral interventions to address criminal thinking and increase readiness for change.

  • Assist the Coordinator with grant writing, compliance, and reporting.

  • Assist participants in identifying and addressing barriers such as housing, employment, and medical insurance.

  • Connect participants to medical, mental health, and substance use treatment services, including VA and community providers.

  • Support participants in navigating public benefits (SNAP, WIC, TANF, HUD) and accessing community resources (utilities, rent, food, clothing, legal assistance).

  • Teach life skills such as budgeting, financial literacy, time management, and goal-setting.

  • Work with participants to achieve educational goals (GED, college, vocational training).

  • Collaborate with the Treatment Court team to coordinate care and share participant progress.

  • Participate in team meetings, trainings, and program evaluation activities.

description:

title: Functional Analyst IV (Strategic Planning) (071-26)
description:
ANGLICOTECH, LLC is an established, rapidly growing, veteran-owned small business providing Global Logistics and Supply Chain management, systems and analysis, Cybersecurity and NIST SP 800-171 compliance solutioning as well as Enterprise Information Technology Implementation and Services.


We are seeking a Functional Analyst IV (Strategic Planning) with immediate availability to support the Marine Corps Logistics Command (MARCORLOGCOM) and Marine Forces Storage Command (MFSC) under the Coordinated SECREP Management (CSM) and Strategic Logistics Services (SLS) program. This key‑personnel role provides enterprise‑level strategic planning, logistics process analysis, policy development support, and senior‑level advisory services that directly enhance Marine Corps readiness and modernization objectives. As the program’s lead strategic planning analyst, this role ensures the CSM/SLS mission remains aligned with enterprise logistics architecture, Marine Corps policy, and the broader modernization efforts across the Marine Corps Logistics Enterprise.


The Functional Analyst IV delivers advanced analytical expertise, facilitates strategic initiatives, develops high‑quality decision support products, and engages with Government leadership to shape logistics policies, forecasting, allowance setting, and sustainment strategies. Through expert analysis and coordination, this role strengthens enterprise planning, enhances SECREP lifecycle management, and advances long‑term logistics effectiveness across all supported commands.

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, education, certifications, technical qualifications, security clearance, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Benefits Include:
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Life and Disability Insurance


Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Logistics Analysis

  • Analyze Marine Corps supply chain processes and logistics architecture; identify strategic level Courses of Action (COAs) to improve efficiency, readiness, and SECREP lifecycle performance.
  • Apply detailed knowledge of strategic planning, metrics management, forecasting, allowance setting, backorder management, and GCSS-MC integration to support modernization efforts.

Policy Development & Modernization Support

  • Develop recommendations for updates and modifications to Marine Corps logistics policy, CSM processes, and SLS initiatives.

Strategic Initiative Facilitation & Change Management

  • Provide structured change management support to Government customers implementing new logistics processes, systems, or policies.

Operational Data Analysis & Process Evaluation

  • Support strategic planning for inventory levels, SECREP allowance setting, demand forecasting, and sustainment planning.

Executive Level Communication & Briefing Support

  • Develop high-quality briefings, documents, strategic communications, and decision support materials for senior Government staff.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Produce trip reports, planning documents, strategic assessments, and other communication products required by Government leadership.
  • Ensure deliverables are accurate, timely, and compliant with required formats and schedules.


Security Clearance: US Citizenship required; must possess a Secret clearance.


Education and Experience:

title: Research Lead - UDAYA Lab
description:
The UDAYA Lab exists to change that. Based within the Community Empowerment Lab (CEL), UDAYA studies how human capacities emerge in the earliest years of life - how attention, learning, self-regulation, and social understanding unfold in children growing up in diverse, real-world settings across India. It integrates four lenses: brain, behaviour, biology, and developmental ecology. The lab is already active, with longitudinal research supported by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and multi-site studies with Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) and international collaborators.


This is not a lab that measures deficits. It studies how capacities are born.


The Role:


We are looking for a Research Lead to anchor the scientific work of the UDAYA Lab. This is not a role for someone who has all the answers. It is a role for someone who is learning to ask the right questions - and who wants to do so in service of children who have been largely absent from the scientific literature.


You will be mentored by senior scientists and collaborators, and given real responsibility as you grow. Your work will include:

  • Contributing to the design of studies on early childhood development, from conception through the first three years of life - with increasing ownership over time.
  • Working across brain, behaviour, biology, and ecology. You need not be expert in all four, but you must be genuinely curious about all of them.
  • Spending significant time in the field - in homes, at community sites, in health facilities - observing, learning, and collecting data alongside field teams.
  • Learning to work with advanced tools - functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), eye-tracking, low-field magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) - in settings where infrastructure is limited and resourcefulness matters.
  • Helping analyse and interpret multi-modal data, and translating findings into insights that can shape care practices, interventions, and policy.
  • Collaborating with CEL's research teams and external partners - ICMR, TIFR, and international institutions.
  • Contributing to publications and presentations that advance the science of early development in diverse contexts.


Requirements:


Who You Are:


We are looking for someone whose scientific curiosity is matched by a quality of attention - to children, to context, to the questions that matter. You may come from developmental psychology, cognitive neuroscience, public health, paediatrics, or a related field. What matters most is the depth of your thinking and the sincerity of your orientation.

  • A strong foundation in developmental science or a related discipline - through formal training and/or sustained research experience.
  • Comfort with quantitative methods. Experience with neuroimaging, eye-tracking, or physiological measurement is an advantage, but the aptitude and willingness to learn matter more.
  • Real curiosity across disciplines. You read outside your own field because you cannot help it.
  • Comfort in field settings. You will work in villages, in homes, in under-resourced facilities. You see this not as a limitation but as the whole point.
  • Humility. The mothers and families you work with know things about child development that no textbook has captured. You are ready to learn from them.
  • The desire to grow. This role comes with mentorship, collaboration with national and global scientists, and space to develop your own research voice. You do not need to arrive complete. You need to arrive ready.


Why This Matters:


The first thousand days of a child's life hold more possibility than any other period. Yet most of the science that informs global policy on early childhood comes from a narrow slice of the world's children. Children of rural India, of South Asia, of sub-Saharan Africa - the majority of the world's young lives and their environment - needs to illuminate and expand our understanding of how development unfolds. UDAYA exists to accomplish that.


Location:


Based at CEL in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with regular field immersion at research sites. This is a field-embedded role. The lab is where the children are.

title: Director of Finance
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Chief Financial and Accounting Officer, The Director of Finance provides operational oversight for financial functions at the Commission. The role ensures that procurement, contracting, accounts payable, grant accounting, accounting operations, and related financial operations are executed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with laws, regulations, statewide policies, and Office of the Comptroller requirements.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the Chief Financial & Accounting Officer with operational and financial activities as assigned;

  • Direct and oversee the work of the Accounting Manager and Procurement Manager to ensure the effective administration of the Commission’s accounting and procurement functions;

  • Ensure encumbrances, payments, and financial transactions are accurately reflected in Mosaic;

  • Oversee accounting functions, including accounts payable, revenue and receivable transactions, accounting operations, grants and related financial reporting;

  • Strengthen financial operations through automation, improved reporting capabilities, and innovative business solutions;

  • Lead initiatives that improve efficiency, transparency, and service quality across finance functions;

  • Compile, analyze and present financial data for internal and external use, and legislative oversight;

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with agency leadership, operational teams, and external oversight organizations;
