title: Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment
description:
POSITION PURPOSE


The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment is the functional owner of the Enterprise order fulfillment solutions within the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. The role translates validated business requirements into working, supported application functionality (mainly, but not limited to, SAP) across the order fulfillment landscape - covering Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing - and is accountable for the quality, consistency, and supportability of that functionality.

The role sits within the global Enterprise Business Analysis team and is aligned to the Order Fulfillment functional domain. It partners with the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption organization, who own business process design, business requirements definition, and adoption. This role owns everything from functional specification onward: configuration, development coordination, testing, cutover, and ongoing application support.

The successful candidate combines SAP order management and logistics execution configuration depth with the ability to work directly with customer service, order management, and logistics stakeholders, and applies the change management, documentation, and control standards that govern the application estate.


PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES


Functional Design & Specification

• Translate validated business requirements received from the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption team into functional specifications, solution designs, and configuration approaches for the SAP order fulfillment landscape.

• Advise business partners and IT colleagues on standard SAP capability and leading practice for Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing, actively steering solutions toward fit-to-standard adoption over custom development.

• Assess the functional and integration impact of proposed changes across adjacent domains, including Customer Experience and Sales, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Purchasing, and Finance (accounts receivable and revenue recognition).

• Provide functional input to application rationalization and integration assessments for order fulfillment systems, supporting - but not owning - the architecture decisions held by Integration & Solutions Architecture.

Configuration & Solution Delivery

• Own SAP configuration for the order fulfillment modules, ensuring changes are designed, documented, and delivered to the standards set by the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization.

• Partner with the technical lead and the application development team to define, deliver, and validate custom development where standard functionality cannot meet a validated requirement.

• Deliver configuration and development activities with attention to quality, consistency, reusability, and scalability across regions and entities.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, functional design documents, and technical handover material.

Testing, Cutover & Release

• Own functional and integration testing for the order fulfillment workstream, including test script preparation, execution, defect logging, and retest.

• Support business-led user acceptance testing by preparing test environments and data, resolving defects, and providing functional guidance to business testers.

• Plan and execute cutover activities for order fulfillment scope, including data validation, sequencing, and hyper care, with attention to open order and in-transit delivery continuity.

• Comply with application change management and transport procedures, ensuring appropriate approval and evidence of control operation for audit purposes.

Application Support & Continuous Improvement

• Act as the functional escalation point for order fulfillment related incidents and defects, driving timely investigation, root cause analysis, and remediation within agreed service levels.

• Identify and deliver continuous improvement opportunities that optimize SAP order fulfillment processes, improve system performance, and reduce recurring incident volume.

• Monitor and report on key performance indicators relating to order fulfillment solution quality, defect trends, and change delivery, using data to inform prioritization.

• Contribute to the reduction of technical debt and custom-code footprint within the order fulfillment landscape.

Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer

• Collaborate with Business Analysts in adjacent functional domains to ensure end-to-end process integrity across the Enterprise System landscape, with particular attention to the customer-facing and finance touchpoints of the order-to-cash chain.

• Maintain strong working relationships with customer service, order management, logistics and distribution stakeholders, regional business teams, and external implementation partners.

• Create and maintain configuration guides and functional documentation and provide functional content and subject-matter input to training materials owned by the Business Enablement & Adoption team.

• Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to application support colleagues, third-party partners, and less experienced analysts.


NATURE AND SCOPE


The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment reports to the Global Manager, Enterprise Business Analysis within the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. There are no direct reports to this position. The role exercises significant functional influence over the order fulfillment solution and coordinates the work of technical colleagues and external partners on order fulfillment scope.

The role operates globally across all BAC entities and works within the application architecture, change management, and quality standards owned by the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. As order fulfillment sits between the customer-facing and financial ends of the order-to-cash chain, the position carries meaningful cross-functional visibility with customer service, logistics, and finance stakeholders.


PERFORMANCE INDICATORS


• Quality and timeliness of functional specifications and configuration delivery against agreed commitments.

• Defect escape rate from functional testing into user acceptance testing and production.

• Incident resolution performance for order fulfillment related issues against agreed service levels, including during period-end and peak shipping windows.

• Proportion of requirements met through standard SAP capability versus custom development.

• Completeness and currency of configuration and functional documentation.

• Stakeholder satisfaction from customer service, order management, logistics, and regional business teams.

No grants of authority have been assigned to the Business Analyst – Order Fulfillment.

The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment maintains regular contact with the Enterprise Business Analysis and Application Development teams; Integration & Solutions Architecture; Application support colleagues; the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption team; Customer Service, Order Management, Logistics and regional business stakeholders; and third-party SAP consultants and implementation partners.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS


• Bachelor’s degree or higher in information technology, computer science, supply chain, business, or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in SAP configuration, functional analysis, or closely related roles, preferably in a global environment.

• Proven configuration expertise in Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing.

• Familiarity with adjacent integration points, particularly Customer Experience and Sales, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Purchasing, and Finance, and with transportation and warehouse management systems.

• Strong understanding of order fulfillment business processes and how they are enabled by SAP solutions.

• Working knowledge of application change management and transport procedures, and of the control and audit requirements that apply to system changes, including segregation of duties in an order management context.

• Experience partnering with technical developers to specify, deliver, and validate custom development.

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both customer service and logistics personnel and technical colleagues.

• A pro-active, solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of urgency and customer focus.

Preferred

• SAP certification in Sales & Distribution or Logistics Execution.

• Experience of an S/4HANA implementation or migration program, including advanced ATP.

• Experience in an engineer-to-order or highly configurable product environment.

• Exposure to transportation management, warehouse management, EDI, and customer portal integrations.


WORKING CONDITIONS


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk up to 50% of the time. Working conditions include those of a normal construction environment, as well as standard hazards associated with installed HVAC equipment and rotating equipment. This position requires occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs, and travel of 10 - 20% of the time.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Position — Sr. Analyst, Assortment Planning

Reports To — Sr. Manager, Assortment Planning

Direct Reports — None (individual contributor); joins a team of ~6 Sr. Analysts within Assortment Planning

Location — Atlanta, GA (Hybrid: On-site Monday–Thursday, Remote on Friday)


About the Company

NAPA Auto Parts is a leading U.S. automotive aftermarket distributor and wholly owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (NYSE: GPC), a $23.5B global distribution leader. With 20,000+ employees, NAPA distributes more than 800,000 automotive replacement parts, accessories, and service items to retail and commercial customers nationwide. As GPC prepares to separate its Automotive and Industrial businesses into independent public companies by 2027, NAPA will become the standalone Automotive platform—creating greater focus, agility, and investment to accelerate growth and innovation across the automotive aftermarket.


Why This Role Matters

Assortment Planning is a newer function at NAPA, built from the ground up over the past year, and the company is in the midst of a broader transformation with renewed executive focus on better leveraging its independent owner network and inventory. This role gives a Sr. Analyst the rare chance to help build processes, tools, and analytics from scratch rather than execute an established playbook, with direct visibility to Category Management and Assortment Planning leadership as the team scales.


The Ideal Candidate

A sharp analytical thinker with 2+ years turning large, messy data sets into a clear story and a recommendation, not just a report. Retail or merchandising exposure is a plus, though not required. Equally important: collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building new processes and tools rather than following an existing playbook.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deep-dive inventory productivity by category, location, and SKU to identify the optimal product mix
  • Identify opportunities to redistribute space within and across categories to optimize assortment mix
  • Build post-review SKU-add analytics to quantify incrementality and cannibalization of assortment decisions
  • Support cross-functional review models that clarify exit-strategy costs and new-item introduction timing
  • Provide SKU-level sales forecasts to Inventory Planning to help ensure proper fill rates and service levels
  • Create streamlined, repeatable processes and documentation for Business Reviews and assortment recommendations
  • Partner with Supply Chain Strategy & Analytics to build and refine the tools used to make assortment decisions


Professional Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of analytics and process improvement experience, ideally within retail or merchandising
  • Advanced Excel skills plus hands-on experience querying large data sets (e.g., BigQuery or similar)
  • Proven ability to turn large data sets into a clear, hypothesis-driven story and a business result
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including building PowerPoint materials for leadership
  • Experience with Power BI or other analytics visualization tools is strongly preferred here.
  • Prior exposure to merchandising or assortment modeling applications and tools is a plus


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Process Improvement, or equivalent work experience is required


Leadership & Personal Characteristics

  • Analytical Storyteller - Turns large data sets into a hypothesis, a conclusion, and a result
  • Collaborative Partner - Works easily across Category, Supply Chain, Sourcing, and Pricing teams
  • Builder Mindset - Energized by creating new processes and tools, not following an existing playbook
  • Self-Starter - Takes initiative and moves forward without needing every step spelled out.
  • Flexible Operator - Respects the process but knows when to flex to support a merchant's need


Culture & Environment

This newly built team works well together and genuinely enjoys one another: smart, collaborative, and easy to get along with rather than cutthroat. Assortment Planning sits alongside Category Management inside an organization investing heavily in modernizing its merchandising capabilities, offering high visibility and the chance to shape process and tools from the ground up rather than inherit a rigid playbook. The team is in the office together Monday through Thursday, with a hybrid work-from-home Friday.


Compensation & Benefits

NAPA offers a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

title: L1 SOC Analyst

title: Senior Business Analyst, Supply Chain Strategy & Analytics
description:
8116 - Midtown Office - 2220 W. Broad Street, Richmond, Virginia, 23220


CarMax, the way your career should be!


About The Team

The Supply Chain Strategy team is a world-class community of analysts who work in a collaborative environment that leverages a variety of strategic and technical skillsets to help drive CarMax's supply chain operations. CarMax's supply chain business is undergoing an exciting transformation focused on optimizing how we acquire, recondition, and move vehicles which is helping us extend our market leadership while positioning us for future growth. The Supply Chain Strategy team is at the center of this transformation, serving as thought leaders who provide strategic direction and data-driven insights that guide decision-making across our supply chain operations


Our team tackles this work while ensuring we are a great representation of CarMax’s 4 core values:


Do the Right Thing: We prioritize maintaining the culture of integrity which has set CarMax apart in the used car industry, and promote a respectful and inclusive environment at work

Put People First: We’re focused on nurturing associate development and on maintaining a healthy work culture, while also making sure our customers are offered a great experience

Win Together: Teamwork is essential to what we do; we regularly learn from each other and draw on each other’s expertise and perspectives

Go for Greatness: We continually improve our abilities and the products that we support, to reinforce CarMax’s position as the industry leader


About The Role


CarMax sources hundreds of thousands of vehicles each year through consumer purchases, auctions, and other channels. Each vehicle goes through a complex journey from acquisition through reconditioning and logistics before it's ready to be sold to customers. The Supply Chain Strategy team leverages data, analytics, and strategy to optimize this journey, ensuring we purchase an optimal mix of cars, recondition those cars efficiently, and move them through our network to support growth of our retail sales.

There are several sub-teams on Supply Chain Strategy who focus on different parts of the vehicle lifecycle. As a Sr. Analyst in Supply Chain Strategy, you will work with business partners in our Product, Technology, and Operations to help drive the supply chain business forward on a team focused on one of these areas:


  • Consumer Supply Strategy – Works to optimize how we acquire vehicles directly from consumers through our digital and omnichannel processes
  • B2B Strategy – Works to enhance the way we exchange with other businesses through selling at our auction or buying directly from third parties
  • Merchandising Strategy – Works to ensure we can evaluate and buy vehicles through all channels through efficient and effective operations
  • Logistics Strategy – Works to optimize vehicle movement throughout our network and balance the tradeoff of cost and speed
  • Service Operations Strategy – Works to enhance reconditioning operations, ensuring vehicles are prepared efficiently and to quality standards that support customer satisfaction


What You Will Do – Essential Responsibilities

Some of our roles lean towards partnering more closely with the Product organization and serving as product analyst, whereas others lean towards partnering more closely with Field Operations organization and serving as an operational analyst. In either of those roles, a successful Sr. Analyst would:

  • Be an analytic partner and establish a close working relationship with a product manager or our operational partners
  • Design and analyze tests to evaluate effectiveness of changes to our products or operational changes
  • Enhance analytical tools, such as models, reports, and dashboards, utilizing them to monitor performance and drive ongoing performance

Qualifications and Requirements

Ability to consistently deliver at a high level on the responsibilities listed above. Requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge and skills required:

  • A track record of excellent problem solving, strategic thinking, and quantitative/qualitative analysis
  • Experience conducting large scale data analysis to support conclusions, and a willingness to gain proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, PowerBI, or Tableau
  • Ability to apply business and technical knowledge to solve complex problems, produce results, and make recommendations
  • Ability to communicate complex topics to people with varying backgrounds and levels of technical familiarity
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to collaborate with a team of passionate analysts and business partners who are regularly shaping strategy at a big-picture and a detailed level
  • Two or more years of experience in an analytical or strategic role
  • Four-year undergraduate degree with strong academic performance


Work Location and Arrangement: This role will be based out of the CarMax Midtown Office (Richmond, VA) and associates will work onsite 4 days per week.


Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Sponsorship will not be considered for this specific role


About CarMax

CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent and high-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 200 locations nationwide.


Our amazing team of more than 25,000 associates work together to deliver iconic customer experiences. Along the way, we help every associate grow their career and achieve their best, at work and in their community. We are recognized for our commitment to training and diversity and are one of the FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For®.


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

CarMax is committed to bringing together people from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe, welcoming, and inclusive work environment.


CarMax is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, and any other characteristics protected by law.


The annual salary for this position is:

$88,400.00 - $132,600.00

May be eligible for bonus and equity.


Benefits:


Except as otherwise required by state law, CarMax Associates are entitled to the following paid sick, vacation, and holiday time.


Associates considered full-time salaried are entitled to paid time away with no specified limit as needed for sick, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, holidays, floating holiday, etc. subject to manager approval.


For more details about benefits, please visit our CarMax Benefits website.

Upon an applicant's request, CarMax will consider reasonable accommodation to complete the CarMax Job Application.

title: Business Associate
description:
ABOUT US

Voltloader is the UK's first all-electric haulier, pioneering a new era of sustainable freight and charging solutions. We are an ambitious scale-up, operating at the cutting edge of both zero-emission logistics and the rapidly growing EV charging sector. This is a rare opportunity to join a business at the heart of its growth journey, where your impact will be immediate and visible, and your role can grow as the company scales up. For more information, please see www.voltloader.com.


POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for a bright, motivated and commercially minded graduate to join our growing business as a Business Associate.


Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and other company leaders, you will help improve business performance, solve practical problems and develop new solutions to support our mission of driving the transition to zero-emission commercial transport.


This is a broad and varied role, spanning business analysis, operations, technology, commercial development and project delivery. You will work with company systems for planning truck movements, managing HGV charging sessions, monitoring charger performance and analysing operational and commercial data to identify opportunities for improvement.


The role involves working closely with colleagues across the business and external stakeholders, including customers, suppliers and partners. It also involves hands-on involvement with hardware (e.g. trucks and chargers), infrastructure (e.g. power supplies and RFID cards), the systems that connect them, and the data they generate.


We are looking for a self-starter who is curious, adaptable and willing to turn their hand to a wide variety of challenges. You will need to be comfortable working with data and technology, but you don't need to be a programmer or an IT specialist. More important are your analytical ability, initiative, business judgement and enthusiasm for getting things done. This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious graduate who wants to develop broad business experience, take responsibility early and make a tangible contribution to a fast-growing company.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Development

● Support the CTO in developing new products, services and technical solutions e.g. charger booking, charger & energy management and optimisation, network (roaming) integration, transport management for eHGVs: connecting telematics, traffic, weather, topography, energy cost, charger speed/availability, etc. with haulage deliveries.

● Support the development of partnerships, alliances and joint ventures through the attendance of events, conferences and networking to drive strategy outcomes.

● Research and document business and solution requirements, present findings specifications to internal and external stakeholders, and act as a bridge between commercial and technical teams.

Support the definition, documentation and execution of testing, including hardware, software and integrations.


Business analysis and modelling

● Support the development of the company's business analysis and reporting capabilities, helping turn data into actionable commercial and operational insights.

● Learn to use and extract data from company systems, including charger back-office, transport management, SharePoint document stores, finance and planning, to inform business decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.

● Use AI and other digital tools effectively and responsibly to improve analysis, reporting and business processes.

● Support the delivery of innovation and business improvement projects, including project management, data analysis, research, reporting, presenting results at funded project events and representing the CTO when required.

● Research, produce and present ad-hoc reports and recommendations on mini-projects for the Leadership Team, covering a variety of commercial, operational and strategic topics.


Cross-departmental support for Operations

● Manage EV charging systems and charging schedules, ensuring equipment is operating safely and efficiently.

● Coordinate responses to charging equipment faults and service interruptions and liaise with maintenance teams and external contractors where necessary.

● Maintain records of charging activity and equipment performance.

● Complete incident reports and recommend corrective actions.

● Identify and support opportunities to improve operational efficiency, processes and customer service.


Cross-departmental support for Sales

● Create sales and pre-sales materials, integrating technical solutions with commercial benefits

● Attend sales meetings and events to represent the CTO, the Product Development function and relevant business solutions.

● Support the tracking and updating of sales opportunities that include charging, systems or networks.

● Support commercial analysis, research and business cases for new opportunities.


Administration & Reporting

● Maintain the Voltloader Network RFID card assets, operational IT devices and inventory audits.

● Support all departments with their regular KPI reporting, including the opportunity to update, implement and present report outputs to the Leadership team.

● Monitor operational KPIs and report variances.

● Maintain accurate records relating to charging activities, projects and network deployment or performance.

● Participate in operational reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Essential

● Graduate calibre, with strong analytical, reasoning and problem-solving skills. All degree disciplines considered.

● Proactive, self-starting and adaptable, with the initiative to take ownership and see tasks through to completion.

● Commercial curiosity and an interest in how businesses operate and improve.

● Confident working with numbers, data and technology, with an aptitude for learning new systems and tools.

● Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Excellent communication and organisational skills, able to engage with stakeholders and manage competing priorities.


Desirable

● Degree in a numerate, scientific, technical, economics or business discipline.

● Experience with data analysis, modelling, visualisation, AI or digital tools such as Power Apps, Visio and Excel Macros.

● Practical business experience through employment, internships, placements or university projects.

● Knowledge of, or interest in, electric vehicles, charging infrastructure, energy or fleet electrification.

Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including eHGV charging, battery storage and energy management.

WORKING CONDITIONS & ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

● Flexible location, although ideally within 1 hour's travel of London or Reading.

● Hybrid working: Office-based, home/remote working, depot and operational site environments.

● May require occasional weekend and holiday working.

● Occasional support for the Operations Team in responding to operational emergencies outside normal working hours.

● Ability to pass company medical and background checks where applicable.


WHAT WE OFFER

● Salary of £30k-£38k per annum depending on experience

● Pension scheme

● Training and development opportunities

● Career progression within a growing sustainable transport business

● Opportunity to contribute to the transition towards zero-emission logistics


HOW TO APPLY

Please submit a CV showcasing your relevant experience, and a Covering Letter setting out why this role appeals to you specifically and how your background aligns with our mission. The covering letter must be added to the top of your CV (as page 1) please.


Due to the high volume of automated LinkedIn responses, applications that do not include a tailored covering letter as page 1 of the CV will not be considered.


Equal Opportunities: Voltloader is an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, as diverse perspectives strengthen our ability to identify and build successful ventures across various sectors. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Inventory Analyst
description:
Inventory Analyst

At Chatters, beauty is more than what we do, it's how we connect, create, and build confidence every day. From professional hair services to must-have beauty products, we bring passion and expertise together to create inspiring spaces where customers feel welcome, empowered, and excited to explore their personal style.

We're looking for an Inventory Analyst to join our growing team at our Mississauga Support Centre!

Reporting to the Manager of Supply and Demand Planning, this role plays an important part in ensuring our salons have the right products, in the right quantities, at the right time. You'll use data and inventory insights to support replenishment, optimize stock levels, and identify opportunities to maximize sales while minimizing inventory risks.

This is an exciting opportunity for an analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys problem-solving, working cross-functionally, and making a meaningful impact on business performance.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze sales trends, inventory levels, and demand forecasts to make informed replenishment and allocation decisions.

  • Manage inventory at the SKU level across salons and warehouses, ensuring optimal stock levels to support sales.

  • Allocate merchandise based on sales performance, seasonal trends, and business needs.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce stock shortages, excess inventory, and improve inventory efficiency.

  • Monitor purchase orders, inventory movements, and discrepancies, ensuring accurate records and timely reconciliation.

  • Prepare and analyze inventory reports, identifying variances between forecasts and actual performance.

  • Collaborate with the Planning and Merchandising teams to align inventory strategies with sales targets and promotional activities.

  • Coordinate with vendors, Distribution Centre, and Store Operations teams to support timely product availability.

  • Process daily purchase orders and allocation requirements while maintaining accurate inventory data.

  • Proactively identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities to improve replenishment strategies and inventory performance.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the business.

Who You Are

You're an analytical, organized, and proactive professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and finding ways to improve processes. You understand the importance of inventory accuracy and how effective planning directly impacts sales, profitability, and the customer experience.

You align with our corporate values:

Start with the Power of You: You take ownership of your work, demonstrate strong analytical thinking, and use data to make confident, informed decisions.

Every Interaction Matters: You communicate effectively and build strong relationships with merchandising, planning, operations, and vendor partners.

Make It Memorable: You understand that having the right products available at the right time contributes to an exceptional customer experience.

More Than Just Beauty: You recognize the importance of collaboration and the behind-the-scenes processes that keep our business moving.

Commit to Grow and Learn: You're curious, adaptable, and continuously look for opportunities to improve inventory processes, reporting, and business performance.

What You Bring

  • Post-secondary education in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in inventory management, replenishment, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience working with MRP systems and retail inventory allocation.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting sales trends, inventory performance, turnover, and variance reporting.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

  • Experience working with ERP systems; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is considered an asset.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and sound decision-making abilities.

  • Previous experience in retail distribution or the beauty industry is considered an asset.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary starting at $60,000 annually

  • Product and salon service discounts

  • Medical and dental benefits

  • Employer RRSP contributions

  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and advance your career

How to Apply

Ready to put your analytical skills to work and play a key role in keeping our growing salon network stocked with the products our customers love?

Submit your online application or email us at careers@chatters.ca.

  • Instagram: @chattershairsalon

Kidderminster | £40,000 - £46,000 + bonus + excellent benefits


Are you an experienced Logistics or Warehouse professional with a strong understanding of ERP systems and a passion for improving processes?


We're looking for a Logistics & Warehouse Systems Specialist to play a key role in a major business transformation programme at an established engineering and manufacturing organisation.


This is an opportunity to help shape how logistics, warehousing and materials planning operate in the future, taking a leading role in the introduction of SAP S/4HANA across the business.


The Opportunity


You'll join a dedicated project team for an exciting transformation programme, working alongside operational teams, business stakeholders and external implementation specialists to design and introduce improved logistics and warehouse management processes.


Your responsibilities will include:


  • Helping design and implement new logistics and warehouse management processes.
  • Supporting the introduction of SAP S/4HANA and associated ERP functionality.
  • Reviewing existing processes and identifying opportunities for improvement, standardisation and efficiency.
  • Gathering operational requirements and ensuring the new system meets business needs.
  • Supporting system configuration, testing, data validation and migration.
  • Working closely with materials planning, manufacturing, quality and finance teams.
  • Supporting colleagues through system training and the transition to new ways of working.


Following the implementation, you'll transition back into the Logistics function as its primary systems specialist/key user, helping maintain the system, support colleagues and drive ongoing improvements.


What We're Looking For


  • Proven experience within logistics, warehouse management or materials planning.
  • A good understanding of logistics and warehouse management best practice.
  • Experience using ERP systems such as SAP, IFS, Kinetic, TROPOS or similar.
  • Experience as a systems super user, key user or functional specialist would be advantageous.
  • An understanding of process improvement, systems implementation and operational change.
  • Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • A relevant Level 4 qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics or Warehouse Management (CILT, CIPS, APICS or equivalent).


Why Consider This Opportunity?


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who understands logistics operations but wants to take their experience further into systems, technology and business transformation.


You'll have genuine influence over the design and implementation of a major ERP system, develop valuable SAP S/4HANA experience and help shape the future of logistics operations within a specialist engineering and manufacturing environment.


Interested? Get in touch to find out more.

title: Coordinator - Student Mobility (Academic Services)
description:
The Coordinator will support all stages of student mobility as a student-facing service within the Academic Services team. The role will be the day-to-day point of contact for participating students and will work closely with programme teams and colleagues in Mumbai and York.


The immediate priority is the next postgraduate study visit to York. Once the visit is complete, the Coordinator will begin preparations for the Year 2, Semester 2 undergraduate mobility programme. The role will continue to support future cohorts, including undergraduate final-year study opportunities at York.


Department:


Chief Academic Services Office (CASO)


Reports to:


Deputy Chief Academic Services Officer


Employment:


Full-time, on University of York Mumbai payroll


Key Responsibilities:

  • Student communications and applications. Coordinate mobility applications and support selection with academic colleagues. Keep students informed about programme requirements, deadlines and next steps, and respond to queries throughout the process.
  • Academic readiness and coordination with York. Work with programme teams in Mumbai and York to help students prepare for their period of study. Coordinate academic arrangements and induction, and help participating students connect with students at York.
  • Visa application support. Guide students through published UK visa application requirements, answer routine questions, coordinate supporting documents and track application progress. Liaise with designated colleagues in Mumbai and York on specialist visa or compliance queries.
  • Accommodation, fees and travel. Advise students on accommodation options, programme fees and payment deadlines. Coordinate accommodation, flights, transfers and insurance through University processes. Track student payments and programme expenditure, and support reconciliation.
  • Pre-departure preparation and student welfare. Organise briefings covering academic expectations, travel, insurance, health and safety, and how to access medical support abroad. Maintain emergency contacts, support risk assessments and follow University escalation procedures. The role may involve occasional work outside normal hours and travel with student groups.
  • Programme records and improvement. Maintain programme schedules, student records, checklists and guidance. Track participation and programme progress, and use student feedback to improve arrangements for future cohorts.


Qualifications and Experience:


Essential:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Two to three years' relevant experience in student mobility, an international office, academic administration or student services.
  • Hands-on experience supporting student visa applications, including guiding applicants through the process and coordinating supporting documentation, with strong working knowledge of UK visa processes and related compliance requirements for student mobility.
  • Experience coordinating student-facing activities, managing multiple deadlines and working across teams.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain processes to students and families.
  • Attention to detail and discretion when handling student records and personal information.


Desirable:

  • Experience supporting study visits, exchange programmes or group travel in higher education.
  • Experience using student records or customer relationship management systems.

description:
Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai


Role Objective:


The incumbent will work closely with the Group Chief Information Security Officer and Country Manager India in efficient formulation, implementation and management of the Bank's information security policy(s) and compliance programs pertaining to India Operations. The incumbent will ensure efficient management of Information Security Governance, in line with the Reserve Bank of India and other statutory / regulatory bodies governing our India operations.


The job holder will coordinate and execute the information security management system program (ISMS), security operations, VAPT program, red team program, update RBI Daksh portal returns before deadline and cyber security framework implementation. The job holder will also ensure that risk management needs in relation to information security, including but not limited to incident response, access control, business continuity and disaster recovery are duly and promptly addressed.   • Responsible for all cyber security governance framework along with other activities related to information and cyber security aspects as per the directions from Group Chief Information Security Officer.

description:
Inventory Planner

We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and highly organized Inventory Planner to manage inventory planning, forecasting, and replenishment across our extensive product assortment.

We carry thousands of SKUs across multiple sports licenses, teams, product categories, and retail customers. The Inventory Planner will be responsible for ensuring that we have the right inventory, in the right quantities, at the right time, while minimizing excess and slow-moving inventory.


Location: Roselle, NJ

Experience level: 3-6 years

Position: Full time on-site

Benefits: Available

Comp: Competitive, based on experience


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in inventory planning, demand planning, replenishment, merchandise planning, or a similar analytical role.
  • Strong Excel skills are essential.
  • Strong analytical and forecasting ability.
  • Experience managing a large number of SKUs.
  • Experience with imported consumer products, wholesale, retail, apparel, or licensed merchandise is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of data and turn it into clear purchasing recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer demand can change quickly.
  • Experience with inventory planning or ERP systems is preferred.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze historical sales, current sales trends, open orders, and inventory levels to forecast future demand.
  • Recommend what products need to be reordered, when they should be reordered, and in what quantities.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels while preventing both stockouts and excess inventory.
  • Plan inventory around seasonal demand, sports seasons, new product launches, and major customer programs.
  • Monitor inventory by SKU, team, license, product category, and customer.
  • Identify fast-selling products that require immediate replenishment.
  • Identify slow-moving and excess inventory and recommend appropriate action.
  • Account for overseas production and shipping lead times when developing purchasing recommendations.
  • Work closely with Sales, Production, Purchasing, and Management to understand upcoming programs and anticipated demand.
  • Review inventory and replenishment needs on a regular basis and provide management with clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Track inventory performance and continuously improve forecasting accuracy.

This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys working with numbers, understands inventory planning, and can confidently make recommendations to management based on the data.

Career Description:

UVAD is making something fast. We are developing Canada’s first supersonic airplane since the Avro Arrow. To accelerate this development, UVAD is calling for highly driven and talented people to join our team.


The Shop Operations Associate is a broad, hands-on job opportunity supporting UVAD's development and production activities. You will coordinate materials and supplies from procurement through receiving, storage, internal movement, and delivery. This includes maintaining accurate inventory records, supporting supplier communication and purchasing activities, receiving incoming parts, and assisting with the movement of equipment and products between UVAD facilities, test locations, and customer sites. Your work will directly support efficient operations and help UVAD meet development, production, and customer commitments.


You will also contribute to the consistent delivery of high-quality products by following documented procedures, completing acceptance activities, supporting tool control and calibration records, and performing hands-on assembly from drawings and instructions.   • Coordinate and support the movement of equipment, materials, and products between UVAD facilities, test locations, and customer sites.
  • Maintain tool-control, certification, and calibration records.

  • Able to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

UVAD is completing development of the Falcon, a first-of-its-kind supersonic UAV. Our technical leadership brings decades of cumulative experience developing advanced aerospace platforms. title: Senior Replenishment Analyst
description:
Senior Replenishment Analyst


Overview:

The Senior Replenishment Analyst is responsible for end-to-end inventory management and

replenishment execution across both Retail Stores and Wholesale Channels. This role ensures

optimal product availability while minimizing excess inventory, supporting both retail and B2B

growth strategies. The analyst will work closely with suppliers, distribution centers (DCs), stores,

buyers, customer managers, and marketing teams, aligning demand planning with execution to

drive supply chain efficiency and customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities:

1. Inventory Planning & Execution:

  • Develop inventory purchasing plans aligned with monthly sales forecasts, business strategies, and channel-specific needs (Retail & Wholesale).
  • Manage replenishment processes for both store-level (Retail) and customer-driven (Wholesale) orders, adapting strategies for differing demand patterns.

2. Sales and Forecast Review:

  • Monitor sales trends to improve system forecast accuracy; adjust system-generated forecasts based on real-time sales insights and wholesale customer requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer managers and buyers to incorporate account-specific and regional demand signals into replenishment plans.

3. Promotional & Seasonal Inventory Planning:

  • Create effective inventory strategies for major promotional periods, holidays, and peak sales events across both retail and wholesale channels.
  • Ensure appropriate inventory coverage tailored to differing promotional rhythms and fulfillment models.

4. Data Analysis and Stock Optimization:

  • Perform detailed inventory and sales data analysis to identify root causes of stockouts or overstocks.
  • Propose and implement corrective actions to improve inventory turns, reduce holding costs, and enhance availability.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (DCs, suppliers, stores, customer managers, buyers, marketing) to streamline processes and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Lead or support lean projects aimed at simplifying the replenishment process and enhancing responsiveness to channel-specific demand.

6. Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment (CPFR):

  • Promote and enhance Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment (CPFR) initiatives with suppliers to improve service levels and planning accuracy across both retail and wholesale supply chains.


Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field.

o 3+ years in replenishment, inventory management, or supply chain roles,

preferably in multi-channel environments (Retail & Wholesale)

o Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in Excel, SAP, or similar

ERP/forecasting systems.

o Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; proven ability to work cross-

functionally with internal teams and external suppliers or customers.

o Experience with CPFR, demand forecasting, and process optimization

o Professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin Chinese highly preferred.

Strategic Planning and Operational Execution:

forecasting) and operational execution (e.g., inventory optimization, lean

management), ensuring a balance between long-term strategy and short-term

operational efficiency.


Data-Driven Role:

o Emphasizes data analysis and optimization, using data-driven decision-making to

enhance inventory management and supply chain operations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:

o Works closely with multiple teams (e.g. suppliers, DCs, stores, buyers,

marketing) to ensure smooth operations from order creation to delivery.


Process Improvement:

title: SAP Solution Analyst (SAP MM)
description:
Role: SAP Solution Analyst

Location: IBC Knowledge Park, Bangalore

Reporting to: Technincal Architect - SAP Engineering

Team name: Supply Chain Technology


About the Team and the Role

The Supply Chain Technology team at Ather is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting robust digital solutions that optimize core operations, drive end-to-end procurement efficiency, and ensure accurate inventory and logistics management.

This role is for a detail-oriented and experienced SAP MM Functional Consultant to drive the design, configuration, and support of SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement solutions. The role owner will bridge business requirements with technology to streamline the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and enhance supply chain execution.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end P2P process configuration including Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, RFQs, Outline Agreements, release strategies, and specialized procurement scenarios (subcontracting, consignment, STO).
  • Manage MM master data governance and configuration, covering Material Master, Business Partner (BP), Purchasing Info Records, and Quota arrangements.
  • Configure and oversee Inventory Management processes, special inventory functions (batch management, stock determination), and Physical Inventory cycle counting to ensure stock accuracy.
  • Design Logistics Invoice Verification (LIV), material valuation (standard/moving average price), and automatic account determination for seamless integration with Finance (FI).
  • Translate manufacturing business requirements into detailed RICEFW functional specifications, collaborating with ABAP developers and utilizing BAPI, BADI, and Enhancement Spots.
  • Lead and support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), creating test scripts, resolving defects, and maintaining comprehensive project documentation.
  • Execute data migration activities into SAP S/4HANA utilizing tools such as LTMC and LSMW.
  • Deliver expert production support by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues across system integration points including FI/CO, SD, and PP using IDoc, OData, and ABAP Proxies.


Experience and Qualifications

  • 3- 5 years of relevant experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience as an SAP MM Functional Consultant, including participation in at least one full-cycle SAP implementation project


Must Have Competencies

  • Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement, end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes, and enterprise structure configuration.
  • Proficiency in advanced MM configuration including pricing procedures, movement types, account determination, split valuation, output management, batch management, and STO.
  • Strong integration experience between MM and FI/CO, SD, and PP via IDoc, OData services, and ABAP Proxies.
  • Experience in preparing functional specifications for custom RICEFW objects using the SAP Enhancement Framework and standard BAPIs.


Good to have Competencies

  • Practical experience in executing data migration using S/4HANA tools like LTMC and LSMW.
  • Familiarity with Material Ledger in S/4HANA and cloud procurement platforms like SAP Ariba.
  • Working knowledge of cross-functional modules such as Warehouse Management (WM/EWM) or Quality Management (QM).
  • Ability to perform basic ABAP debugging and work within an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.


Want to know more?

At Ather, we’ve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.


Be You, With Us

The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

title: Duty Manager
description:
Own the guest journey. Lead the hotel. Deliver consistency at scale.


Why this role exists:


Z Hotels is scaling - and the front office is where service promise meets operational reality.


Every guest interaction - from arrival to departure - is shaped at the front desk.


If the experience is inconsistent, if escalations are mishandled, if the team is not aligned - guest trust breaks instantly.


As occupancy increases, the challenge is not just handling volume - it is maintaining service consistency, operational discipline, and team performance across every shift.


This role exists to ensure the front office operates as a controlled, high-performing, guest-centric unit - every single day.


Your mandate is clear:

  • Own the end-to-end guest experience at the property
  • Build and continuously upgrade front office team capability
  • Enforce SOPs with zero tolerance for execution gaps
  • Handle escalations with speed, authority, and clarity
  • Protect revenue, ratings, and repeat experience


This is not a supervision role. It is ownership of the hotel and its outcomes.


What you will be responsible for:

  • Own Guest Experience & Service Outcomes:
    • Take end-to-end ownership of the guest journey from arrival to departure
    • Monitor guest feedback and reviews daily and act on insights
    • Ensure consistent service tone across all shifts
    • Drive high review ratings through structured guest engagement
    • Maintain strong presence during peak hours and critical touchpoints
  • Build Team Leadership & Capability:
    • Hire, train, and upgrade front office team members
    • Conduct structured shift briefings and daily alignment
    • Coach team on communication, empathy, and service standards
    • Identify and act on underperformance early
    • Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and professionalism
  • Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Compliance:
    • Ensure strict adherence to check-in, check-out, and billing processes
    • Eliminate operational gaps and inconsistencies across shifts
    • Monitor daily execution of front office protocols
    • Maintain grooming and presentation standards
    • Ensure coordination with housekeeping and other teams is seamless
  • Handle Escalations & High-Pressure Situations:
    • Take immediate ownership of guest escalations
    • De-escalate situations with confidence and clarity
    • Manage peak-time chaos with structured decision-making
    • Coordinate across teams to resolve issues quickly
    • Conduct post-incident reviews and prevent recurrence
  • Protect Revenue & Reputation:
    • Ensure correct rate application and billing accuracy
    • Monitor and control complimentary usage and leakages
    • Drive room upgrade opportunities in a structured manner
    • Understand impact of service quality on ratings and occupancy
    • Actively protect and improve the property's online reputation
  • Maintain Reporting & System Discipline:
    • Ensure PMS accuracy and real-time updates
    • Maintain clean and reliable daily reports
    • Track occupancy trends and flag risks early
    • Review night audit and identify discrepancies
    • Build data-backed visibility into front office performance


What success looks like after 12 months:

  • Consistently smooth and fast check-in/check-out experience
  • Strong guest ratings driven by service quality
  • Well-trained, stable, and high-performing FO team
  • Minimal operational errors and billing disputes
  • Controlled and confident escalation handling
  • Improved upgrade conversion and revenue discipline
  • Accurate, reliable, and timely reporting


The hotel feels structured, calm, and consistently high quality - even during peak pressure.


Who this role is for:


You will likely thrive here if:

  • You naturally take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
  • You are comfortable leading teams and holding people accountable
  • You stay calm and structured during high-pressure situations
  • You notice execution gaps and fix them quickly
  • You balance guest empathy with operational discipline
  • You think in terms of systems, not just individual actions


Experience we value:

  • 3-5 years of experience in customer-facing operations or service roles
  • Prior experience managing teams or leading frontline staff
  • Strong communication and people management capability
  • Demonstrated ability to handle customer issues and escalations
  • Comfort with basic systems, reporting, and operational processes


Note: Hospitality experience is not mandatory.


Leadership mindset, ownership, and execution discipline are critical.


The impact you will have:


You will define how every guest experiences the hotel from the first interaction.


You will build and scale the front office team into a high-performing unit.


You will directly influence ratings, repeat stays, and revenue outcomes.


Why join now:


Z Hotels is entering a rapid expansion phase across markets.


As we scale, the consistency of guest experience will define brand strength.


Front office leadership will determine whether growth enhances or dilutes trust.


If you believe guest experience is built through discipline, leadership, and execution - this is the right moment.

title: Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (DCISO)
description:
Zions Bancorporation’s Enterprise Information Security (EIS) team is transforming what it means to work for a financial institution. With a commitment to technology and innovation, we have been providing our community, clients and colleagues the best experience possible for over 150 years. Help us transform our workforce of the future, today.

We are seeking a Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (DCISO) to join Zions Bancorporation. The DCISO is responsible for critical operational and strategic capabilities, alignment with key stakeholders, and overall program leadership and execution.

This position works closely with executive leadership, technology teams, and business stakeholders to develop and execute cybersecurity strategies that support business objectives, regulatory expectations, and industry leading practices. The ability to maintain credibility and strong working relationships within the three lines of defense, external auditors, and regulators is a key success factor for the role.

The DCISO directs enterprise-wide cybersecurity programs and projects, manages budgets and resources, leads teams directly and cross-functionally, and ensures the organization maintains a strong and resilient cybersecurity posture.

Responsibilities\:

  • Oversee cyber program definition, execution, measurement and reporting, including multi-year strategic objectives, annual plans, budget, resources, and prioritization
  • Lead key cyber initiatives informed by our threat environment and business objectives\: cross-functional staff, objectives, execution, committee and Board reporting
  • The DCISO strategic initiatives include, but are not limited to\:
    • Cyber secure supply chain
    • Offensive and defensive AI security
    • Cyber resilience
  • Oversee Enterprise Cyber Architecture, manage the practice, personnel, objectives and capabilities
  • Lead and standardize talent management, workforce strategies, internship program, performance management, training, professional development, and retention across the EIS workforce
  • Manage cyber investments, tooling approaches, platforms, and services to align with our strategy and good stewardship principles
  • Ensure strong relationships across the three lines of defense and with regulators, including successful reviews, exams, and prompt correction of identified issues
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications\:

  • 12+ years of experience with cybersecurity/technology
  • Significant leadership experience (managing managers, multiple teams) in large-scale, enterprise environments
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in multiple cybersecurity domains\: cyber operations/incident response, identity/access management, data protection, cryptography, etc.; hands-on, fundamental expertise in at least one of these disciplines is required
  • Current expertise of artificial intelligence as applied to cybersecurity, including both securing the firm’s use of AI and protecting the firm from external AI threats
  • Experience implementing cyber resilience strategy, capabilities, assessment, testing, and partnering with enterprise resiliency and technology stakeholders
  • Experience with cyber governance, risk management, and compliance, especially in a regulated environment
  • Experience with third-party risk management and supply chain security
  • Experience managing projects, programs, roadmaps, and delivery for a complex technical organization
  • Exceptional communication skills, including preparation and presentation of Board materials, communication with regulators, chairing technical committees, and navigating sensitive topics with varied stakeholders
  • Exceptional leadership, strategic planning, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to influence decision-making across all levels of the organization
  • Experience managing significant enterprise budgets, technology engagements, and vendor relationships
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

title: Forecast Analyst
description:
Join our vertically integrated team at MAT Holdings, Inc., a leading global manufacturer with a 40-year history. We're proud to provide employment opportunities for more than 14,000 employees across 12 countries. Headquartered in Long Grove, Illinois, we have over 40 factories on three continents, including 2.1 million square feet of U.S. distribution and manufacturing space.

You will find our products in home improvement centers, big box retailers, hardware stores and automotive chains. They're in the cars you drive, the trailers you tow, and the heavy-duty machinery you operate.

MAT can maintain consistent expertise and solutions across the entire supply chain. We’re experts in engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, logistics and distribution, marketing, design, and customer service — we don't just make it happen, we ensure it happens with excellence.

We’re more than manufacturing, we’re MAT.

Benefits

  • MAT Holdings Inc. and its subsidiaries offer a complete benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance after 60 days of employment
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), including paid vacation, sick days, and paid holidays
  • 401k Retirement Plan + Company Match
  • Career Advancement Program, training and development
  • Wellness Programs, including fitness reimbursements and mental health support
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Voluntary Life / AD&D , Employer Provided Life/AD&D

Job Description

This role is responsible for supporting the Manager of Demand Planning in delivering accurate and on-time demand plans for the MATI and MIND Divisions of MAT Holdings. MATI services the Home Improvement sector with various fencing and lawn & garden products. MIND is a leading manufacturer of air compressors and air tools. Both division’s products are sold primarily in Home Centers, Hardware, Mass Merchant, Farm, and Industrial distributor’s channels. This person will support the Manager of Demand Planning through the S&OP process while working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product Development, and Sourcing.

Principle Responsibilities

  • Lead in developing and maintaining monthly forecasts for all finished goods parts using order and shipment history, customer point of sale data, market intelligence, and industry trends to inform the projected demand.
  • Work with sales, marketing, and product management to understand product life cycles, demand patterns, and short-, medium-, and long-term forecasts.
  • Develop and maintain monthly forecast accuracy and forecast bias metrics by customer, product family, and SKU.
  • Ensure proactive communication and delivery of targets for forecast accuracy and bias. Drive action plans for improvement in case of non-compliant KPIs.
  • Communicate and summarize forecast changes along with monthly performance and critical variances.
  • Schedule, prepare documentation, and moderate bi-monthly revenue call with sales leadership
  • Run and maintain statistical forecasts in IBP. Analyze and articulate variances between statistical forecast, history, and customer forecast.
  • Develop, maintain, and report out weekly and monthly POS and inventory reports for key customers with sales leadership
  • Articulate and present POS, inventory levels, price points, store counts, and rate of sales observations to multiple levels within the organization

Qualifications

  • Able to process large amounts of data, influence others, drive cross-functional alignment, and communicate at various levels within the organization.
  • Experience using and interacting with Demand Planning systems.
  • Experience with forecasting methodologies, techniques, and approaches (e.g., time series, causal modeling, and ML)
  • Must be well organized, self-motivated, focused on meeting deadlines, and able to multitask within a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (i.e., Excel and PowerPoint) and prior ERP system experience such as SAP.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrate ability to work collaboratively across the organization to accomplish strategic objectives

Education/Experience:

  • Undergraduate degree in operations management, supply chain, engineering, statistics, or a related field. Certifications like Google Data Analytics or Six Sigma are also welcomed
  • 2-5 years of supply chain planning experience in S&OP, demand, and supply planning.
  • CPG and E-Commerce experience a plus.



The posted salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications.



Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Production Planner - Chemical products

Working closely with the Logistics Manager, you will take ownership of production and materials planning, ensuring customer orders are translated into effective purchasing and manufacturing schedules.


A key part of the role will involve developing and improving systems and processes to enhance forecasting, inventory management, purchasing and production efficiency.

  • Develop demand forecasts and translate customer orders into production and material requirements.
  • Monitor raw material stocks, plan replenishment and coordinate purchasing.

As a Production Planning Specialist, you will use your strong analytical and problem-solving skills to oversee the coordination of assembly integration and testing activities across multiple programs. You will help identify and mitigate risks to ensure on-time delivery to international customers.

You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where you’ll tackle a variety of challenges, including scheduling conflicts, material constraints, equipment availability, labor capacity, and overall production planning.

title: Sports Executive
description:
Help win and run thumpN's sports partnerships, from the first pitch deck to match day.


Why This Role Exists:


Big sports deals run on the details.


Behind every league or tournament partnership is a lot of work most people never see: proposals, tenders, inventory sheets, revenue projections, trackers and a long list of stakeholders to keep in sync. Getting that right is what lets us win the deal and deliver it well.


You'll work closely with our Sports Lead across business development and account management. You'll help build the proposals that win properties, keep our sports accounts running smoothly, and learn the business of sports ticketing from the inside.


What You'll Actually Do:

  • Support the Sports Lead on business development, client acquisition, proposals, presentations and tender submissions.
  • Help build commercial proposals, inventory analysis and revenue projections.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for new events and partnerships, drive pitches and conversions, and work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and long-term business growth.
  • Support existing sports accounts and help them grow.
  • Coordinate with clients and with Account Management, Operations, Product, Finance and Marketing for event onboarding and execution.
  • Put together client reporting that's clear, accurate and on time.
  • Maintain business pipelines, client trackers, event calendars, and account documentation.
  • Keep the sports team's information organised so nothing slips between meetings and match days.


What You Bring:

  • Relevant industry experience is a must. At least 2 years in sports events, sports ticketing, league operations, sports agencies or event management.
  • You know your way around Indian sport. A basic understanding of leagues, franchises, associations, tournament organisers and event promoters, and a growing network across them.
  • You can help find a deal and close it. You've supported pitches, proposals or tenders, and you understand what it takes to get a client onboarded.
  • You're good with numbers. Strong proficiency in Excel, pitch deck creation and commercial reporting, and you're comfortable with inventory, pricing and revenue figures.
  • You look after accounts properly. You follow up, keep clients informed and help turn one event into a repeat partnership.
  • You're curious about how the business works. A working knowledge of ticketing economics and commercial models, and a real interest in learning more.
  • You make sure the deal turns into match day. You coordinate with internal teams so onboarding and delivery run smoothly.
  • You know the ground game: Bring structure to match-day chaos, support the Operations team and ensure seamless on-ground execution.


Preferred:

  • Experience on a live sporting event, especially on the ground.
  • Exposure to more than one sport, not just cricket.
  • A genuine love for live sport. You know the difference between watching on TV and being in the stands.


Non-Negotiables:

  • You're a self-starter. You're proactive and target-driven, and you need light direction, not hand-holding, in a company that's growing fast.
  • You're organised to a fault. Trackers updated, notes sent, files where they should be. The Sports Lead can rely on you to keep things moving.
  • You're happy on the ground. You're willing to travel and work on-site during sporting events when needed. Match day is where you learn the most.
  • You want to grow. You see this as the start of a career in the business of sport, and you're keen to take on more as you go.

title: Senior Production Planner
description:
Techo-Bloc designs and manufactures premium hardscape products (pavers, slabs, walls, steps and outdoor living features) that end up in backyards, patios and public spaces across North America. What started as an entrepreneurial bet in Quebec has grown into an 850+ person team with production plants across Canada and the United States, and a proud Canada’s Best Managed Companies award winner.

Our founder, Charles Ciccarello, likes to say: “We didn’t fit the mold, so we made our own.” That mindset still drives how we work: ambitious, hands-on, and always looking for a better way.

Job Description

You’re the planner people turn to when things get complicated. You see the bottleneck coming three weeks out, you know why the KPI moved, and you’d rather fix the process than firefight the same problem twice.

At Techo-Bloc, we’re looking for that person to become the go-to planning expert of our Saint-Hubert team. You’ll own the schedule for key lines, shape our short, medium and long-term plans, build better tools, and help grow the next generation of planners. Your ideas won’t sit in a deck: you’ll have the room and the backing to implement them.

Why you’ll love this role

  • A real planning challenge. Strong seasonality, high-volume peaks, a wide range of SKUs, colors and textures. This is planning at its most interesting.
  • Influence that counts. You’ll work side by side with the Planning Manager and have a direct voice with production, procurement and sales.
  • Room to build. We expect you to improve how we plan, from tools and templates to processes and KPIs, not just run the existing system.
  • A leadership role, without the org chart. Mentor planners and set the standard for the team.
  • A company that grows its people. Over 850 employees, a growing North American footprint, and career paths in almost every department.
  • Close to home for the South Shore. No bridge, no downtown commute.

What You’ll Do

Plan for today and for the season ahead

  • Own the daily and weekly production schedule for your assigned lines and keep orders accurate in our MRP/ERP system.
  • Translate demand forecasts into realistic plans aligned with actual capacity, over the short, medium and long term.
  • Anticipate capacity, bottleneck and sequencing risks, and work with the Planning Manager to address them before they hit the floor.

Turn data into decisions

  • Analyze demand, trends and historical data to spot risks and opportunities early.
  • Prevent stockouts and excess inventory before they have an impact.
  • Drive KPI performance (service level, changeovers, excess inventory, backorder lead time): understand the trends, propose actions and follow them through.

Make planning better

  • Turn day-to-day pain points into lasting fixes: build the tools, adjust the processes, measure the results.
  • Lead corrective actions and confirm they actually worked.

Lead through expertise

  • Be the team’s go-to planning expert.
  • Coach and onboard planners, and pass on best practices, procedures and tool know-how.
  • Collaborate proactively with sales on demand and priorities, and with production and procurement on execution.

Qualifications

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of production planning experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • A track record of moving KPIs and leading process improvement initiatives. Come ready to tell us about one.
  • Strong MRP/ERP proficiency and advanced Excel skills.
  • An analytical, strategic mind, combined with the rigor to keep the details right.
  • The ability to influence and coach others, with or without a title.
  • Fluency in French and English, as you’ll work regularly with our colleagues in Ontario and the US.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in operations management, industrial engineering, supply chain or a related field.
  • Experience with seasonal or high-mix / high-volume production.
  • Experience with S&OP processes, Power BI or other analytics tools.
  • APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or Lean / Six Sigma training.

Additional Information

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and a bonus plan
  • Group insurance plans
  • RRSP with employer contribution
  • 24/7 telemedicine and Employee Assistance Program
  • Weekly one-on-ones with your manager to tackle challenges, celebrate wins and plan your growth
  • Thousands of hours of training every year, and real support to take that course or learn that new tool
  • Clear career paths: we have interns who became department directors in under 10 years
  • Discounts on Techo-Bloc products (your own backyard will thank you)
  • Team events and an employee referral program

Ready to raise the bar for our planning team? Apply today. A résumé is all we need, no cover letter required. We’ll get back to you quickly.

Techo-Bloc is committed to an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.
