title: Sourcing Analyst
description:
Sourcing Analyst – Heavy Cargo & Specialized Transportation

Luminary Logistics Solutions (LLS)

Location: Remote – United States

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary: $60,000–$70,000 annually

Important: Required Industry Experience

Applicants must have direct, hands-on experience sourcing, pricing, and coordinating transportation solutions for heavy, oversized, overweight, or specialized project cargo.

This is not an entry-level logistics or general procurement position. We are seeking an experienced professional who understands the complexities of heavy cargo transportation and can independently source vendors, obtain accurate pricing, and develop transportation solutions with minimal training.

Experience in general freight forwarding, standard truckload brokerage, warehouse operations, or general purchasing alone will not meet the requirements of this position.

About the Position

Luminary Logistics Solutions is seeking an experienced Sourcing Analyst to support our heavy cargo and project logistics operations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing specialized transportation providers, developing competitive pricing, negotiating vendor rates, and identifying effective transportation solutions for complex cargo movements.

This position requires someone who can assess cargo requirements, identify appropriate equipment and vendors, recognize potential logistical challenges, and independently manage sourcing requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source transportation services for heavy, oversized, overweight, and specialized project cargo.
  • Identify and qualify heavy-haul carriers, crane and rigging companies, barge operators, rail providers, terminals, and specialized transportation vendors.
  • Obtain, analyze, and negotiate competitive vendor quotations.
  • Develop transportation pricing for complex domestic and international project cargo movements.
  • Evaluate equipment requirements, transportation routes, permitting considerations, and logistical challenges.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Project Management to develop comprehensive transportation solutions.
  • Identify potential risks, access limitations, and cost considerations associated with specialized cargo.
  • Build and maintain relationships with qualified transportation and logistics providers.
  • Manage multiple sourcing requests while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Maintain detailed vendor records, pricing documentation, and sourcing information.

Required Qualifications

  • Direct professional experience sourcing and pricing heavy, oversized, overweight, or specialized project cargo transportation.
  • Demonstrated experience working with specialized transportation providers, such as heavy-haul carriers, crane and rigging companies, or multimodal project logistics vendors.
  • Working knowledge of specialized transportation equipment and requirements.
  • Experience obtaining vendor quotes, analyzing costs, and negotiating transportation pricing.
  • Ability to evaluate cargo specifications and determine appropriate transportation solutions.
  • Understanding of transportation challenges associated with large industrial equipment and complex project movements.
  • Ability to independently manage sourcing activities with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related business applications.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Transportation of transformers, generators, turbines, industrial machinery, and other large-scale equipment.
  • Heavy-haul trucking, rail, barge, ocean breakbulk, and specialized project cargo logistics.
  • Crane and rigging operations, port and terminal services, and multimodal transportation.
  • Project logistics supporting energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, and industrial construction.
  • Established relationships with specialized transportation vendors.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a professional who can contribute immediately and who already understands the heavy cargo and specialized transportation industry.

The ideal candidate will have practical experience independently sourcing vendors, negotiating pricing, evaluating transportation requirements, and developing cost-effective solutions for complex cargo movements.

Candidates must demonstrate relevant hands-on heavy cargo sourcing experience. General logistics or procurement experience without this specialized background is not sufficient.

title: Solution Analyst
description:
Who We Are

FarEye is a low-code, Intelligent Delivery Management Platform, that makes the delivery experience better for everyone. Our low code/ no-code SaaS platform helps shippers and carriers to do deliveries at reduced cost and high customer experience.


With 20+ Gartner mentions, FarEye is empowering more than 150 enterprises across 30 plus countries to win in this customer-centric era with exception- al delivery experience and efficient operations. We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified organization, driven by a passion for innovation, inclusivity,and empowering our teams to thrive.


Join a workplace where your ideas matter, your growth is a priority, and collaboration fuels everything we do.


What We Do

FarEye, is a technology platform that does logistic process automation, intelligent optimization and provides predictability. We help you achieve on-time delivery with higher profitability. Technology has the answer to most complex problems of logistics and transportation and each of us at FarEye is dedicated to finding those solutions.


What We Believe In

Diversity, Collaboration, Customer First, Environment- We are on a mission to make life better for everyone through the power of technology-driven logistics. We strongly believe that everyone from big enterprises to end consumers can benefit by running logistics operations more efficiently.


What You Will Work On

Client Service is the team that makes FarEye work in a customer's operation after the sale: the rollout, and everything after it.


You join the pod for a large customer and own a piece of making FarEye work in their operation.You sit in the customer's calls from week one; as you prove yourself, you lead working conversations with their analysts and operations managers,present your work to their team, and travel to them across South East Asia. Your Engagement Manager owns the customer

and reviews your work.


A typical week: a retailer's trucks are leaving the depot with stops in the wrong order and deliveries are landing late. You sit with their operations team to find out why, change how FarEye plans their day, and watch the next morning's routes go out right.


● How one part of the customer's delivery operation works, from order to doorstep, and why. You learn it from their operations people and write it down so others can follow it.

● The improvement to that flow. You work out with the customer's team what should change, and what FarEye should do differently to make it happen.

● Making it happen on FarEye: the setup, the data it needs, the testing against the customer's real orders before they see it, and the record of why it was built that way.

● The repetitive work around all of this. When you have done a task twice by hand, you find a way for a script or an AI tool to do it the third time, and you check the result.

● Several customers over time, so you see more than one operation.

● Based in Noida. You get to be at customer sites across South East Asia.


What success looks like

● What success looks like Your work goes live without the customer finding the problems first.

● Own a piece of a large customer's FarEye go-live from your first month.

● You can explain the part of the operation you own, and why it was built that way, to someone who has never seen it.

● You run a workstream on your own, manage the customer-side dependencies, and raise issues in time to protect the date.

● The customer's team asks for you by name.

● At least one piece of repetitive work has disappeared because of you.


What You Will Bring

● Experience required 0-2 Years (Analyst) / 2-5 Years (Sr Analyst)

● A strong academic record from a top college, in any stream.

● You can work with data, spot what does not add up, and say what it means.

● You can take a complicated operational problem apart and work through it in order.

● You led or built something nobody asked you to.

● You write and speak clearly, including when something has gone wrong.

● Good to have: logistics or supply-chain experience, and some hands-on technical skill such as SQL, scripting or working with APIs. We teach the platform; you bring the thinking.

title: Fashion Curator
description:
Fashion Curator (E-commerce)


You'll set the tone for how Oyela shows up to customers, elevating the look, feel, and relevance of our product catalogue so every shoot feels current, aspirational, and unmistakably on-trend. Working hand-in-hand with the creative, merchandising teams, you'll turn the latest trends into catalogue imagery that's as scroll-stopping as it is high-converting.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the styling direction for catalogue shoots across all categories.
  • Continuously improve the overall look, feel, and consistency of the website catalogue.
  • Curate complete digital looks using garments, accessories, footwear, and props.
  • Track what's trending - on Instagram, Pinterest, and across global and Indian fashion - and translate it into catalogue styling fast.
  • Build styling mood boards and shot references.
  • Audit catalogue quality regularly and spot opportunities to sharpen visual merchandising and conversion.


What We're Looking For:

  • A genuine obsession with fashion and a sharp, current eye for trends, silhouettes, colours, and styling.
  • Deeply plugged into Gen Z fashion culture and the way trends move on social - you know what's landing right now, not last season.
  • An active creator or content sensibility of your own, with a portfolio, feed, or mood boards that show your taste.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong aesthetic instinct.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Early-career is welcome - we care far more about your eye and your feel for the culture than your years on paper.


Bonus Points If You:

  • Create fashion content yourself and have built an engaged Instagram following.
  • Have done content or social for an aesthetic-led brand (cafe, skincare, lifestyle etc).
  • Understand what makes people click and buy in e-commerce.
  • Use Pinterest, Instagram, and international references as second nature for trend research.

title: Transformation and Business Program Manager
description:

title: Logistics Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Logistics Executive to manage and coordinate day-to-day logistics operations, with a strong focus on 1st-mile and mid-mile logistics, vendor coordination, and timely movement of goods, import-export shipments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage 1st-mile and mid-mile logistics operations.
  • Coordinate with vendors, transporters, and warehouses for vehicle placement and timely movement of goods.
  • Create gate passes for stock transfers from the mother warehouse to other locations.

title: GM/HBC Manager-Homer
description:

As a primary contact for Safeway customers, the GM/HBC Manager provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. Works in the variety department of a grocery store handling mostly non-grocery items. The GM/HBC Manager is held accountable for the department’s results in providing superior service, increasing sales, improving gain, and containing cost. Trains, supervises, schedules and assigns duties to GM/HBC Clerks. Follows division guidelines for the implementation of the merchandising program.   3. Speak with customers to resolve problems with sales, dissatisfaction with service or product or other problems related with the operation of the GM/HBC area. Maintain cleanliness of department and storage area.
  4. Replace stock in displays and on shelves as needed. Makes sure all expired items are removed from the shelves daily.
  5. Perform daily inventory and order necessary supplies to maintain adequate inventory.
  6. Write and input order into store computer.
  7. Monitor inter-office mail and company web page daily for updated information.
  8. Other duties as assigned.

GM/HBC Clerks

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.

title: Senior Analyst — Contract & Catalogue Management
description:
Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC) is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31.6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out-of-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).

HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.

MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.

Website: https://www.metro-gsc.in

Company Size: 1000-1100

Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India

Type: Privately Held

Inception: 2011

Job Description

As Senior Specialist for Contract & Catalogue Management, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining contracts and catalogues in SAP Ariba on behalf of all METRO countries, validating country-submitted data, ensuring compliance with global configuration standards, and peer-reviewing work as additional specialists join. You will be the Ariba subject matter expert for the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive and validate contract and catalogue requests submitted by country Procurement teams via the shared inbox and tracker
  • Create and configure contracts and catalogues in SAP Ariba in line with global templates and LUCA programme standards
  • Perform data validation checks on all incoming requests — identifying missing fields, inconsistencies or non-compliant data before processing
  • Manage the contract and catalogue request tracker on a daily basis, updating status, flagging blockers and communicating with country teams
  • Act as peer reviewer for Specialist-level work, ensuring quality and first-time-right accuracy
  • Serve as Ariba subject matter expert — advising the Team Lead and country teams on configuration options, limitations and best practices
  • Liaise directly with country stakeholders to resolve data queries and obtain approvals

Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify recurring data errors or process gaps and propose structural fixes (e.g. request form improvements, quality gate checklists)
  • Support the development and maintenance of process documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Contribute to post-peak capacity planning and potential redeployment planning from Q1 2027

Skills & Competencies:

  • Expert-level knowledge of SAP Ariba — specifically contract module, catalogue management and Guided Buying configuration
  • High attention to detail and strong data accuracy discipline — first-time-right mindset is essential
  • Ability to manage multiple requests in parallel, prioritise effectively and meet SLA targets
  • Clear and professional communication in English, with experience working with cross-cultural stakeholders
  • Structured working style — able to set up trackers, templates and SOPs from scratch
  • Proactive problem-solver — flags issues early rather than waiting for escalation
  • Ability to train and support junior team members

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, IT or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in procurement operations or indirect procurement, with a strong focus on SAP Ariba
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Ariba contract management and/or catalogue configuration — mandatory
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP MM is a plus
  • Experience in a shared services, GCC or multi-country environment is preferred
  • Fluency in English is required

title: Supply Planning Lead
description:
Job Title: Supply Planning Lead

Location: Kolkata (Onsite - Work from Office)


About the Role:

We are looking for a Supply Planning professional to drive distribution and replenishment planning across warehouses and sales channels, ensuring optimal inventory levels, timely product availability, and efficient stock allocation in alignment with business requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

• Drive distribution planning across warehouses and sales channels, ensuring optimal inventory deployment, product availability, and service levels.

• Develop and execute replenishment plans based on demand forecasts, stock cover, inventory norms, lead times, and warehouse-level requirements.

• Monitor inventory across locations, identify stock imbalances, ageing, excess and shortfall risks, and drive inter-warehouse transfers or replenishment actions as required.

• Coordinate with Demand Planning, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams to align supply availability with distribution priorities and business requirements.

• Track fill rates, stock-outs, inventory cover, replenishment adherence, and distribution KPIs; analyse deviations and implement corrective actions.

• Support allocation planning for new launches, promotions, seasonal demand, and peak periods to ensure timely product availability across channels.

• Drive planning accuracy, process standardization, system data quality, and continuous improvement in distribution and replenishment processes.

• Depending on seniority, lead planning reviews, optimize distribution strategies, and mentor or manage the supply planning team.


Preferred Skills & Know-how:

• Strong understanding of Distribution Planning, Replenishment Planning, Inventory Management, and Supply Chain Planning.

• Proficiency in Advanced MS Excel and strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple warehouses and sales channels in a fast-paced business environment.


Experience Requirements:

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Commerce, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.

• Relevant experience in Supply Planning, Distribution Planning, Replenishment Planning, or Inventory Management, with designation aligned to demonstrated capabilities.

• Experience in FMCG, Beauty & Personal Care, Consumer Goods, Retail, or E-commerce preferred.

• Exposure to multi-location inventory planning, warehouse coordination, replenishment optimization, and planning KPI management preferred.

title: Operations Graduates
location: Welwyn Garden City, England, United Kingdom
description:
Build your career. Improve how we operate. Help shape a more sustainable future.

Help us build the modern world

At Sika, we use our expertise, innovation and teamwork to help build the modern world.

For more than 100 years, we have developed specialist products and solutions that support construction and manufacturing around the globe. Our technologies are used in everything from nuclear power stations, high-speed rail links and renewable energy infrastructure to electric vehicles, superyachts and homes for families across the UK.

You may not always see the Sika name, but our products and people are behind many of the structures, systems and technologies that society relies on every day.

We are now looking for talented graduates to join our UK Operations Management Graduate Programme and help shape the future of our operations





Job Description

What we offer you

We have multiple opportunities to join our two-year UK Graduate Programme.

The programme is designed to develop the technical, analytical and leadership capabilities you will need to build a successful career in operations. Our ambition is to prepare high-performing graduates to progress towards a future operational leadership position.

Through a series of structured rotations, you will experience Sika’s end-to-end operations, work alongside teams, and lead projects in areas including:

  • Production and manufacturing
  • Engineering and maintenance
  • Procurement and supply chain
  • Environment, Health and Safety
  • Sustainability and energy management
  • Data analytics and business intelligence
  • Continuous improvement
  • Automation and digitalisation

From the outset, you will be given real responsibilities and the opportunity to deliver meaningful projects with measurable outcomes.



Your role and priorities

Throughout the programme, you will support our Operations and EHS teams in maintaining high standards of safety, compliance and operational excellence. You will contribute to projects that improve how we operate today while helping us prepare for the challenges and opportunities of the future.

Safety and operational performance

  • Drive continuous improvement in Health & Safety performance across all operations
  • Proactively support Operations and EHS teams to create and maintain safe and healthy workspaces
  • Help the business meet its legal, regulatory and moral responsibilities
  • Identify, assess and implement opportunities to reduce risk and improve safety culture
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across different functions and locations to embed EHS best practice and promote a culture of continuous improvement

Sustainability and environmental improvement

  • Support projects to reduce energy consumption, carbon emissions, waste and water usage
  • Analyse environmental and sustainability performance
  • Identify opportunities to make manufacturing processes more efficient and sustainable
  • Support site-level delivery of wider sustainability objectives
  • Help teams understand the environmental impact of operational decisions

Data analysis and business intelligence

  • Collect, analyse and interpret operational data
  • Develop dashboards and reports that support effective decision-making
  • Identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities
  • Turn complex data into clear and practical recommendations
  • Support the development of consistent operational performance measures

Continuous improvement and operational excellence

  • Review processes to identify waste, inefficiency and variation
  • Support Lean and continuous improvement activities
  • Work with operational teams to investigate problems and identify root causes
  • Help implement and measure process improvements
  • Share successful approaches across teams and sites

Digitalisation and automation

  • Support the introduction of digital tools and automated processes
  • Explore opportunities to improve productivity through technology
  • Help teams adopt new systems and ways of working
  • Contribute to projects involving emerging technologies and artificial intelligence
  • Evaluate whether digital solutions have delivered the intended operational benefits

During each rotation, you will deliver defined projects and demonstrate how your work has added value to the organisation.

Your development

You will be supported by a mentor, operational leaders and colleagues across the business. At the start of each rotation, you will agree clear learning objectives and development priorities.

Your development will combine hands-on experience, formal learning, internal and external training, peer support and exposure to senior leaders. You will build capability in:

  • Operational leadership
  • Data analysis and decision-making
  • Sustainability
  • Project and change management
  • Commercial awareness
  • Problem-solving and continuous improvement
  • Communication, influencing and collaboration

Projects you could work on

  • Developing a dashboard to improve visibility of operational performance
  • Analysing manufacturing data to identify productivity opportunities
  • Reducing waste, energy consumption or carbon emissions at one of our sites
  • Improving a production, procurement or supply chain process
  • Supporting the implementation of automation or new digital technology
  • Investigating the root cause of a recurring safety, quality or service issue
  • Improving inventory performance and material availability
  • Developing a business case for an operational investment
  • Helping teams measure the benefits delivered by an improvement project





Qualifications

What we are looking for

We are looking for driven and curious graduates who are ready to tackle the challenges involved in building the modern world.

You will be a team player who builds trust through integrity, accountability and respect. You will be eager to learn from experienced colleagues while bringing your own ideas, energy and perspective to the business.

You should be able to:

  • Approach challenges logically and analytically
  • Work confidently with data and communicate what it means
  • Turn ideas into practical actions
  • Communicate effectively with different audiences
  • Build positive working relationships
  • Remain calm and focused when priorities change
  • Take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments
  • Balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture
  • Demonstrate an interest in manufacturing, sustainability and technology
  • Show the potential and ambition to become a future operations leader

You do not need to arrive with all the answers. We are looking for people with the curiosity, adaptability and determination to learn.

Qualifications

We welcome applications from graduates with a relevant degree or equivalent qualification. Suitable disciplines could include:

  • Engineering
  • Manufacturing or operations management
  • Occupational Health and Safety
  • Supply chain or logistics
  • Data analytics or data science
  • Environmental management or sustainability
  • Business management
  • Chemistry or materials science
  • Other relevant technical or analytical subjects

More important than your specific degree subject will be your ability to learn, solve problems, work with others and apply your knowledge in a practical operational environment.





Additional Information

Your future with Sika

Operations Management is at the centre of what we achieve together. Our customers, colleagues and society rely on us to operate safely, responsibly and effectively.

Our ambition is to develop future operations leaders. High-performing graduates will have opportunities to progress into supervisory, specialist, project or leadership roles, supported by structured development, mentoring and real business responsibility.

If you are ready to learn, contribute and help shape the future of our operations, we would like to hear from you.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Food and Beverage Executive
description:

title: Head of Strategy
description:

CEO

  • High Agency & Sharp Problem-Solving: First-principles thinker who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and effortlessly switches between 30,000-foot strategy and granular operational troubleshooting.
  • Commercial and financial acumen: Strong command of unit economics and financial modelling, applied to pricing, GTM and investment decisions.
  • Team leadership: Builds, develops and gets high-quality output from a lean strategy team.
  • Integrity and discretion: Handles sensitive information and decisions with sound judgement.

title: Operations - CEE
description:
Business Operations – Central & Eastern Europe (CEE)


1. Role Objective

To manage and streamline end-to-end business operations for CEE markets from the India Corporate Office by ensuring effective coordination between country teams, manufacturing plants and cross-functional departments.

The role will focus on converting market demand and purchase orders into timely production, dispatch, billing and revenue realization through effective planning, SAP execution, monitoring and coordination.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Forecast & Demand Planning

  • Collect and consolidate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts from CEE country teams.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and align demand with production capacity and material availability.
  • Identify demand variations, supply gaps and potential risks.

B. Purchase Order Management & SAP Execution

  • Receive, validate and process purchase orders from CEE markets.
  • Ensure accuracy of product details, quantities, pricing, pack sizes and delivery schedules.
  • Create and monitor sales orders and related transactions in SAP.
  • Coordinate with Commercial, Finance and SCM teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely order confirmation.

C. Material & Production Planning

  • Coordinate with SCM, Procurement, PPIC and manufacturing plants for material availability and production feasibility.
  • Monitor API, raw material and packaging material requirements.
  • Track production schedules, batch manufacturing, QA/QC testing and batch release.
  • Identify delays and ensure timely resolution of production and supply-related issues.

D. Regulatory & Artwork Coordination

  • Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs and country teams for product registrations, approvals, renewals and market-specific requirements.
  • Monitor artwork development and approvals.
  • Ensure regulatory and artwork readiness before production and dispatch.

E. Test & Release Sample Management

  • Plan and coordinate product-wise and country-wise test and release sample requirements.
  • Liaise with Production, QA/QC, Warehouse and Regulatory teams for sample availability, testing and approvals.
  • Monitor sample dispatch, test reports, COAs and final release status.
  • Maintain sample trackers and ensure timely closure of pending activities.

F. Dispatch & Logistics Coordination

  • Coordinate with SCM, Warehouse, QA and Export teams to ensure dispatch readiness.
  • Monitor batch release, export documentation and shipment schedules.
  • Track pending dispatches and ensure timely delivery commitments to country teams.

G. Billing, Collections & Business Monitoring

  • Coordinate with Finance for timely invoicing and billing against dispatched orders.
  • Monitor billing performance against monthly and quarterly targets.
  • Track outstanding receivables and coordinate with country teams for collection follow-ups.
  • Monitor pending orders, revenue gaps and overall business execution.

3. Cross-Functional Coordination

The role will act as a central coordination point between:

  • CEE Country Teams – Forecasts, purchase orders and market priorities.
  • Demand Planning – Forecast consolidation and demand prioritisation.
  • SCM / PPIC / Procurement – Material availability and production planning.
  • Regulatory Affairs / R&D – Product registrations, approvals and technical requirements.
  • Production / QA / QC – Manufacturing, testing and batch release.
  • Artwork Team – Packaging and artwork approvals.
  • Warehouse / Export / Logistics – Sample handling, documentation and dispatch.
  • Finance / Commercial – Pricing, SAP transactions, billing and collections.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Forecast accuracy and demand planning effectiveness.
  • Timely PO validation and SAP order creation.
  • Accuracy of sales orders and commercial transactions.
  • Material availability and production plan adherence.
  • Regulatory and artwork readiness.
  • Timely batch manufacturing, testing and release.
  • Test and release sample availability and approval timelines.
  • On-time dispatch and delivery performance.
  • Billing achievement against business targets.
  • Receivables follow-up and collection performance.
  • Reduction in pending orders and operational delays.

5. Review & Monitoring Mechanism

  • Daily: Critical order status, material shortages, production delays, sample status and dispatch priorities.
  • Weekly: PO and SAP order book, forecast versus orders, production progress, regulatory and artwork status.
  • Monthly: Billing, dispatch performance, pending orders, sample release status and collections.
  • Quarterly: Overall business performance, forecast accuracy and process improvement initiatives.

6. Educational Qualifications & Experience

Mandatory Qualification:

  • B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy).

Preferred Qualification:

  • MBA in Operations / Supply Chain Management / Business Administration.

Experience:

  • Relevant experience in pharmaceutical business operations, supply chain, order management or commercial operations.
  • Experience in SAP, demand planning, production coordination and export operations will be an added advantage.
  • Exposure to international markets and cross-functional coordination is preferred.

7. Overall Role Ownership

The position will own the end-to-end operational coordination of CEE markets, from forecast consolidation and PO validation to SAP order execution, material planning, production, sample coordination, batch release, dispatch, billing and collection follow-up.

The individual will serve as the central link between country teams, India Corporate Office and manufacturing plants, ensuring operational efficiency, timely order execution and business continuity.

Ultimate Objective:

To bridge market demand with manufacturing and supply chain execution, ensuring timely order fulfilment, operational excellence, customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Business Operations – Connecting Market Demand to Manufacturing Excellence and Revenue Growth.

title: Supply Planning Analyst
description:
Supply Planning Analyst | North Canton, OH


About A. Stucki Company

At A. Stucki Company, we're built on more than a century of innovation, craftsmanship, and rail industry expertise. Founded in 1911, we've grown into a leading manufacturer and reconditioner of freight car, locomotive, and track components that keep the rail industry moving safely and efficiently across North America.


Our family of companies combines manufacturing excellence, engineering expertise, and customer-focused solutions. As we continue to grow and improve our operations, we're looking for talented professionals who want to make a meaningful impact on our business.


Position Overview

A. Stucki Company is seeking a Supply Planning Analyst to support and strengthen our supply chain operations through data-driven planning, inventory optimization, and cross-functional collaboration.


Reporting through the Supply Chain function, this position plays an important role in our Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process by analyzing material forecasts, aligning supply with customer demand, and ensuring inventory levels support business objectives.


The Supply Planning Analyst will work closely with Operations, Sales, Procurement, and Finance to improve customer service levels, minimize supply chain risks, and drive greater efficiency throughout our manufacturing network.


This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical supply chain professional who enjoys solving complex problems, improving processes, and translating data into actionable business decisions.


The role will also have exposure to general managers and senior leadership through KPI reporting and supply chain performance reviews.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain supply plans that balance customer service requirements, inventory objectives, and overall business needs.
  • Utilize PFEP (Plan for Every Part) methodology to establish optimal stocking levels and material replenishment strategies.
  • Analyze inventory performance and identify opportunities to reduce excess, obsolete, and aging inventory.
  • Proactively identify potential material shortages and supply disruptions, coordinating with Sourcing and other stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
  • Manage supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance against established KPIs, delivery expectations, and continuous improvement objectives.
  • Lead the effective utilization and management of MRP planning tools to maintain appropriate inventory levels and support business objectives.
  • Maintain material master data and planning parameters to ensure accurate, efficient material planning and inventory flow.
  • Support monthly Supply Review meetings as part of the SIOP process, helping align supply capabilities with customer demand and business forecasts.
  • Develop and present supply chain KPIs to General Managers and senior and executive leadership, including customer fill rates, inventory days on hand, and aging inventory.
  • Establish and improve planning processes for both stocked and made-to-order materials.
  • Ensure inventory strategies are incorporated into updated supply plans and reflect changing business requirements.
  • Conduct monthly KPI root cause analysis and develop corrective action plans to address performance gaps.
  • Lead and participate in supply chain projects focused on operational efficiency, cost reduction, inventory optimization, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in supply planning, materials planning, inventory management, or a related supply chain function.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with ERP and MRP planning systems, preferably SAP.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel experience required.
  • Experience with Power BI, SQL, data warehousing, or other analytics platforms is a plus.
  • Previous experience supporting or participating in SIOP, S&OP, or IBP processes preferred.
  • ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.


Join A. Stucki Company and help us build a smarter, more efficient supply chain that keeps our customers and the rail industry moving forward.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:

1. Air Export Procurement & Rate Negotiation

  • Manage end-to-end Air Export procurement activities and ensure competitive pricing.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with airlines, freight forwarders, transporters, and CHA partners.
  • Negotiate and procure competitive air freight rates to improve business margins and profitability.
  • Maintain updated airline rate sheets and ensure timely circulation of rates to Sales and Customer Service teams.
  • Identify new airline partnerships and alternative routing options to enhance service offerings.

2. Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Actively contribute towards developing and expanding the Airfreight business.
  • Support the Sales team in securing new business through competitive pricing and effective procurement strategies.
  • Achieve a minimum enquiry conversion ratio of 60%.
  • Ensure achievement of budgeted tonnage and revenue targets for the department.
  • Identify new business opportunities and strengthen existing customer relationships.

3. Customer Service & Operational Support

  • Provide back-up support to the Customer Service team for Air Export shipments.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth shipment execution and timely resolution of operational issues.
  • Handle commercial and operational challenges related to Air Export shipments.
  • Ensure effective coordination for door-to-door shipments, including origin and destination handling.
  • Monitor shipment-related issues and work towards timely resolution to ensure customer satisfaction.

4. Stakeholder Management & Coordination

  • Coordinate with Sales and Customer Service teams within the division.
  • Work closely with other business divisions, Regional Heads, Branches, and Zonal Managers.
  • Liaise with Airport Operations teams to ensure smooth shipment handling.
  • Coordinate with the Finance team on rate-related, billing, and commercial matters.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with overseas offices, customers, airlines, and external service providers.

5. Market Intelligence & Process Improvement

  • Monitor market trends, airline capacity, freight rate movements, and competitor pricing.
  • Identify opportunities for improving procurement efficiency and commercial profitability.
  • Ensure effective market coverage for corporate customers and business requirements.
  • Explore new airline connections and service providers to strengthen the procurement network.

  • Achievement of budgeted Air Export tonnage and revenue.
  • Minimum 60% conversion of received enquiries.
  • Competitiveness of procured airline rates and commercial margins.
  • Development and expansion of airline and vendor relationships.
  • Timely resolution of commercial and operational challenges.
  • Customer satisfaction and internal stakeholder support.

Key External Linkages
